Mientras tienes esta forma, puedes aumentar tu reducción de daño y resistencia a las despotenciaciones, infligir daño adicional a los enemigos con embestidas y consumir <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color> continuamente para regenerar vida.

name: Terra Slam

names.Thai: ทุบ​แผ่นดิน

description: Deals damage and grants <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. When you have at least 5 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> is consumed to create an explosion that grants even more <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.

descriptions.English: Deals damage and grants <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. When you have at least 5 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> is consumed to create an explosion that grants even more <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 造成伤害，并获得<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>；至少有5层<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>时，消耗<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>引发爆炸，获得更多<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 造成傷害，並獲得<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>；至少有5層<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>時，消耗<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>引發爆炸，獲得更多<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: ダメージを与えて<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を獲得する。<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>が5個以上の場合、<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>を消費して爆発を引き起こし、より多くの<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を獲得する
descriptions.Korean: 대미지를 가하고 <color=#49A5FFFF>「전의」</color>를 획득한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color> 최소 5스택 보유 시, <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color>를 소모해 폭발을 일으키고 더 많은 <color=#49A5FFFF>「전의」</color>를 획득한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Gây ST và nhận được <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color>; Khi ít nhất có 5 tầng <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color>, tiêu hao <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color> sẽ kích nổ, nhận được nhiều <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color> hơn
descriptions.Thai: สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​และ​มอบ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ ​เมื่อ​มี​จำนวน​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​สะสม​อย่างน้อย​ 5 ​ชั้น​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​จะ​ถูก​ใช้​เพื่อ​สร้าง​การระเบิด​ที่​มอบ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ ​มากยิ่งขึ้น
descriptions.French: Inflige des dégâts et accorde de l'<color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color>. Lorsque vous avez au moins 5 instances de <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color>, la <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color> est consommée pour créer une explosion qui accorde encore plus d'<color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color>.
descriptions.German: Verursacht Schaden und gewährt <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color>. Wenn du mindestens 5 Stapel <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> hast, wird <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> verbraucht, um eine Explosion zu erzeugen, die noch mehr <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color> gewährt.
descriptions.Russian: Наносит урон и вызывает <color=#49A5FFFF>жажду крови</color>. Собрав 5 зарядов <color=#49A5FFFF>жизненной силы</color>. <color=#49A5FFFF>Жизненную силу</color> можно потратить, чтобы устроить взрыв, который даст вам еще больше <color=#49A5FFFF>жажды крови</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menghasilkan damage dan memberikan <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. Ketika kamu memiliki setidaknya 5 tumpukan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> dikonsumsi untuk menciptakan ledakan yang menghasilkan lebih banyak lagi <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Causa dano e concede <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color>. Quando você tiver pelo menos 5 pilhas de <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color> é consumida para criar uma explosão que concede ainda mais <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Inflige daño y otorga <color=#49A5FFFF>frenesí</color>. Cuando tienes al menos 5 acumulaciones de <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color>, la <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color> se consume para crear una explosión que otorga aún más <color=#49A5FFFF>frenesí</color>.

name: Massive Trauma

names.Thai: ตอกย้ำ

description: Drastically increases damage against dazed enemies.

descriptions.English: Drastically increases damage against dazed enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 大幅提升对晕眩敌人的伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 大幅提升對暈眩敵人的傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 気絶の敵へのダメージが大幅に上がる
descriptions.Korean: 기절한 적에게 주는 대미지가 대폭 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tăng mạnh ST lên kẻ địch bị choáng
descriptions.Thai: เพิ่ม​ความเสียหาย​ต่อ​ศัตรู​ที่​เหม่อลอย​อยู่​อย่างรุนแรง
descriptions.French: Augmente considérablement les dégâts contre les ennemis hébétés.
descriptions.German: Der Schaden gegen betäubte Gegner ist stark erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наносите значительно повышенный урон оглушенным противникам.
descriptions.Indonesian: Sangat meningkatkan damage pada musuh yang linglung.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Aumenta drasticamente o dano contra inimigos atordoados.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Aumenta mucho el daño contra los enemigos confundidos.

name: Fiery Smite

names.Thai: โล​กันต์​ลงทัณฑ์

description: Infuse your weapon with the power of fire, granting your melee hits a chance to explode on enemies. Locks a percentage of mana.

descriptions.English: Infuse your weapon with the power of fire, granting your melee hits a chance to explode on enemies. Locks a percentage of mana.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用能量上限，为武器注入火焰力量，使你的近战攻击命中敌人后有概率发生爆炸
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用能量上限，為武器注入火焰力量，使你的近戰攻擊命中敵人後有概率發生爆炸
descriptions.Japanese: マナ上限を消費し、武器に炎の力を与える。近接攻撃が敵に命中すると一定確率で爆発を引き起こす
descriptions.Korean: 일정 마나를 차지해 무기에 화염의 힘을 주입한다. 근거리 공격이 적을 명중하면 일정 확률로 폭발한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm giới hạn của năng lượng, truyền sức mạnh lửa vào vũ khí, sau khi giúp bạn Tấn Công Cận Chiến trúng kẻ địch, sẽ có xác suất gây nổ
descriptions.Thai: อาบ​พลัง​ไฟ​ให้​กับ​อาวุธ​ ​ทำให้​การ​โจมตี​ระยะ​ประชิด​มีโอกาส​ที่จะ​ระเบิด​ใส่​ศัตรู​ ​ล็อก​พลัง​เวท​ส่วนหนึ่ง
descriptions.French: Vous imprégnez votre arme du pouvoir du feu. Vos attaques de mêlée peuvent provoquer une explosion. Bloque un certain pourcentage de mana.
descriptions.German: Deine Waffe erhält die Kraft des Feuers, wodurch bei deinen Treffern im Nahkampf die Chance einer Explosion besteht. Sperrt einen Teil des Manas.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наделяете свое оружие силой огня — теперь удары в ближнем бою могут вызывать взрывы. Блокирует часть очков маны.
descriptions.Indonesian: Membenamkan kekuatan api pada senjata, memberikan serangan meleemu peluang untuk meledak pada musuh. Mengunci beberapa persen mana.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Infunde sua arma com o poder de fogo, concedendo a seus golpes corpo a corpo chance de causar explosões ao atingir os inimigos. Bloqueia uma porcentagem de mana.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Infundes tu arma con el poder del fuego, lo que otorga a tus ataques cuerpo a cuerpo la posibilidad de explotar en impacto. Bloquea un porcentaje de maná.

name: Hymn to Gaia

names.Thai: เพลงสวด​แด่​ไก​อา

description: Chance to gain <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> every second. When you have at least 10 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, your attacks inflicts tremors.

descriptions.English: Chance to gain <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> every second. When you have at least 10 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, your attacks inflicts tremors.
descriptions.Chinese: 每秒概率获得<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>，<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>至少为10层时，发动攻击会产生威压
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 每秒概率獲得<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>，<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>至少為10層時，發動攻擊會產生威壓
descriptions.Japanese: 毎秒ごとに一定確率で<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>を獲得する。<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>が10個以上の場合、攻撃時に威圧感を与える
descriptions.Korean: 매초 일정 확률로 <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color>를 획득한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color> 최소 10스택 보유 시, 공격을 발동하면 위압을 생성한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Mỗi giây có xác suất nhận được <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color>, khi <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color> ít nhất là 10 tầng, phát động tấn công sẽ tạo ra uy lực
descriptions.Thai: มีโอกาส​ที่จะ​ได้รับ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​ทุก​วินาที​ ​เมื่อ​มี​จำนวน​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​สะสม​อย่างน้อย​ 10 ​ชั้น​ ​การ​โจมตี​จะ​ทำให้เกิด​แรง​สั่นสะเทือน
descriptions.French: Une chance de gagner en <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color> chaque seconde. Lorsque vous avez au moins 10 instances de <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color>, vos attaques infligent des tremblements.
descriptions.German: Chance, jede Sekunde <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> zu erhalten. Wenn du mindestens 10 Stapel <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> hast, lösen deine Angriffe ein Beben aus.
descriptions.Russian: Каждую секунду дает шанс получить <color=#49A5FFFF>жизненную силу</color>. Собрав 10 зарядов <color=#49A5FFFF>жизненной силы</color>, вы сможете вызывать землетрясения.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kesempatan untuk mendapatkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color> setiap detik. Ketika memiliki setidaknya 10 tumpukan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, seranganmu menimbulkan getaran.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Chance de ganhar <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color> a cada segundo. Quando você tiver pelo menos 10 pilhas de <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color>, seus ataques causam tremores.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): La oportunidad de ganar <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color> cada segundo. Cuando tienes al menos 10 acumulaciones de <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color>, tus ataques causan temblores.

name: Searing Colossus

names.Thai: ย่าง​สด​ครั้ง​ใหญ่

description: Draw enemies together with a thermic blastwave and summon a powerful Fire Colossus on them. When drawing enemies together, you assimilate <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> in the area to restore life.

descriptions.English: Draw enemies together with a thermic blastwave and summon a powerful Fire Colossus on them. When drawing enemies together, you assimilate <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> in the area to restore life.
descriptions.Chinese: 用热浪聚集敌人，并召唤强大的火焰巨人。聚集时吸收周围<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>会恢复生命值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 用熱浪聚集敵人，並召喚強大的火焰巨人。聚集時吸收周圍<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>會恢復生命值
descriptions.Japanese: 炎で敵を引き寄せ、強力な炎の巨人を召喚する。敵を引き寄せる時に<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>を吸収するとHPを回復する
descriptions.Korean: 열파로 적들을 끌어당겨 강력한 화염 거인을 소환한다. 적을 끌어당길 때 주변의 <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>을 흡수해 생명력을 회복한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Dùng sóng nhiệt tập hợp kẻ địch và triệu hồi Người Khổng Lồ Lửa. Khi tập hợp sẽ hấp thu <color=#49A5FFFF>"Ngọn Lửa"</color> xung quanh hồi phục HP.
descriptions.Thai: ดึง​ศัตรู​มา​อยู่​รวมกัน​ด้วย​การระเบิด​และ​อัญเชิญ​โคล​อส​ซัส​ไฟ​ลง​ทับ​พวก​มัน​ ​ขณะ​ดึง​ศัตรู​มาร​ว​ม​กัน​ ​คุณ​จะ​ดูดซับ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>​ใน​พื้นที่​เพื่อ​ฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต
descriptions.French: Vous rassemblez les ennemis avec une onde de choc thermique avant d'invoquer un puissant colosse de feu. Quand vous rassemblez les ennemis, vous assimilez les <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> dans la zone pour regagner de la vie.
descriptions.German: Mit einer thermischen Druckwelle drängst du Gegner zusammen und beschwörst einen mächtigen Feuerkoloss auf sie. Beim Zusammendrängen der Gegner nutzt du <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> in dem Gebiet, um Leben wiederherzustellen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы притягиваете противников друг к другу тепловой взрывной волной и обрушиваете на них могучего огненного колосса. Притягивая врагов, вы поглощаете <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color> в области, чтобы восстановить здоровье.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menarik musuh bersama dengan ledakan gelombang panas dan memanggil Kolosus Api yang kuat. Saat menarik musuh bersama, kamu memunculkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Bara</color> di area untuk memulihkan HP.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Atrai os inimigos com uma onda de explosão térmica e invoca um poderoso Colosso de Fogo sobre eles. Ao aproximar os inimigos, você assimila <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> na área para restaurar sua vida.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Agrupas a los enemigos con un rayo térmico e invocas un coloso ígneo sobre ellos. Al agrupar enemigos, absorbes las <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color> del área para recuperar vida.

name: Bloodborne

names.Thai: เปื้อน​เลือด

description: You gain Battlelust and mana whenever life is lost. Additionally, your attack speed is increased for each stack of Battlelust you have.

descriptions.English: You gain Battlelust and mana whenever life is lost. Additionally, your attack speed is increased for each stack of Battlelust you have.
descriptions.Chinese: 生命值减少时获得「战意」并恢复能量值。每层「战意」还会提升攻击速度
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 生命值減少時獲得「戰意」並恢復能量值。每層「戰意」還會提升攻擊速度
descriptions.Japanese: HPが減る時に「闘志」を獲得してマナを回復する。「闘志」一つにつき攻撃速度がアップする
descriptions.Korean: HP가 감소할 때 「전의」를 획득하고 마나를 회복한다. 「전의」 스택마다 공격 속도가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi HP giảm, nhận [Chiến Ý] và hồi Năng Lượng. Mỗi tầng [Chiến Ý] cũng sẽ tăng tốc độ đánh
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​ได้รับ​บ้าเลือด​และ​พลัง​เวท​ทุกครั้งที่​สูญเสีย​พลัง​ชีวิต​ ​นอกจากนี้​ ​ความเร็ว​การ​โจมตี​ของ​คุณ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ตามแต่​ละ​ชั้น​ของ​บ้าเลือด​ที่​คุณมี
descriptions.French: Vous gagnez Ardeur guerrière ainsi que du mana à chaque fois que vous perdez de la vie. De plus, votre vitesse d'attaque est augmentée pour chaque instance d'Ardeur guerrière que vous avez.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst Kampflust und Mana, wenn du Leben verlierst. Außerdem erhöht sich dein Angriffstempo für jeden Stapel Kampflust, den du hast.
descriptions.Russian: Вы получаете жажду крови и ману при каждой потере здоровья. Кроме того, ваша скорость атаки повышается за каждый имеющийся у вас заряд жажды крови.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu mendapatkan Battlelust dan mana setiap kali HP berkurang, kecepatan serang juga meningkat untuk setiap tumpuk Battlelust.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você recebe Desejo de Batalha e mana sempre que perde vida. Além disso, sua velocidade de ataque é aumentada a cada pilha de Desejo de Batalha que você tiver.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Obtienes frenesí y maná siempre que pierdes vida. Además, aumenta tu velocidad de ataque por cada frenesí que tengas acumulado.

name: Transmute Strength
description: A percentage of your Strength is added to Magical Attack.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Strength is added to Magical Attack.
descriptions.Chinese: 法术攻击获得一定比例的力量加成

name: Juggernaut's Might
description: Gain increased physical size and stats.

descriptions.English: Gain increased physical size and stats.
descriptions.Chinese: 体型变大，获得各项属性提升

name: Dreadnaught

names.Thai: เดร​ด​น็อต

description: You gain increased damage reduction in inverse proportion to life percentage.

descriptions.English: You gain increased damage reduction in inverse proportion to life percentage.
descriptions.Chinese: 生命值越低，伤害减免越高
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 生命值越低，傷害減免越高
descriptions.Japanese: HPが低いほど、被ダメージ軽減効果がアップする
descriptions.Korean: HP가 낮을수록 대미지 경감이 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: HP càng thấp, Giảm ST càng cao
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​ได้รับ​การ​ลด​ความเสียหาย​เพิ่มขึ้น​ใน​สัดส่วน​ผกผัน​กับ​เปอร์เซ็นต์​พลัง​ชีวิต
descriptions.French: Vous gagnez un bonus de réduction de dégâts proportionnel à la vie qu’il vous manque.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst eine erhöhte Schadensreduktion im umgekehrten Verhältnis zum Lebensprozentsatz.
descriptions.Russian: Вы получаете повышенное снижение урона в обратной пропорции к проценту здоровья.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu memperoleh pengurangan damage yang ditingkatkan sesuai dengan persentase HP.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você recebe redução de dano aumentada em proporção inversa à porcentagem de vida.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Obtienes una mayor reducción de daño en proporción inversa al porcentaje de vida.

name: Searing Colossus
description: Draw enemies together with a blastwave and summon a powerful Fire Colossus into battle.

descriptions.English: Draw enemies together with a blastwave and summon a powerful Fire Colossus into battle.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放一阵冲击波聚拢敌人，并召唤强大的火焰巨人加入战斗

name: Fireblade Ward
description: Surround yourself with a ward of flaming swords that attack enemies.

descriptions.English: Surround yourself with a ward of flaming swords that attack enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 扔出围绕自身的火焰剑攻击敌人

name: Shadow Manifestation

names.Thai: การปรากฏ​ของ​เงา

description: Your physical attacks deal additional Dark Damage, and Dark-based attacks deal additional physical damage.

descriptions.English: Your physical attacks deal additional Dark Damage, and Dark-based attacks deal additional physical damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 物理攻击会附带黑暗伤害。黑暗攻击会附带物理伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 物理攻擊會附帶黑暗傷害。黑暗攻擊會附帶物理傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 物理攻撃は闇ダメージを、闇攻撃は物理ダメージを追加する
descriptions.Korean: 물리 공격에 어둠 대미지가 부여된다. 어둠 공격에 물리 대미지가 부여된다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn Công Vật Lý sẽ kèm ST Hắc Ám. Tấn Công Hắc Ám sẽ kèm ST Vật Lý
descriptions.Thai: การ​โจมตี​ทางกายภาพ​ของ​คุณ​จะ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ความมืด​เพิ่มเติม​ ​และ​การ​โจมตี​จาก​ความมืด​จะ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ทางกายภาพ​เพิ่มเติม
descriptions.French: Vos attaques physiques infligent des dégâts de ténèbres supplémentaires, et vos attaques de ténèbres infligent des dégâts physiques supplémentaires.
descriptions.German: Deine physischen Angriffe verursachen zusätzlichen Dunkelschaden und dunkelbasierte Angriffe verursachen zusätzlichen physischen Schaden.
descriptions.Russian: Ваши физические атаки наносят дополнительный урон от тьмы, а атаки на основе тьмы наносят дополнительный физический урон.
descriptions.Indonesian: Serangan Fisik memberikan Damage Kegelapan tambahan, dan serangan Kegelapan memberikan Damage Fisik tambahan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Seus ataques físicos causam Dano Sombrio adicional e os ataques baseados em Sombras causam Dano Físico adicional.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tus ataques físicos infligen más daño oscuro, y los ataques de oscuridad infligen más daño físico.

name: Chain Hook
description: Hook and pull targets to you.

descriptions.English: Hook and pull targets to you.
descriptions.Chinese: 将目标单位拉至身边

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Bounding Shield

names.Thai: โล่​กระเด้ง

description: Throw your shield, which bounds between enemies, damaging and dazing them. Deals more damage when you have <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.

descriptions.English: Throw your shield, which bounds between enemies, damaging and dazing them. Deals more damage when you have <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 投掷盾牌弹射攻击敌人造成晕眩。拥有<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>时伤害更高
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 投擲盾牌彈射攻擊敵人造成暈眩。擁有<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>時傷害更高
descriptions.Japanese: 盾を投げ捨てて敵を攻撃して気絶させる。<color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>を持つ時ダメージが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 방패를 던져 적을 기절시킨다. <color=#49A5FFFF>"결심"</color> 보유 시 대미지가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Ném Khiên tấn công gây choáng kẻ địch. Khi có <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quyết Tâm"</color>, ST sẽ cao hơn
descriptions.Thai: โยน​โล่​ซึ่ง​จะ​กระเด้ง​กระดอน​ระหว่าง​ศัตรู​ ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​และ​ทำให้​เหม่อลอย​ ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​มากขึ้น​เมื่อ​คุณมี<color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>
descriptions.French: Vous lancez votre bouclier, qui rebondit d'un ennemi à l'autre. Les ennemis touchés subissent des dégâts et sont hébétés. Inflige plus de dégâts avec de la <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color>.
descriptions.German: Du schleuderst deinen Schild, der von Gegner zu Gegner springt und ihnen dabei Schaden zufügt sowie sie betäubt. Wenn du über <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color> verfügst, ist der Schaden erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы метаете свой щит, который отскакивает от противника к противнику, нанося урон и оглушая. Щит наносит больше урона, если у вас есть состояние <color=#49A5FFFF>«Решимость»</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melemparkan tamengmu, yang memantul antara musuh, memberi damage dan membuat linglung. Memberikan lebih banyak damage saat kamu memiliki <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Arremessa seu escudo, que salta entre os inimigos, causando dano e atordoando-os. Causa mais dano quando você tem <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu escudo rebota entre los enemigos al lanzarlo, lo que inflige daño y confusión. Inflige más daño cuando tienes <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color>.

name: Dark Covenant

names.Thai: พันธสัญญา​แห่ง​ความมืด

description: You exchange life for a massive increase to damage that diminishes over time. If a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> is present, its damage also diminishes at the same rate.

descriptions.English: You exchange life for a massive increase to damage that diminishes over time. If a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> is present, its damage also diminishes at the same rate.
descriptions.Chinese: 消耗生命值，大幅增加自己的伤害，并逐步衰减。存在<color=#49A5FFFF>「牺牲」</color>时同步降低其伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 消耗生命值，大幅增加自己的傷害，並逐步衰減。存在<color=#49A5FFFF>「犧牲」</color>時同步降低其傷害
descriptions.Japanese: HPを消費してダメージを大幅にアップする。この効果は持続的に減衰する。<color=#49A5FFFF>「犠牲」</color>がある場合、同時に敵のダメージをダウンさせる
descriptions.Korean: HP를 소모해 공격력을 대폭 증가시키며, 해당 효과는 점차 감소한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「희생」</color> 존재 시 동시에 해당 적의 대미지가 감소한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tiêu hao HP, tăng mạnh ST của bản thân, va giảm dần. Khi tồn tại <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hy Sinh]</color> sẽ đồng thời giảm ST
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​แลก​ชีวิต​เพื่อ​เพิ่ม​ความเสียหาย​มหาศาล​ซึ่ง​จะ​ลดน้อยลง​เมื่อ​เวลา​ผ่าน​ไป​ ​หาก​มีส​ถานะ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เสียสละ</color>​อยู่​ ​ความเสียหาย​ก็​จะ​ลดลง​ใน​อัตรา​ที่​เท่ากัน
descriptions.French: Vous échangez de la vie contre une augmentation massive de vos dégâts qui diminue au fil du temps. Si un <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> est présent, ses dégâts diminuent également à la même vitesse.
descriptions.German: Du tauschst Leben gegen eine massive Erhöhung des Schadens ein, der mit der Zeit abnimmt. Wenn ein <color=#49A5FFFF>Opfer</color> vorhanden ist, verringert sich auch sein Schaden im gleichen Verhältnis.
descriptions.Russian: Вы обмениваете здоровье на значительное повышение урона, который со временем снижается. При наличии <color=#49A5FFFF>жертвы</color> ее урон снижается с той же скоростью.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu mengorbankan HP untuk peningkatan besar pada kerusakan yang berkurang seiring waktu. Jika ada <color=#49A5FFFF>Korban</color>, damage ikut berkurang dengan kecepatan yang sama.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você troca vida por um aumento enorme de dano, que diminui com o tempo. Se um <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifício</color> estiver presente, seu dano também diminui na mesma proporção.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Intercambias vida por un aumento masivo de daño que va disminuyendo con el tiempo. Si hay un <color=#49A5FFFF>sacrificio</color> presente, su daño también disminuye a la misma velocidad.

name: Warcry

names.Thai: กู่​ร้อง

description: Consume all <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> to restore life and mana for each stack, then let loose a terrifying roar that causes nearby enemies to flee in fear.

descriptions.English: Consume all <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> to restore life and mana for each stack, then let loose a terrifying roar that causes nearby enemies to flee in fear.
descriptions.Chinese: 消耗全部<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>，每层恢复生命和能量，之后怒吼震慑周围敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 消耗全部<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>，每層恢復生命和能量，之後怒吼震懾周圍敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 全ての<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を消費する、1つにつき一定のHPとマナを回復する、その後に怒鳴って敵を震え上がらせる
descriptions.Korean: 모든 <color=#49A5FFFF>"전의"</color>를 소모해 스택마다 생명력과 마나를 회복한 다음 고함을 질러 주변 적을 공포에 떨게 한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tiêu hao tất cả <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color>, mỗi tầng hồi phục HP và Năng Lượng, sau đó gào thét khiến kẻ địch xung quanh sợ hãi
descriptions.Thai: ใช้<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ทั้งหมด​ใน​การ​พื้น​ฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​และ​พลัง​เวท​สำหรับ​แต่ละครั้ง​ ​จากนั้น​ปลดปล่อย​เสียง​คำ​ราญ​น่า​หวั่นเกรง​ที่​ทำให้​ศัตรู​ใกล้เคียง​วิ่งหนี​ไป​ด้วย​ความกลัว
descriptions.French: Vous utilisez toute votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color> pour regagner de la vie et du mana à chaque instance, puis vous poussez un rugissement terrifiant qui effraie les ennemis à proximité et les fait fuir.
descriptions.German: Du verbrauchst deine gesamte <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color>, um pro Stapel Leben und Mana wiederherzustellen. Danach lässt du einen markerschütternden Kriegsschrei los, der Gegner in der Nähe vor Angst fliehen lässt.
descriptions.Russian: Вы поглощаете весь запас <color=#49A5FFFF>жажды крови</color> и восстанавливаете здоровье и ману за каждый заряд, а затем неистово рычите, заставляя противников поблизости бежать в ужасе.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menggunakan semua <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> untuk memulihkan HP dan mana untuk setiap tumpuk, lalu melepaskan raungan menakutkan yang menyebabkan musuh di sekitar lari ketakutan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Consume todo o <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color> para restaurar vida e mana para cada acúmulo. Depois, solta um rugido aterrorizante que faz com que os inimigos próximos fujam de medo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Consumes todo el <color=#49A5FFFF>Frenesí</color> para recuperar vida y maná por cada acumulación, después sueltas un rugido aterrador que provoca que los enemigos huyan.

name: Nature's Wrath

names.Thai: ธรรมชาติ​พิโรธ

description: Your attacks have a chance to inflict <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color>, and your <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> is transformed into <color=#49A5FFFF>Nature's Wrath</color>, which grants additional Poison Damage.

descriptions.English: Your attacks have a chance to inflict <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color>, and your <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> is transformed into <color=#49A5FFFF>Nature's Wrath</color>, which grants additional Poison Damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击时有概率附加<color=#7CBC45>毒素异常</color>；<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>变为<color=#49A5FFFF>「自然战意」</color>：提供额外毒素伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊時有概率附加<color=#7CBC45>毒素異常</color>；<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>變為<color=#49A5FFFF>「自然戰意」</color>：提供額外毒素傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 攻撃時確率で<color=#7CBC45>毒異常</color>を付与する。<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>が<color=#49A5FFFF>「自然の闘志」</color>に変化し、追加で毒ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 공격 시 일정 확률로 <color=#7CBC45>독 이상</color>을 부여한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「전의」</color>가 <color=#49A5FFFF>「자연의 전의」</color>로 변경된다: 추가 독 대미지를 제공한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi tấn công có xác suất kèm <color=#7CBC45>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color>; <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color> thay đổi thành <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý Tự Nhiên"</color>: Cung cấp ST Độc Tố
descriptions.Thai: การ​โจมตี​มีโอกาส​ที่จะ​ทำให้เกิด​ ​<color=#7CBC45>​อาการ​พิษ</color>​ ​และ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ ​จะ​เปลี่ยนเป็น​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​ธรรมชาติ​พิโรธ</color>​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​ทำให้​ความเสียหาย​จาก​พิษ​เพิ่มขึ้น
descriptions.French: Vos attaques ont une chance d'infliger une <color=#7CBC45>altération Poison</color>, et votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color> se transforme en <color=#49A5FFFF>Colère de la nature</color>, qui confère des dégâts toxiques supplémentaires.
descriptions.German: Deine Angriffe haben die Chance, <color=#7CBC45>Giftschwächung</color> zuzufügen, und deine <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color> wird in <color=#49A5FFFF>Zorn der Natur</color> transformiert, was zusätzlichen Giftschaden verursacht.
descriptions.Russian: Ваши атаки имеют шанс навести <color=#7CBC45>отравляющую хворь</color>, а ваша <color=#49A5FFFF>жажда крови</color> превращается в <color=#49A5FFFF>гнев природы</color>, который повышает урон от яда.
descriptions.Indonesian: Seranganmu memiliki peluang untuk menimbulkan <color=#7CBC45>Infeksi Racun</color>, dan <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> milikmu diubah menjadi <color=#49A5FFFF>Amarah Alam</color>, yang memberikan tambahan Damage Racun.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Seus ataques têm chance de infligir <color=#7CBC45>Condição Veneno</color>, e seu <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color> é transformado em <color=#49A5FFFF>Ira da Natureza</color> , que concede Dano de Veneno adicional.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tus ataques tienen una probabilidad de infligir <color=#7CBC45>alteraciones de veneno</color>, y tu <color=#49A5FFFF>frenesí</color> se transforma en <color=#49A5FFFF>ira de la naturaleza</color>, lo cual otorga daño venenoso adicional.

name: One-Man Army

names.Thai: กองทัพ​หนึ่ง​บุรุษ

description: Gain increased damage and defense when multiple enemies are near. This effect is doubled with full <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.

descriptions.English: Gain increased damage and defense when multiple enemies are near. This effect is doubled with full <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 附近有多个敌人时提升伤害与防御，<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>充盈会使效果翻倍
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 附近有多個敵人時提升傷害與防禦，<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>充盈會使效果翻倍
descriptions.Japanese: 周りに複数の敵がいる時にダメージと防御力をあげる、十分な<color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>を持つ時効果は倍になる
descriptions.Korean: 주변에 여러 적이 있으면 대미지와 방어가 증가하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>"결심"</color>이 가득 차면 효과가 두 배로 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi xung quanh có nhiều kẻ địch sẽ tăng ST và Phòng Thủ, <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quyết Tâm"</color> dồi dào sẽ giúp nhân đôi hiệu ứng
descriptions.Thai: เพิ่ม​ความเสียหาย​และ​ป้องกัน​เมื่อ​มี​ศัตรู​หลาย​ตัว​อยู่​ใกล้​ ​เอฟเฟกต์​นี้​จะ​มีผล​ทวีคูณ​เมื่อ<color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>​เต็ม​หลอด
descriptions.French: Vous gagnez un bonus de dégâts et de défense à proximité d'ennemis multiples. Cet effet est doublé si votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color> est au maximum.
descriptions.German: Dein Schaden und deine Verteidigung sind erhöht, wenn sich mehrere Gegner in deiner Nähe befinden. Wenn du über volle <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color> verfügst, wird dieser Effekt verdoppelt.
descriptions.Russian: Если рядом есть несколько врагов, вы наносите больше урона, а ваш показатель защиты улучшен. Эффект удваивается, если заполнена шкала <color=#49A5FFFF>решимости</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memperoleh damage dan pertahanan yang ditingkatkan saat dekat musuh. Efek ini digandakan saat <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> penuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Aumenta o dano e a defesa quando vários inimigos estiverem próximos. Este efeito é dobrado com a <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color> no máximo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Obtienes un aumento de ataque y defensa cuando hay varios enemigos cerca. Este efecto se duplica cuando la <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color> está al máximo.

names.Thai: พลัง​ชีวิต

name: Colossal Might

names.Thai: อำนาจ​ใหญ่​ยิ่ง

description: Embody the might of colossi to fill your <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> while simultaneously buffing nearby allies.

descriptions.English: Embody the might of colossi to fill your <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> while simultaneously buffing nearby allies.
descriptions.Chinese: 接受巨人的力量使<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>充盈，同时为周围的友军提供增益
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 接受巨人的力量使<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>充盈，同時為周圍的友軍提供增益
descriptions.Japanese: 巨人の力を受け入れて十分な<color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>を獲得、同時に周りの味方を強化する
descriptions.Korean: 거인의 힘을 받아들여 <color=#49A5FFFF>"결심"</color>을 가득 채우고, 주변 아군에 버프를 제공한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhận sức mạnh của người khổng lồ giúp <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quyết Tâm"</color> dồi dào, đồng thời tăng buff cho quân đồng đội xung quanh.
descriptions.Thai: เรียก​พลัง​ของ​โคล​อส​ซี่​มา​เติม<color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>​จน​เต็ม​หลอด​ในขณะที่​บัฟ​พันธมิตร​ใกล้เคียง
descriptions.French: En incarnant la puissance des colosses, vous remplissez votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color> tout en renforçant les alliés à proximité.
descriptions.German: Nutze die Kraft der Kolosse, um deine <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color> aufzufüllen, während gleichzeitig Verbündete in der Nähe verstärkt werden.
descriptions.Russian: Обретите силу колоссов, чтобы заполнить шкалу <color=#49A5FFFF>решимости</color> и усилить союзников поблизости.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menggunakan kekuatan colossi untuk mengisi <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> sambil terus memberi buff pada sekutu di sekitar.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Incorpora o poder dos colossos para preencher sua <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color> enquanto fortalece os aliados próximos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Encarnas el poder de los colosos para llenar tu <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color> y potenciar a los aliados cercanos al mismo tiempo.

name: Bloodcurdling Roar

names.Thai: คำราม​นองเลือด

description: You consume life and all Battlelust to expel Blood Rosin that deal Dark Damage to surrounding enemies and restore life to you. If a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> is present, your Blood Rosin can track enemies.

descriptions.English: You consume life and all Battlelust to expel Blood Rosin that deal Dark Damage to surrounding enemies and restore life to you. If a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> is present, your Blood Rosin can track enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 消耗生命值和全部战意，发射「血珀」攻击周围的敌人造成黑暗伤害并恢复生命值。存在<color=#49A5FFFF>「牺牲」</color>时「血珀」会进行追踪攻击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 消耗生命值和全部戰意，發射「血珀」攻擊周圍的敵人造成黑暗傷害並恢復生命值。存在<color=#49A5FFFF>「犧牲」</color>時「血珀」會進行追蹤攻擊
descriptions.Japanese: HPと全ての闘志を消費し、「血の琥珀」を放って近くの敵に闇ダメージを与えてHPを回復する。<color=#49A5FFFF>「犠牲」</color>がある場合、「血の琥珀」は追尾攻撃する
descriptions.Korean: HP와 모든 전의를 소모하고, 「선혈의 앰버」를 발사해 주변의 적에게 어둠 대미지를 가하고 HP를 회복한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「희생」</color> 존재 시 「선혈의 앰버」는 추적 공격을 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tiêu hao HP và toàn bộ Chiến Ý, phóng [Huyết Phách] để tấn công kẻ địch xung quanh, gây ST Hắc Ám và hồi HP. Khi tồn tại <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hy Sinh]</color>, [Huyết Phách] sẽ thực hiện đòn truy kích
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​ใช้​พลัง​ชีวิต​และ​บ้าเลือด​ทั้งหมด​เพื่อ​ขับไล่​เลือด​ขัดสน​ที่​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ความมืด​ให้​กับ​ศัตรู​ที่อยู่​รอบๆ​ ​และ​ฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​ให้​กับ​คุณ​ ​ถ้า​มีส​ถานะ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เสียสละ</color>​อยู่​ ​เลือด​ขัดสน​ของ​คุณ​จะ​สามารถ​ติดตาม​ศัตรู​ได้
descriptions.French: Vous consommez de la vie et toute Ardeur guerrière pour expulser une Humeur sanguine qui inflige des dégâts de ténèbres aux ennemis environnants et vous redonne de la vie. Si un <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> est présent, votre Humeur sanguine peut traquer les ennemis.
descriptions.German: Du verbrauchst Leben und alle Kampflust, um Blutharz auszustoßen, das den Gegnern in der Umgebung Dunkelschaden zufügt und dir Leben zurückgibt. Wenn ein <color=#49A5FFFF>Opfer</color> vorhanden ist, kann dein Blutharz Gegner verfolgen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы расходуете здоровье и всю жажду крови, чтобы извергнуть кровавую смолу, которая наносит окружающим врагам урон от тьмы и восстанавливает ваше здоровье. При наличии <color=#49A5FFFF>жертвы</color> ваша кровавая смола может отслеживать врагов.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu menyerap HP dan semua Battlelust untuk mengusir Blood Rosin yang memberikan Damage Kegelapan ke musuh di sekitar dan memulihkan HP milikmu. Jika ada <color=#49A5FFFF>Korban</color>, Blood Rosin bisa melacak musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você consome vida e todo o Desejo de Batalha para expelir a Resina de sangue que causa Dano de Escuridão aos inimigos ao redor e restauram sua vida. Se um <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifício</color> estiver presente, sua Resina de sangue pode rastrear os inimigos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Consumes vida y todo tu frenesí para expulsar colofonia sangrienta que inflige daño oscuro a los enemigos a tu alrededor y restaura tu vida. Si hay un <color=#49A5FFFF>sacrificio</color> presente, la colofonia sangrienta puede rastrear enemigos.

name: Enduring Flame

names.Thai: เพลิง​อดทน

description: Life recovers faster. Restore a small amount of life upon taking damage, with doubled effect when Pyroclad is active.

descriptions.English: Life recovers faster. Restore a small amount of life upon taking damage, with doubled effect when Pyroclad is active.
descriptions.Chinese: 生命值恢复得更快。受到伤害时恢复少量生命，展开护体火焰时效果翻倍
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 生命值恢復得更快。受到傷害時恢復少量生命，展開護體火焰時效果翻倍
descriptions.Japanese: HP回復速度上昇。ダメージを受ける時にHPを少し回復する、護身の炎を発動する時の効果が倍になる
descriptions.Korean: 생명력이 더 빨리 회복한다. 대미지를 받을 때 생명력을 소량 회복하고, 보호막 화염 발동 시 효과가 두 배로 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Hồi phục HP nhanh hơn. Khi chịu ST sẽ hồi 1 ít HP, khi kích hoạt Lửa Hộ Thể sẽ nhân đôi hiệu ứng
descriptions.Thai: พลัง​ชีวิต​ฟื้นฟู​เร็ว​ขึ้น​ ​ฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​เล็กน้อย​เมื่อ​ได้รับ​ความเสียหาย​ ​โดย​จะ​มีผล​เป็น​สองเท่า​เมื่อ​โล่​โล​กันต์​ทำงาน
descriptions.French: La vie remonte plus vite. Vous regagnez un peu de vie quand vous subissez des dégâts, deux fois plus avec Pyrocuirasse.
descriptions.German: Dein Leben regeneriert sich schneller. Ein kleiner Teil deines Lebens wird wiederhergestellt, wenn du Schaden erleidest. Dieser Effekt wird verdoppelt, wenn Feuermantel aktiv ist.
descriptions.Russian: Здоровье восстанавливается быстрее. Вы также можете восстановить часть здоровья, получив урон. Эффект удваивается, если активен «Огненный панцирь».
descriptions.Indonesian: HP pulih lebih cepat. Memulihkan sedikit HP saat terkena damage, dengan efek ganda saat Pyroclad aktif.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): A vida se recupera mais rápido. Restaura uma pequena quantidade de vida ao sofrer dano, com efeito dobrado quando Defesa Ígnea está ativa.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Recuperas vida rápido. Restauras una pequeña cantidad de vida al recibir daño y el efecto se duplica si Piroescudo está activo.

name: Mana Reaver

names.Thai: สูบ​พลัง​เวท

description: Attack surrounding targets, dealing damage twice and restoring mana.

descriptions.English: Attack surrounding targets, dealing damage twice and restoring mana.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击周围目标，造成2次伤害并恢复能量值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊周圍目標，造成2次傷害並恢復能量值
descriptions.Japanese: 周りの目標を攻撃し、ダメージを2回与えてマナを回復する
descriptions.Korean: 주변 목표를 공격하여 대미지를 2회 주고 마나를 회복한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn công mục tiêu xung quanh, gây 2 lần ST và hồi phục Năng Lượng
descriptions.Thai: โจมตี​เป้าหมาย​รอบตัว​ ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​เป็น​สองเท่า​และ​ฟื้นฟู​พลัง​เวท
descriptions.French: Vous attaquez les cibles à proximité en infligeant deux fois des dégâts et en regagnant du mana.
descriptions.German: Du greifst umstehende Gegner an. Dabei verursachst du 2-mal Schaden und stellst dein Mana wieder her.
descriptions.Russian: Вы атакуете цели вокруг, дважды нанося им урон и восстанавливая ману.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menyerang musuh di sekitar, memberikan damage dua kali dan memulihkan mana.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Ataca os alvos ao redor, causando dano duas vezes e restaurando mana.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Atacas a los objetivos circundantes, infliges el doble de daño y restauras maná.

name: War Banner
description: Erect a war banner that buffs nearby allies.

descriptions.English: Erect a war banner that buffs nearby allies.
descriptions.Chinese: 放置战旗，给周围的友军提供增益效果

name: Merciless
description: Deal additional damage to Bleeding enemies.

descriptions.English: Deal additional damage to Bleeding enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 对流血异常的敌人造成更多伤害

name: Lifespring
description: Recover life upon scoring critical hits.

descriptions.English: Recover life upon scoring critical hits.
descriptions.Chinese: 暴击获得生命值恢复

name: Lifesprig

names.Thai: ยอดอ่อน​แห่ง​ชีวิต

description: Defeated enemies drop Lifesprigs that build <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, which increases your life regen rate. When you have at least 10 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, you gain bonuses to movement, damage reduction, life regen rate as well as continuous life regen.

descriptions.English: Defeated enemies drop Lifesprigs that build <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, which increases your life regen rate. When you have at least 10 stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, you gain bonuses to movement, damage reduction, life regen rate as well as continuous life regen.
descriptions.Chinese: 击败敌人掉落生命之叶，提供<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>：提供生命恢复速度；至少拥有10层<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>时：获得移动速度、伤害减免、生命恢复速度和持续的生命恢复
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 擊敗敵人掉落生命之葉，提供<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>：提供生命恢復速度；至少擁有10層<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命能量」</color>時：獲得移動速度、傷害減免、生命恢復速度和持續的生命恢復
descriptions.Japanese: 敵を撃破すると命の葉を生み出し、<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>を獲得する。「命の力」：HP回復が早くなる。<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の力」</color>が10個以上の場合：移動速度と被ダメージ軽減とHP回復効果が上がり、HPが持続的に回復する
descriptions.Korean: 적을 처치해 드랍된 생명의 나뭇잎은 <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color>를 제공한다: 생명력 회복 속도를 제공한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명 마나」</color> 최소 10스택 보유 시: 이동 속도, 대미지 경감, 생명력 회복 속도와 지속적인 생명력 회복을 획득한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Đánh bại kẻ địch sẽ rơi ra Lá Sinh Mệnh, cung cấp <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color>: Cung cấp tốc độ phục hồi HP; Khi sở hữu ít nhất 10 tầng <color=#49A5FFFF>"Năng Lượng Sống"</color>: Nhận Tốc độ di chuyển, Giảm ST, Tốc độ hồi phục HP và hồi phục HP duy trì
descriptions.Thai: ศัตรู​ที่​ตาย​จะ​ดร​อป​ยอดอ่อน​แห่ง​ชีวิต​ที่​สร้าง​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​เพิ่ม​อัตรา​การฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​ ​เมื่อ​มี​จำนวน​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​สะสม​อย่างน้อย​ 10 ​ชั้น​ ​จะ​ได้รับ​โบนัส​การ​เคลื่อนที่​ ​การ​ลด​ความเสียหาย​ ​อัตรา​การฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​ ​และ​การฟื้นฟู​พลัง​ชีวิต​ต่อเนื่อง
descriptions.French: Les ennemis vaincus libèrent des feuillevies qui génèrent de la <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color>, ce qui augmente votre taux de regain de vie. Lorsque vous avez au moins 10 instances de <color=#49A5FFFF>force de vie</color>, vous gagnez des bonus de mouvement, de réduction de dégâts, de taux de regain de vie ainsi qu'un regain de vie continu.
descriptions.German: Besiegte Gegner lassen Lebenszweige fallen, die <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> aufbauen, was deine Lebensregenerationsrate erhöht. Wenn du mindestens 10 Stapel <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenskraft</color> hast, erhältst du Boni auf Bewegung, Schadensreduktion, Lebensregenerationsrate sowie kontinuierliche Lebensregeneration.
descriptions.Russian: Побежденные враги оставляют после себя побеги жизни, дарующие <color=#49A5FFFF>жизненную силу</color>, которая повышает скорость восстановления здоровья. Собрав 10 зарядов <color=#49A5FFFF>жизненной силы</color>, вы повысите свою дальность движения, а также начнете получать меньше урона и непрерывно восстанавливать больше здоровья.
descriptions.Indonesian: Musuh yang dikalahkan menjatuhkan Lifesprig yang membangun <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, yang meningkatkan tingkat regen HP-mu. Ketika memiliki setidaknya 10 tumpukan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifeforce</color>, dapatkan bonus pergerakan, pengurangan damage, rasio regen HP, serta regen HP berkelanjutan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Inimigos derrotados largam Lifesprigs que constroem <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color> , o que aumenta sua taxa de regeneração de vida. Quando você tiver pelo menos 10 pilhas de <color=#49A5FFFF>Força Vital</color> , pode ganhar bônus de movimento, redução de dano, taxa de regeneração de vida, bem como regeneração de vida contínua.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Los enemigos vencidos sueltan espigas de vida que componen <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color>, que aumenta la tasa de regeneración de vida. Cuando tengas al menos 10 acumulaciones de <color=#49A5FFFF>fuerza vital</color>, obtendrás bonificaciones de movimiento, reducción de daño y tasa de regeneración de vida, además de regeneración de vida continua.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Dash in front of enemies and lob a smoke bomb to damage and distract them.

descriptions.English: Dash in front of enemies and lob a smoke bomb to damage and distract them.
descriptions.Chinese: 突进到敌方面前并投掷烟雾弹攻击并干扰敌人

name: Reprisal
description: Chance to counterattack when you are hit.

descriptions.English: Chance to counterattack when you are hit.
descriptions.Chinese: 受到攻击有概率进行反击

name: Fiery Smite
description: Attack enemies with your weapon, generating multiple fireballs on hit. Locks a percentage of mana.

descriptions.English: Attack enemies with your weapon, generating multiple fireballs on hit. Locks a percentage of mana.
descriptions.Chinese: 使用武器攻击敌人，命中敌人将生成多个火球，需要占用能量值

name: Dark Maelstrom

names.Thai: ห้วง​แห่ง​ความมืด

description: Consume life to materialize a greataxe that slams into enemies in front of you, making a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> to take the Undertow in your stead, before unleashing a wide swing that deals Dark Damage. Repeated use of the skill increases both the area and damage.

descriptions.English: Consume life to materialize a greataxe that slams into enemies in front of you, making a <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color> to take the Undertow in your stead, before unleashing a wide swing that deals Dark Damage. Repeated use of the skill increases both the area and damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 消耗生命值，制造巨斧冲击前方敌人并引爆<color=#49A5FFFF>「牺牲」</color>的效果，之后进行大范围挥砍造成黑暗伤害，连续释放时范围和伤害提升
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 消耗生命值，製造巨斧衝擊前方敵人並引爆<color=#49A5FFFF>「犧牲」</color>的效果，之後進行大範圍揮砍造成黑暗傷害，連續釋放時範圍和傷害提升
descriptions.Japanese: HPを消費して斧を作り、前方の敵を攻撃して<color=#49A5FFFF>「犠牲」</color>の効果を発動する。その後、広範囲を斬り裂き闇ダメージを与える。連続発動時、攻撃範囲は広くなる
descriptions.Korean: HP를 소모하고 거대한 도끼를 생성해 전방의 적을 베고, <color=#49A5FFFF>「희생양」</color> 효과를 폭발시킨다. 이후 넓은 범위의 휘두르기를 발동해 어둠 대미지를 가한다. 연속 발동 시 범위가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tiêu hao HP, tạo ra Rìu Khổng Lồ xông vào kẻ địch phía trước và gây nổ hiệu ứng <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hy Sinh]</color>, sau đó chém trên diện rộng lớn gây ST Hắc Ám, khi thi triển liên tục, phạm vi sẽ lớn hơn
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​ใช้​พลัง​ชีวิต​เพื่อ​สร้าง​ขวาน​ยักษ์​ที่จะ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ที่อยู่​ตรงหน้า​คุณ​ ​ทำให้​เอฟเฟกต์​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​เสียสละ</color>​ ​ระเบิด​ ​จากนั้น​ปล่อย​วง​สวิง​เป็น​วงกว้าง​ซึ่ง​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ความมืด​ ​การ​ใช้​ทักษะ​ซ้ำๆ​ ​จะ​เพิ่ม​พื้นที่​การ​สวิง
descriptions.French: Vous dépensez de la vie pour faire apparaître une grande hache qui frappe les ennemis devant vous, déclenchant les effets de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifice</color>, puis qui fauche une large zone en infligeant des dégâts de ténèbres. Les utilisations successives de ce talent augmentent la zone du fauchage.
descriptions.German: Du gibst Leben aus, um eine Großaxt zu materialisieren, die auf die Gegner vor dir einschlägt und jeden <color=#49A5FFFF>Opfer</color>-Effekt sprengt, um dann einen großflächigen Schwung zu entfesseln, der Dunkelschaden verursacht. Durch wiederholtes Anwenden der Fertigkeit wird der Bereich des Axtschwungs vergrößert.
descriptions.Russian: Вы расходуете здоровье, чтобы сотворить большой топор, который врезается во врагов перед вами, взрывая все эффекты <color=#49A5FFFF>жертвы</color>, а затем поражает большую площадь, нанося урон от тьмы. Повторное применение навыка увеличивает область действия.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu menggunakan HP untuk mewujudkan greataxe yang menghantam musuh di depanmu, meledakkan setiap efek <color=#49A5FFFF>Korban</color>, lalu melakukan ayunan luas yang menghasilkan Damage Kegelapan. Menggunakan skill berulang akan meningkatkan area ayunan kapak.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você gasta vida para materializar um machado grande que acerta os inimigos à sua frente, detonando qualquer efeito de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sacrifício</color> e, em seguida, lança um golpe em grande área que causa Dano de Escuridão. O uso repetido da habilidade aumentará a área do golpe.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Gastas vida para materializar una enorme hacha que aplasta a los enemigos frente a ti, detonando todo efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>sacrificio</color>, y luego lanza un golpe de gran alcance que causa daño oscuro a tu alrededor. Si lanzas la habilidad varias veces, aumenta el alcance del golpe.

name: Toxic Bloom

names.Thai: ระเบิด​พิษ

description: Unleash a battlecry that consumes and detonates <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailments</color> on targets, sprouting <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprigs</color> in their place.

descriptions.English: Unleash a battlecry that consumes and detonates <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailments</color> on targets, sprouting <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprigs</color> in their place.
descriptions.Chinese: 发出战吼，引爆并消耗目标的<color=#7CBC45>毒素异常</color>，产生<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命之叶」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 發出戰吼，引爆並消耗目標的<color=#7CBC45>毒素異常</color>，產生<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命之葉」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 雄叫びを上げ、目標の<color=#7CBC45>毒異常</color>を起爆し、<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の葉」</color>を生み出す
descriptions.Korean: 전투의 포효를 내지르며, 목표의 <color=#7CBC45>독 이상</color>을 폭발 및 소모시키고 <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명의 나뭇잎」</color>을 생성한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Phát ra tiếng kêu xung trận, kích nổ và tiêu hao <color=#7CBC45>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color> của mục tiêu, tạo ra <color=#49A5FFFF>"Lá Sinh Mệnh"</color>
descriptions.Thai: ปล่อย​เสียงคำราม​สู้รบ​ที่​ใช้​และ​ระเบิด​ ​<color=#7CBC45>​อาการ​พิษ</color>​ ​ใส่​เป้าหมาย​ ​แตก​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​ยอดอ่อน​แห่ง​ชีวิต</color>​ ​ใน​ตำแหน่ง​ของ​พวกเขา
descriptions.French: Lancez un cri de guerre qui consume et fait exploser les <color=#7CBC45>altérations Poison</color> sur les cibles, faisant germer des <color=#49A5FFFF>feuillevies</color> à leur place.
descriptions.German: Entfessle einen Schlachtruf, der <color=#7CBC45>Giftschwächung</color> auf Zielen verbraucht und detoniert und dabei <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenszweige</color> an ihrer Stelle sprießen lässt.
descriptions.Russian: Испускает боевой клич, который насылает на врагов <color=#7CBC45>отравляющую хворь</color> и заставляет на их месте цвести <color=#49A5FFFF>побеги жизни</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Lepaskan teriakan perang yang memakan dan meledakkan <color=#7CBC45>Infeksi Racun</color> tepat di sasaran, menumbuhkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifespring</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Solte um grito de guerra que consome e detona <color=#7CBC45>Condição Veneno</color> em alvos, brotando <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprig</color> em seu lugar.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Desata un grito de batalla que consume y detona <color=#7CBC45>alteraciones de veneno</color> en los objetivos y hace surgir <color=#49A5FFFF>espigas de vida</color> en su lugar.

name: Flurry

names.Thai: กวัดแกว่ง

description: Swing your melee weapon in a rapid bout of successive blows against the enemy.

descriptions.English: Swing your melee weapon in a rapid bout of successive blows against the enemy.
descriptions.Chinese: 快速挥舞近战武器，连续打击敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 快速揮舞近戰武器，連續打擊敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 素早く近接武器を振り回して連続で敵を攻撃する
descriptions.Korean: 근접 무기를 빠르게 휘둘러 적을 연속 공격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhanh chóng vung vũ khí cận chiến và tấn công kẻ địch liên tục
descriptions.Thai: หวด​อาวุธ​ระยะ​ประชิด​อย่างรวดเร็ว​เพื่อ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ติดต่อกัน
descriptions.French: Vous assénez une salve rapide de coups successifs à l'ennemi.
descriptions.German: Du führst mit deiner Nahkampfwaffe in rasender Geschwindigkeit mehrere Angriffe gegen den Gegner aus.
descriptions.Russian: Вы быстро размахиваете мечом, нанося ряд ударов по противнику.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengayunkan senjata melee pada musuh dengan cepat.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Desfere vários golpes com sua arma corpo a corpo contra o inimigo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Blande tu arma cuerpo a cuerpo en una rápida sucesión de ataques contra el enemigo.

name: Massive Trauma
description: Inflict massive damage when you attack stunned enemies.

descriptions.English: Inflict massive damage when you attack stunned enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击眩晕单位时造成大量伤害

name: Riposte

names.Thai: แทง​กลับ

description: Your dodge capability is enhanced, and you retaliate against any dodged attack with a flung dagger.

descriptions.English: Your dodge capability is enhanced, and you retaliate against any dodged attack with a flung dagger.
descriptions.Chinese: 强化闪避能力，闪避时会投掷匕首反击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 強化閃避能力，閃避時會投擲匕首反擊
descriptions.Japanese: 回避能力を強化し、回避時に匕首を投げて反撃する
descriptions.Korean: 회피 능력을 강화해 회피 시 단검을 던져 반격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Cường hóa năng lực Né Đòn, khi né đòn sẽ ném dao găm phản đòn
descriptions.Thai: เพิ่ม​ความสามารถ​ใน​การ​หลบหลีก​ ​และ​ตอบโต้​การ​โจมตี​ที่​หลบ​ได้​ทุกครั้ง​ด้วย​มีด​ขว้าง
descriptions.French: Votre capacité d'esquive est améliorée et vous ripostez contre toute attaque esquivée en lançant une dague.
descriptions.German: Deine Ausweichfähigkeit ist verbessert und jedem Angriff, dem du ausweichst, entgegnest du mit einem Dolch-Gegenangriff.
descriptions.Russian: Вы лучше уклоняетесь от ударов. Избежав атаки, вы бросаете кинжал в ответ.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kemampuan menghindar ditingkatkan, dan membalas serangan yang dihindari dengan melemparkan belati.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Sua capacidade de esquiva é aprimorada e todo ataque evitado é seguido de um arremesso de adaga.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Mejoras tu capacidad de esquivar y devuelves cualquier ataque esquivado lanzando una daga.

name: Killer Instinct

names.Thai: สัญชาตญาณ​นัก​สังหาร

description: Crits have a chance to grant <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. Crit damage is increased for each <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> stack.

descriptions.English: Crits have a chance to grant <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. Crit damage is increased for each <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> stack.
descriptions.Chinese: 暴击有机会获得<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>。根据<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>的层数提升暴击伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 暴擊有機會獲得<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>。根據<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>的層數提升暴擊傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 会心攻撃時は一定確率で<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を獲得できる。<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>の数に応じて会心ダメージを上げる
descriptions.Korean: 치명타 발동 시 일정 확률로 <color=#49A5FFFF>"전의"</color>를 획득한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>"전의"</color> 스택 수에 따라 치명타 대미지가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Bạo kích có cơ hội nhận <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color>. Tăng ST Bạo Kích theo số tầng <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color>
descriptions.Thai: คริ​ติค​อล​มีโอกาส​ที่จะ​มอบ<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ ​ความเสียหาย​คริ​ติค​อล​เพิ่มขึ้น​เมื่อ​สะสม<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​แต่ละครั้ง
descriptions.French: Les critiques peuvent rapporter de l'<color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color>. Les dégâts critiques augmentent pour chaque instance d'<color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color>.
descriptions.German: Kritische Treffer haben eine Chance, <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color> zu gewähren. Für jeden <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color>-Stapel wird der kritische Schaden erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Критические атаки могут пополнять <color=#49A5FFFF>жажду крови</color>. Критический урон повышается за каждый заряд <color=#49A5FFFF>жажды крови</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kritikal memiliki peluang memberikan <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>. Damage Kritikal ditingkatkan untuk setiap tumpuk <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Críticos têm chance de conceder <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color>. O dano crítico é aumentado para cada acúmulo de <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tienes una probabilidad de obtener <color=#49A5FFFF>Frenesí</color> mediante golpes críticos. El daño crítico aumenta por cada acumulación de <color=#49A5FFFF>Frenesí</color>.

name: Transmute Magic
description: A percentage of your Intelligence is added to Physical Attack.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Intelligence is added to Physical Attack.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击

name: Splitting Roar
description: Send out a thunderous warcry that damages and terrifies enemies while recovering life based on the number of enemies affected.

descriptions.English: Send out a thunderous warcry that damages and terrifies enemies while recovering life based on the number of enemies affected.
descriptions.Chinese: 发出怒吼攻击敌人，根据击中的敌人数量回复生命值，并使敌人恐惧

name: Gale Flash
description: Dash forward and deal multiple consecutive slashes to frontal enemies.

descriptions.English: Dash forward and deal multiple consecutive slashes to frontal enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 突进并对敌人造成多段斩击

name: Merciless

names.Thai: ไร้​ปราณี

description: Attacking any <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleeding</color> enemy deals more damage and refreshes the effect's duration.

descriptions.English: Attacking any <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleeding</color> enemy deals more damage and refreshes the effect's duration.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击<color=#49A5FFFF>「流血」</color>的敌人会造成更多伤害，并刷新持续时间
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊<color=#49A5FFFF>「流血」</color>的敵人會造成更多傷害，並刷新持續時間
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「出血」</color>を持つ敵に攻撃するのダメージは上がる、同時に持続時間をリセットする
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>"출혈"</color> 상태의 적을 공격할 때 더 많은 대미지를 주고, 지속 시간을 리셋한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn công kẻ địch <color=#49A5FFFF>"Mất Máu"</color> sẽ gây nhiều ST hơn và làm mới thời gian duy trì
descriptions.Thai: การ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ที่<color=#49A5FFFF>​เลือด​ไหล</color>​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​มากขึ้น​และ​รี​เฟรช​ระยะเวลา​ของ​เอฟเฟกต์
descriptions.French: Attaquer un ennemi victime de <color=#49A5FFFF>Saignement</color> lui inflige plus de dégâts et réinitialise la durée de l'effet.
descriptions.German: Angriffe auf <color=#49A5FFFF>blutende</color> Gegner verursachen höheren Schaden und verlängern die Effektdauer.
descriptions.Russian: Атаки по <color=#49A5FFFF>истекающим кровью</color> противникам наносят больше урона и возобновляют действие эффекта.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menyerang musuh dengan <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleed</color> memberikan lebih banyak damage dan menyegarkan durasi efek.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Atacar qualquer inimigo sofrendo de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sangramento</color> causa mais dano e renova a duração do efeito.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Infliges más daño a enemigos bajo el efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sangrado</color> y extiendes su duración.

name: Igneous Transmutation

names.Thai: อิก​นี​อัส​ทราน​มู​เท​ชัน

description: A percentage of your Intelligence is added to Attack Power.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Intelligence is added to Attack Power.
descriptions.Chinese: 获得一定比例智力的攻击力
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 獲得一定比例智力的攻擊力
descriptions.Japanese: 知力に応じて攻撃力を上げる
descriptions.Korean: 일정 비율의 지능 만큼 공격력을 획득한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhận được Lực Công với Trí Lực nhất định
descriptions.Thai: สัดส่วน​เปอร์เซ็นต์​ของ​สติปัญญา​จะ​เพิ่ม​เป็น​พลัง​โจมตี
descriptions.French: Un certain pourcentage de votre intelligence s'ajoute à votre puissance d'attaque.
descriptions.German: Ein Teil deiner Intelligenz wird zu deiner Angriffskraft hinzugefügt.
descriptions.Russian: К вашей силе атаки добавляется часть вашего интеллекта.
descriptions.Indonesian: Persentase Intelligence milikmu ditambahkan ke Kekuatan Serangan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma porcentagem de sua Inteligência é adicionada ao Poder de Ataque.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Un porcentaje de tu inteligencia se suma a tu poder de ataque.

name: Nemesis Automail

names.Thai: กรรม​สนอง

description: Automatically counterattack enemies when taking damage.

descriptions.English: Automatically counterattack enemies when taking damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 受到伤害时，自动反击进攻的敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 受到傷害時，自動反擊進攻的敵人
descriptions.Japanese: ダメージを受けると、自動的に攻撃者に反撃する
descriptions.Korean: 대미지를 받으면 공격자에게 자동 반격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi chịu ST, tự động phản đòn kẻ địch tấn công mình
descriptions.Thai: โจมตี​ศัตรู​สวน​กลับ​โดยอัตโนมัติ​เมื่อ​ได้รับ​ความเสียหาย
descriptions.French: Contre-attaque automatiquement quand vous subissez des dégâts.
descriptions.German: Du führst automatisch einen Gegenangriff aus, wenn du Schaden erleidest.
descriptions.Russian: Получив урон, вы автоматически контратакуете врага.
descriptions.Indonesian: Secara otomatis menyerang balik musuh saat terkena damage.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Contra-ataca automaticamente os inimigos ao sofrer dano.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Contraatacas a los enemigos de manera automática al recibir daño.

name: Breath of the Wild

names.Thai: ลมหายใจ​แห่ง​ป่า

description: Invoke the forces of nature to become temporarily invulnerable and sprout <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprigs</color>; upon this effect ending, you unleash an explosion that deals increased damage based on the number of attacks you took during the effect.

descriptions.English: Invoke the forces of nature to become temporarily invulnerable and sprout <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprigs</color>; upon this effect ending, you unleash an explosion that deals increased damage based on the number of attacks you took during the effect.
descriptions.Chinese: 呼唤荒野之力，短时间变得坚不可摧并产生<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命之叶」</color>，随后引发爆炸；期间受到攻击会提升爆炸伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 呼喚荒野之力，短時間變得堅不可摧並產生<color=#49A5FFFF>「生命之葉」</color>，隨後引發爆炸；期間受到攻擊會提升爆炸傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 野性の力を呼び起こし、暫くの間金剛不壊になり、<color=#49A5FFFF>「命の葉」</color>を召喚して爆発を引き起こす。効果持続中に攻撃を受けると爆発ダメージが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 황야의 힘을 소환해 짧은 시간 바위처럼 단단해지고 <color=#49A5FFFF>「생명의 나뭇잎」</color>을 생성해 폭발을 일으킨다. 기간, 받는 공격은 폭발 대미지를 증가시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Kêu gọi sức mạnh hoang dã, trở nên không thể phá hủy trong thời gian ngắn và tạo ra <color=#49A5FFFF>"Lá Sinh Mệnh"</color>, sau đó gây nổ; Trong thời gian này, bị tấn công sẽ làm tăng ST nổ
descriptions.Thai: เรียก​พลัง​แห่งธรรม​ชาติ​ให้​กลายเป็น​อมตะ​และ​งอกงาม​ชั่วคราว​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​ชูชีพ</color>​เมื่อ​เอฟเฟกต์​นี้​สิ้นสุดลง​ ​คุณ​จะ​ปล่อย​ระเบิด​ที่​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​เพิ่มขึ้น​ตาม​จำนวน​การ​โจมตี​ที่​คุณ​ได้รับ​ระหว่าง​เอฟเฟกต์
descriptions.French: Invoquez les forces de la nature pour devenir temporairement invulnérable et faire pousser des <color=#49A5FFFF>feuillevies</color> ; une fois cet effet terminé, vous déclenchez une explosion dont les dégâts sont augmentés en fonction du nombre d'attaques que vous avez subies lors de l'effet précédent.
descriptions.German: Beschwöre die Kräfte der Natur, um vorübergehend unverwundbar zu werden und <color=#49A5FFFF>Lebenszweige</color> sprießen zu lassen. Wenn dieser Effekt endet, entfesselst du eine Explosion, die erhöhten Schaden verursacht, basierend auf der Anzahl der Angriffe, die du während des Effekts erlitten hast.
descriptions.Russian: Призовите силы природы, чтобы получить временную неуязвимость и пустить <color=#49A5FFFF>побеги жизни</color>. По окончании действия этого эффекта происходит взрыв, урон которого зависит от того, сколько раз вас атаковали во время действия эффекта.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memanggil kekuatan alam untuk menjadi kebal sementara dan menumbuhkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprig</color>. Setelah efek ini berakhir, kamu akan melepaskan ledakan yang meningkatkan damage berdasarkan jumlah serangan yang kamu terima selama menggunakan efek ini.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Invoque as forças da natureza para se tornar temporariamente invulnerável e fazer brotar <color=#49A5FFFF>Lifesprigs</color>; quando o efeito termina, você liberta uma explosão que causa dano aumentado com base no número de ataques que você recebeu durante o efeito.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Invocas a las fuerzas de la naturaleza para ser temporalmente invulnerable y brotas <color=#49A5FFFF>Espigas de vida</color>; cuando termina este efecto, desatas una explosión que causa más daño según la cantidad de ataques que recibiste durante el efecto.

name: Evasive Stance

names.Thai: ท่า​หลบ

description: Dodge all attacks for a brief time, whose duration is extended by consuming <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.

descriptions.English: Dodge all attacks for a brief time, whose duration is extended by consuming <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 短时间内闪避全部攻击，消耗<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>提升持续时间
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 短時間內閃避全部攻擊，消耗<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>提升持續時間
descriptions.Japanese: 短時間内に全ての攻撃を回避する、<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を消費すれば持続時間を上げることができる
descriptions.Korean: 짧은 시간 동안 모든 공격을 회피하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>"전의"</color>를 소모해 지속 시간을 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Né tất cả đòn tấn công trong thời gian ngắn, tiêu hao <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color> tăng thời gian duy trì
descriptions.Thai: หลบหลีก​การ​โจมตี​ทั้งหมด​เป็นเวลา​สั้นๆ​ ​ระยะเวลา​นี้​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ได้​โดย​ใช้<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>
descriptions.French: Vous esquivez toutes les attaques pendant un bref délai, prolongé en consommant votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color>.
descriptions.German: Für eine kurze Zeit weichst du allen Angriffen aus. Die Dauer des Effekts wird durch Aufbrauchen von <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color> erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы временно уклоняетесь ото всех атак. Действие навыка продлевается за счет <color=#49A5FFFF>жажды крови</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menghindari semua serangan untuk beberapa saat, durasinya diperpanjang dengan menggunakan <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Desvia de todos os ataques por um breve período, cuja duração é estendida consumindo <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Esquivas todos los ataques durante un breve período cuya duración se extiende al consumir <color=#49A5FFFF>Frenesí</color>.

name: Gale Flash

names.Thai: ลมกรด

description: Rush forward and execute a maximum of 6 slashes against the enemy.

descriptions.English: Rush forward and execute a maximum of 6 slashes against the enemy.
descriptions.Chinese: 突进并对敌人造成最多6次斩击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 突進並對敵人造成最多6次斬擊
descriptions.Japanese: 突進して敵に最大6回の斬撃を与える
descriptions.Korean: 돌진하여 적을 최대 6회 참격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn công và tối đa trảm kích 6 lần kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: พุ่ง​ไป​ข้างหน้า​และ​ฟาดฟัน​ใส่​ศัตรู​สูงสุด​ 6 ​ครั้ง
descriptions.French: Vous foncez vers l'avant et assénez jusqu'à 6 attaques de taille à l'ennemi.
descriptions.German: Du preschst vor und führst maximal 6 Hiebe gegen den Gegner durch.
descriptions.Russian: Вы бросаетесь к врагу и наносите ему до 6 ударов.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melaju ke depan dan melakukan maksimal 6 tebasan pada musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Avança e executa um máximo de 6 golpes contra o inimigo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Avanzas y ejecutas un máximo de 6 cortes contra el enemigo.

name: Stealth

names.Thai: ลักลอบ

description: Temporarily conceal your presence. You’re guaranteed to crit for massive damage on your next attack and for a short time after.

descriptions.English: Temporarily conceal your presence. You’re guaranteed to crit for massive damage on your next attack and for a short time after.
descriptions.Chinese: 暂时隐藏身形，攻击时短时间内一定会暴击造成大量伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 暫時隱藏身形，攻擊時短時間內一定會暴擊造成大量傷害
descriptions.Japanese: しばらく姿を隠し、攻撃時、しばらくの間必ず会心攻撃になって大ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 잠시 동안 몸을 숨기고, 공격 시 짧은 시간 반드시 치명타를 발동해 대량의 대미지를 가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tạm thời tàng hình, khi tấn công chắc chắn sẽ bạo kích gây nhiều ST trong thời gian ngắn
descriptions.Thai: ปกปิด​ตัวตน​ของ​คุณ​ชั่วคราว​ ​รับประกัน​ว่า​คุณ​จะ​ติด​คริ​ติค​อล​เพื่อ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​มหาศาล​ใน​การ​โจมตี​ครั้ง​ต่อไป​และ​ใน​ช่วงเวลา​สั้นๆ​ ​หลังจากนั้น
descriptions.French: Dissimule temporairement votre présence. Un coup critique infligeant de lourds dégâts est garanti lors de votre prochaine attaque, ainsi que sur un court délai ensuite.
descriptions.German: Verbirgt vorübergehend deine Anwesenheit. Du fügst bei deinem nächsten Angriff und für kurze Zeit danach garantiert einen kritischen Treffer mit massivem Schaden zu.
descriptions.Russian: Временно скрывает ваше присутствие. Вы гарантированно нанесете огромный урон при следующей атаке и в течение некоторого времени после нее.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menyembunyikan keberadaanmu untuk sementara. Kamu pasti menimbulkan damage dengan Crit yang sangat besar untuk serangan berikutnya selama sekian waktu ke depan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Oculta temporariamente sua presença. Você tem a garantia de causar dano crítico massivo em seu próximo ataque e por um curto período de tempo depois.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Oculta tu presencia temporalmente. En tu siguiente ataque y en el breve período posterior, tienes garantizado un golpe crítico de una gran cantidad de daño.

name: Mana Reaver
description: Unleash a manastealing attack on surrounding enemies.

descriptions.English: Unleash a manastealing attack on surrounding enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击周围敌人，并吸取能量值

name: Scorching Breath

names.Thai: ลมหายใจ​แผดเผา

description: Spew flames that scorch enemies and smelt their armor. The effect is more devastating when <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> are ignited.

descriptions.English: Spew flames that scorch enemies and smelt their armor. The effect is more devastating when <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> are ignited.
descriptions.Chinese: 喷吐火焰灼烧敌人，并融化敌人的盔甲。燃烧<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>会变得更加旺盛
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 噴吐火焰灼燒敵人，並融化敵人的盔甲。燃燒<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>會變得更加旺盛
descriptions.Japanese: 炎を噴き出して敵を攻撃し、敵の鎧を溶かす。<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>に火をつけると勢いを増す
descriptions.Korean: 불을 내뿜어 적을 불태우고 갑옷을 녹인다. <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>을 태우면 효과가 더욱 강해진다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Phun lửa thiêu đốt kẻ địch, làm tan chảy áo giáp của địch. <color=#49A5FFFF>"Ngọn Lửa"</color> đốt cháy sẽ trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn
descriptions.Thai: พ่น​ไฟ​ที่​เผา​ศัตรู​และ​หลอม​เกราะ​ ​เอฟเฟกต์​จะ​ยิ่ง​รุนแรง​มากขึ้น​เมื่อ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>​ติดไฟ
descriptions.French: Vous crachez des flammes qui brûlent les ennemis et font fondre leur armure. L'effet est plus dévastateur quand des <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> s'enflamment.
descriptions.German: Du spuckst Feuer, das Gegner verbrennt und ihre Rüstung schmelzen lässt. Wenn <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> entzündet wird, ist der Effekt noch verheerender.
descriptions.Russian: Вы изрыгаете языки пламени, которые обжигают врагов и плавят их доспехи. Эффект причиняет больше ущерба, если вы поджигаете <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melontarkan api yang membakar musuh dan melelehkan armor mereka. Efek lebih mematikan saat <color=#49A5FFFF>Bara</color> dinyalakan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Sopra chamas que queimam os inimigos e derretem sua armadura. O efeito é mais devastador quando <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> estão acesas.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Escupes llamas que queman a los enemigos y derriten sus armaduras. El efecto es más devastador cuando se encienden las <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color>.

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Fireblade Ward

names.Thai: วง​ล้อ​ดาบ​โล​กันต์

description: Encircle yourself with a perimeter of flaming swords that attack enemies. All <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> is consumed to increase the number of swords.

descriptions.English: Encircle yourself with a perimeter of flaming swords that attack enemies. All <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> is consumed to increase the number of swords.
descriptions.Chinese: 扔出围绕自身的火焰剑攻击敌人，转化全部<color=#49A5FFFF>「战意」</color>以提升火焰剑数量
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 扔出圍繞自身的火焰劍攻擊敵人，轉化全部<color=#49A5FFFF>「戰意」</color>以提升火焰劍數量
descriptions.Japanese: 周りに火炎の刃を召喚して敵を攻撃する、<color=#49A5FFFF>「闘志」</color>を全て消費して火炎の刃の数を増やすことができる
descriptions.Korean: 자신 주변의 화염검을 적에게 던진다. 모든 <color=#49A5FFFF>"전의"</color>를 소모해 화염검의 수량을 증가시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Ném Kiếm Lửa rực cháy xung quanh để tấn công kẻ địch, chuyển hóa toàn bộ <color=#49A5FFFF>"Chiến Ý"</color> để tăng số lượng Kiếm Lửa
descriptions.Thai: เรียก​ดาบ​เพลิง​หลาย​เล่ม​มา​หมุนรอบ​ตัว​ ​ใช้<color=#49A5FFFF>​บ้าเลือด</color>​ทั้งหมด​เพื่อ​เพิ่มจำนวน​ดาบ
descriptions.French: Vous vous entourez d'un cercle d'épées enflammées qui attaquent les ennemis. Toute votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Ardeur guerrière</color> est consommée pour augmenter le nombre d'épées.
descriptions.German: Du umgibst dich mit einem Schild von flammenden Schwertern, die Gegner angreifen. Deine gesamte <color=#49A5FFFF>Kampflust</color> wird aufgebraucht, um die Anzahl der Schwerter zu erhöhen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы окружаете себя пылающими мечами, которые атакуют противников. Весь запас <color=#49A5FFFF>жажды крови</color> поглощается, чтобы увеличить количество мечей.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengelilingi musuh dengan pedang membara yang menyerang mereka. Semua <color=#49A5FFFF>Battlelust</color> akan digunakan untuk menambah jumlah pedang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você é cercado por espadas flamejantes que atacam os inimigos. Todo o <color=#49A5FFFF>Desejo de Batalha</color> é consumido para aumentar o número de espadas.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Te encierras en un perímetro de espadas llameantes que atacan a los enemigos. Consumes todo tu <color=#49A5FFFF>Frenesí</color> para aumentar la cantidad de espadas.

name: Bounding Shield
description: Throw a shield that bounces between enemies and stuns them.

descriptions.English: Throw a shield that bounces between enemies and stuns them.
descriptions.Chinese: 投掷盾牌在敌人周围弹射，并击晕敌人

names.Thai: ย่าง​สด​ครั้ง​ใหญ่

name: Dark Commandment

names.Thai: บัญญัติ​แห่ง​ความมืด

description: Locks a percentage of life to summon <color=#ab87ca>Darkblade: Decretum</color> to assist you in combat.

descriptions.English: Locks a percentage of life to summon <color=#ab87ca>Darkblade: Decretum</color> to assist you in combat.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用生命值上限，制造<color=#ab87ca>「黑暗剑·戒律」</color>协助攻击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用生命值上限，製造<color=#ab87ca>「黑暗劍·戒律」</color>協助攻擊
descriptions.Japanese: 最大HPを消費して<color=#ab87ca>「暗黒剣・戒め」</color>を呼び出す
descriptions.Korean: 일정 HP를 차지해 <color=#ab87ca>「어둠의 검·계율」</color>을 생성해 공격을 지원한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm giới hạn HP, tạo ra <color=#ab87ca>[Kiếm Hắc Ám - Giới Luật]</color> để hỗ trợ tấn công
descriptions.Thai: ล็อก​เปอร์เซ็นต์​พลัง​ชีวิต​ที่จะ​อัญเชิญ<color=#ab87ca>​ดาบ​มืด​:​ ​ดี​ครี​ทั​ม</color>​ ​เพื่อ​ช่วยเหลือ​คุณ​ใน​การต่อสู้
descriptions.French: Verrouille un pourcentage de vie pour invoquer <color=#ab87ca>Sombrelame : Decretum</color> pour vous aider au combat.
descriptions.German: Sperrt einen Prozentsatz des Lebens, um <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelklinge: Decretum</color> zu beschwören, um dich im Kampf zu unterstützen.
descriptions.Russian: Отнимает процент здоровья, чтобы призвать <color=#ab87ca>Меч Тьмы Декретум</color>, который помогает вам в бою.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengunci persentase HP untuk memanggil <color=#ab87ca>Darkblade: Decretum</color> untuk membantumu dalam pertempuran.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Bloqueia uma porcentagem da vida para evocar <color=#ab87ca>Espada Obscura: Decretum</color> para ajudar você em combate.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Bloquea un porcentaje de vida para invocar la ayuda de <color=#ab87ca>Darkblade: Decretum</color> para el combate.

name: Pyroseismic Crash
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of fire and shatter the ground, causing a chain of explosions to erupt ahead.

descriptions.English: Imbue your weapon with the power of fire and shatter the ground, causing a chain of explosions to erupt ahead.
descriptions.Chinese: 将火焰之力注入武器攻击地面，使得前方区域发生连续爆炸

name: Beast Trap
description: Place a beast trap that immobilize enemies.

descriptions.English: Place a beast trap that immobilize enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 放置捕兽夹，限制敌人的移动

name: Glaive Throw
description: Throw multiple glaives that return to you after a time.

descriptions.English: Throw multiple glaives that return to you after a time.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放多个飞刀，飞刀会在一段时间后返回角色身上

name: Armored to the Teeth
description: A percentage of your Defense is added to Physical Attack.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Defense is added to Physical Attack.
descriptions.Chinese: 物理攻击获得一定比例的防御值加成

name: Baptism by Fire
description: Increases Fire Resistance. In addition, a percentage of Fire Resistance is added to your Fire Damage.

descriptions.English: Increases Fire Resistance. In addition, a percentage of Fire Resistance is added to your Fire Damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升火炕，火炕一定比例转换成火焰伤害

name: Jungle Jeopardy

names.Thai: ความ​อันตราย​แห่ง​ป่า

description: Toss out a seed trap that, when approached by an enemy, explodes and sprouts Chokevines that assault nearby enemies.

descriptions.English: Toss out a seed trap that, when approached by an enemy, explodes and sprouts Chokevines that assault nearby enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 投出种子陷阱，敌人靠近时种子会爆炸，并长出藤蔓袭击附近的敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 投出種子陷阱，敵人靠近時種子會爆炸，並長出藤蔓襲擊附近的敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 種をまき、敵が近づくと種は爆発し、蔓を伸ばして周囲の敵を攻撃する
descriptions.Korean: 씨앗 함정을 투척한다. 적이 접근하면 씨앗이 폭발하고, 넝쿨을 성장시켜 주변의 적을 공격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Ném bẫy hạt giống. Khi kẻ địch đến gần, hạt giống sẽ phát nổ và mọc thành dây leo để tấn công kẻ địch ở gần
descriptions.Thai: โยน​กับดัก​เมล็ดพันธุ์​ที่​เมื่อ​ศัตรู​เข้าใกล้​ ​จะ​ระเบิด​และ​งอก​เถาวัลย์​หนาม​ที่จะ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ที่อยู่​ใกล้เคียง
descriptions.French: Lance un piège à graines qui, lorsqu'un ennemi s'en approche, explose et fait surgir des strangulianes du sol, qui attaquent les ennemis proches.
descriptions.German: Stelle eine Falle auf, die, wenn ein Gegner sich nähert, explodiert und aus der Würgeranken wachsen, die Gegner in der Nähe angreifen.
descriptions.Russian: Бросьте семеномер, который при приближении противников взрывается и выпускает удушающие лозы, атакующие их.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melemparkan benuh perangkap yang ketika didekati oleh musuh akan meledak dan menumbuhkan Chokevines yang menyerang musuh di dekatnya.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Lança uma armadilha de sementes que explode quando um inimigo se aproxima e brota Chokevines, que atacam os inimigos próximos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Lanza una trampa de semilla que, cuando se acerca un enemigo, explota y brotan vides asfixiantes que atacan a los enemigos cercanos.

name: Paroxysmic Eruption

names.Thai: ระเบิด​ไฟ​โร​ซิ​มิก

description: Projectile fragments erupt forth from slain or <color=#49A5FFFF>Exsanguinated</color> enemies.

descriptions.English: Projectile fragments erupt forth from slain or <color=#49A5FFFF>Exsanguinated</color> enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 击败敌人或造成<color=#49A5FFFF>「大出血」</color>时会发射弹片
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 擊敗敵人或造成<color=#49A5FFFF>「大出血」</color>時會發射彈片
descriptions.Japanese: 敵を倒す、または<color=#49A5FFFF>「大出血」</color>を与えた時、弾丸を発射する
descriptions.Korean: 적을 처치하거나 <color=#49A5FFFF>"대출혈"</color> 부여 시 발사체 파편을 발사한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi đánh bại kẻ địch hoặc gây <color=#49A5FFFF>"Mất Máu Nhiều"</color> sẽ bắn mảnh đạn
descriptions.Thai: เศษ​ที่​กระจาย​ออกจะ​ระเบิด​การถู​ก​ฟัน​ห​รื​ศัตรู​ที่<color=#49A5FFFF>​ถูก​ถ่าย​เปลี่ยน​เลือด</color>
descriptions.French: Des éclats de projectiles sortent des ennemis vaincus ou <color=#49A5FFFF>exsangues</color>.
descriptions.German: Projektilfragmente brechen aus getöteten oder <color=#49A5FFFF>verbluteten</color> Gegnern aus.
descriptions.Russian: Из убитых или <color=#49A5FFFF>обескровленных</color> противников вырываются фрагменты снаряда.
descriptions.Indonesian: Fragmen proyekitl muncul dari musuh yang kalah atau mengalami <color=#49A5FFFF>Exsanguination</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Fragmentos de projéteis são disparados de mortos ou inimigos <color=#49A5FFFF>Exsanguinados</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Fragmentos de proyectiles erupcionan de los enemigos derrotados o bajo el efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>Hemorragia</color>.

name: Saturated Firepower
description: Chance to launch more projectiles for a short time after defeating enemies.

descriptions.English: Chance to launch more projectiles for a short time after defeating enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 击败敌人后有概率短时间内提升投射物数量

name: Astral Pulse

names.Thai: ชีพจร​ดาว

description: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you call down a transplanar strike from the astral plane that prioritizes tracking Marked enemies and deals continuous area damage.
