descriptions.English: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you call down a transplanar strike from the astral plane that prioritizes tracking Marked enemies and deals continuous area damage.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，请求来自星界的攻击，会优先追踪被标记的敌人，持续造成范围伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，請求來自星界的攻擊，會優先追蹤被標記的敵人，持續造成範圍傷害
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>闇の力</color>を利用してアストラル界の支援攻撃を要請する。優先的に照準を合わせた敵に攻撃し、持続的に範囲ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>어둠의 힘으로</color> 아스트랄계에 지원을 요청해 마크가 부여된 적을 우선적으로 추적하고 지속적으로 광역 대미지를 가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Sử dụng Sức Mạnh Hắc Ám</color>, khi yêu cầu tấn công từ Tinh Tú, ưu tiên theo dõi kẻ địch bị đánh dấu, liên tục gây ST diện rộng
descriptions.Thai: <color=#ab87ca>​ด้วย​พลัง​แห่ง​กระแสทวน</color>​ ​คุณ​เรียก​การ​โจมตี​ข้าม​ระนาบ​จาก​ระนาบ​ดวงดาว​ที่​ให้ความสำคัญ​ใน​การติ​ด​ตาม​ศัตรู​ที่​ถูก​เล็ง​เป้า​และ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ใน​พื้นที่​อย่างต่อเนื่อง
descriptions.French: <color=#ab87ca>Grâce au pouvoir du Contre-courant</color>, vous invoquez une frappe transplanaire du plan astral qui traque en priorité les ennemis marqués et leur inflige des dégâts de zone continus.
descriptions.German: <color=#ab87ca>Durch die Kraft des Sogs</color> rufst du einen transplanaren Schlag aus der Astralebene herab, der vorrangig markierte Gegner verfolgt und kontinuierlichen Flächenschaden verursacht.
descriptions.Russian: <color=#ab87ca>С помощью силы Тягуна</color> вы можете призвать из астрального мира межпланетный удар, который в первую очередь бьет по помеченным врагам и наносит непрерывный урон по области.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#ab87ca>Dengan kekuatan Undertow</color>, kamu memanggil serangan transplanar dari dunia astral, mengutamakan pelacakan musuh yang ditandai dan menghasilkan damage area secara terus menerus.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#ab87ca>Com o poder de Ressaca</color>, você evoca um ataque transplanar do plano astral que prioriza o rastreamento de inimigos Marcados e causa dano contínuo em área.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Con el poder de la corriente</color>, convocas un golpe transplanario desde el plano astral que primero rastrea a los enemigos marcados e inflige daño de área continuo.

name: Rain of Arrows: Ourea

names.Thai: ฝา​ธนู​:​ ​อู​เรีย

description: A sequence of powerful shots pounds enemies inside the target area and dazes them.

descriptions.English: A sequence of powerful shots pounds enemies inside the target area and dazes them.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域落下多个强力箭矢击晕敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 目的地區域落下多個強力箭矢擊暈敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 目標エリアに複数の強力な矢を放って敵を気絶させる
descriptions.Korean: 목표 지역에 강력한 화살을 뿌려 적을 기절시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thả nhiều mũi tên vào khu vực mục tiêu để làm choáng kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: การ​ยิง​ลูกศร​เป็น​ชุด​ที่จะ​กระแทก​ศัตรู​ภายใน​พื้นที่​เป้าหมาย​และ​ทำให้​พวก​มัน​เหม่อลอย
descriptions.French: Une salve de puissants tirs pilonne et hébète les ennemis dans la zone cible.
descriptions.German: Eine Reihe von mächtigen Schüssen regnet auf Gegner im Zielgebiet herab und betäubt sie.
descriptions.Russian: Вы обрушиваете на врагов в выбранной области череду из мощных выстрелов и оглушаете их.
descriptions.Indonesian: Runtutan tembakan kuat mengenai musuh dalam area target dan membuat mereka linglung.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma sequência de tiros poderosos atinge os inimigos dentro da área-alvo e os atordoa.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Una secuencia de flechas poderosas hostiga a los enemigos dentro del área objetivo y los confunde.

name: Landmine
description: Place landmines that explode upon enemy contact.

descriptions.English: Place landmines that explode upon enemy contact.
descriptions.Chinese: 放置地雷，触碰后发生爆炸

name: Razorward

names.Thai: จิต​สั่ง​มีด​บิน

description: Fling multiple rotating blades that attack enemies and stop momentarily at their max range before returning, causing an additional instance of damage to enemies caught.

descriptions.English: Fling multiple rotating blades that attack enemies and stop momentarily at their max range before returning, causing an additional instance of damage to enemies caught.
descriptions.Chinese: 掷出多个旋转刀片攻击敌人，短暂停留后收回再次造成伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 擲出多個旋轉刀片攻擊敵人，短暫停留後收回再次造成傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 複数の回転する刃を投げて敵を攻撃する、しばらくして回収すると再びダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 회전하는 칼날을 적에게 투척, 잠시 후 칼날을 회수해 다시 대미지를 준다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Ném nhiều lưỡi đao xoay để tấn công kẻ địch, sau khi dừng một thời gian ngắn sẽ thu hồi và gây ST lần nữa
descriptions.Thai: ปา​ดาบ​หมุน​ควง​โจมตี​ศัตรู​และ​หยุด​ชั่วครู่​ที่​ระยะ​สูงสุด​ก่อน​จะ​กลับมา​ ​ทำให้เกิด​การ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ต่อเนื่อง​ต่อ​ศัตรู​ที่​โดน​ดาบ
descriptions.French: Vous lancez plusieurs lames rotatives qui attaquent les ennemis et s'arrêtent momentanément à leur portée maximale avant de revenir, en infligeant une autre instance de dégâts aux ennemis sur leur passage.
descriptions.German: Du schleuderst mehrere wirbelnde Klingen, die Gegner angreifen, am Punkt ihrer maximalen Reichweite stoppen und dann wieder zu dir zurückfliegen, wobei sie getroffenen Gegnern ein weiteres Mal Schaden zufügen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы метаете несколько вращающихся клинков, которые атакуют противников. Достигнув максимальной дальности, клинки на мгновение останавливаются, после чего возвращаются к вам и наносят дополнительный урон задетым противникам.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melemparkan beberapa pisau berputar yang menyerang musuh dan berhenti sementara di jarak maksimal sebelum kembali, menyebabkan damage tambahan pada musuh yang terkena.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Lança várias lâminas rotativas que atacam os inimigos e param momentaneamente em seu alcance máximo antes de retornar, causando uma instância adicional de dano aos inimigos atingidos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Lanzas múltiples cuchillas giratorias que atacan a los enemigos y se detienen momentáneamente en su alcance máximo antes de regresar, lo que inflige daño adicional a los enemigos atrapados.

name: Blastwave
description: Release a blastwave that damages and knocks back enemies.

descriptions.English: Release a blastwave that damages and knocks back enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放冲击波，伤害并击退敌人

name: Closing Shadows

names.Thai: เงา​คืบคลาน

description: Performing Physical Attacks progressively increases the Extra Dark Damage you deal, and performing Dark-based attacks progressively increases your Dexterity.

descriptions.English: Performing Physical Attacks progressively increases the Extra Dark Damage you deal, and performing Dark-based attacks progressively increases your Dexterity.
descriptions.Chinese: 物理攻击会逐渐提升额外黑暗伤害，黑暗攻击会逐渐提升敏捷
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 物理攻擊會逐漸提升額外黑暗傷害，黑暗攻擊會逐漸提升敏捷
descriptions.Japanese: 物理攻撃は闇ダメージを、闇攻撃は素早さをアップする
descriptions.Korean: 물리 대미지에 부여된 추가 어둠 대미지가 점차 증가하고, 어둠 대미지는 민첩을 지속적으로 증가시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn Công Vật Lý sẽ tăng dần ST Hắc Ám bổ sung, Tấn Công Hắc Ám sẽ tăng dần Nhanh nhạy
descriptions.Thai: การ​ทำการ​โจมตี​ทางกายภาพ​จะ​ช่วย​เพิ่ม​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ความมืด​ที่​คุณ​ทำได้​อย่างต่อเนื่อง​เพิ่มเติม​ ​และ​การ​โจมตี​ด้วย​ความมืด​จะ​เพิ่ม​ความคล่อง​ตัว​ของ​คุณ​อย่างต่อเนื่อง
descriptions.French: Effectuer des attaques physiques augmente progressivement les dégâts de ténèbres supp. que vous infligez, et effectuer des attaques basées sur les ténèbres augmente progressivement votre Dextérité.
descriptions.German: Wenn du physische Angriffe ausführst, erhöht sich progressiv der zusätzliche Dunkelschaden, den du zufügst, und wenn du dunkelbasierte Angriffe ausführst, erhöht sich progressiv deine Gewandtheit.
descriptions.Russian: Физические атаки постепенно повышают дополнительный урон от тьмы, а атаки на основе тьмы постепенно повышают вашу ловкость.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melakukan Serangan Fisik sangat meningkatkan Damage Kegelapan Tambahan yang kamu berikan, dan melakukan serangan Kegelapan terus meningkatkan Dexterity milikmu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): A execução de ataques físicos aumenta progressivamente o Dano Extra de Escuridão que você causa, e a execução de ataques baseados em Escuridão aumenta progressivamente sua Destreza.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Lanzar ataques físicos incrementa progresivamente el daño oscuro adicional que causas, y lanzar daños de oscuridad incrementa progresivamente tu destreza.

name: Rain of Arrows: Maahes

names.Thai: ฝา​ธนู​:​ ​แมช​ส์

description: A volley of arrows shower the target area for a short duration.

descriptions.English: A volley of arrows shower the target area for a short duration.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域如雨一般持续落下大量箭矢
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 目的地區域如雨一般持續落下大量箭矢
descriptions.Japanese: 目標エリアに持続的に大量の矢を放つ
descriptions.Korean: 목표 지역에 비 오듯 쏟아지는 화살을 지속 발사한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thả nhiều mũi tên liên tục trút xuống khu vực mục tiêu
descriptions.Thai: ระดม​ยิง​ลูกศร​ใส่​พื้นที่​เป้าหมาย​เป็นระยะ​เวลา​สั้นๆ
descriptions.French: Une grêle de flèches s'abat sur la zone cible pendant un court instant.
descriptions.German: Das Zielgebiet wird für eine kurze Zeit von einer Pfeilsalve bedeckt.
descriptions.Russian: Некоторое время выбранную область осаждает ливень из стрел.
descriptions.Indonesian: Hujan panah di area target untuk waktu yang pendek.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma saraivada de flechas cobre a área alvo por um curto período.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Una descarga de flechas cae sobre el área objetivo durante un breve periodo de tiempo.

name: Rapid Fire

names.Thai: ยิง​เร็ว

description: Discharge a barrage of suppressive fire.

descriptions.English: Discharge a barrage of suppressive fire.
descriptions.Chinese: 使用远程武器开始攻击，打出多发子弹
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 使用遠端武器開始攻擊，打出多發子彈
descriptions.Japanese: 遠距離武器で攻撃し、複数の弾丸を撃ち出す
descriptions.Korean: 원거리 무기로 여러 발의 공격을 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Dùng vũ khí tầm xa bắt đầu tấn công, bắn ra nhiều viên đạn
descriptions.Thai: ยิงปืน​ข่ม​เป็น​ชุด​ต่อเนื่อง
descriptions.French: Libère un barrage de tirs de suppression.
descriptions.German: Du sorgst für eine Salve von Unterdrückungsfeuer.
descriptions.Russian: Вы ведете заградительный огонь на подавление.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melepaskan runtutan serangan penekan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Dispara uma barragem de fogo supressivo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Descargas una cortina de fuego represivo.

name: Death from Afar
description: Gain increased damage when no enemies are near.

descriptions.English: Gain increased damage when no enemies are near.
descriptions.Chinese: 身边没有敌人时，伤害提升

name: Dark Symphony

names.Thai: ซิมโฟนี​แห่ง​ความมืด

description: Locks a percentage of mana to summon <color=#ab87ca>Darkbow: Nocturne</color> to assist you in combat.

descriptions.English: Locks a percentage of mana to summon <color=#ab87ca>Darkbow: Nocturne</color> to assist you in combat.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用能量值上限，制造<color=#ab87ca>「黑暗弓·旋律」</color>协助攻击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用能量值上限，製造<color=#ab87ca>「黑暗弓·旋律」</color>協助攻擊
descriptions.Japanese: 最大マナを消費して<color=#ab87ca>「闇の弓・旋律」</color>を呼び出す
descriptions.Korean: 일정 마나를 차지해 <color=#ab87ca>「어둠의 궁·선율」</color>을 생성해 공격을 지원한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm giới hạn Năng Lượng, tạo ra <color=#ab87ca>[Cung Hắc Ám - Giai Điệu]</color> để hỗ trợ tấn công
descriptions.Thai: ล็อก​เปอร์เซ็นต์​ของ​พลัง​เวท​ท​เพื่อ​จะ​อัญเชิญ<color=#ab87ca>​ธนู​มืด​:​ ​น็อค​เทิร์น</color>​ ​เพื่อ​ช่วยเหลือ​คุณ​ใน​การต่อสู้
descriptions.French: Verrouille un pourcentage de mana pour invoquer <color=#ab87ca>Sombrarc : Nocturne</color> pour vous aider au combat.
descriptions.German: Sperrt einen Teil des Manas, um <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelbogen: Nocturne</color> zu beschwören und dich im Kampf zu unterstützen.
descriptions.Russian: Расходует часть запаса маны, чтобы призвать <color=#ab87ca>Лук Тьмы Ноктюрн</color>, который помогает вам в бою.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengunci persentase mana untuk memanggil <color=#ab87ca>Darkbow: Nocturne</color> untuk membantumu dalam pertempuran.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Bloqueia uma porcentagem de mana para evocar <color=#ab87ca>Golpe Obscuro: Nocturno</color> para ajudar você em combate.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Bloquea un porcentaje de maná para invocar la ayuda de <color=#ab87ca>Darkbow: Nocturne</color> para el combate.

name: Saturated Firepower

names.Thai: ยิง​สดุดี

description: Number of projectiles gradually increases as you attack, immediately reaching max if an enemy is defeated.

descriptions.English: Number of projectiles gradually increases as you attack, immediately reaching max if an enemy is defeated.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击时可能逐渐提升投射物数量，击败敌人会提升至最大值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊時可能逐漸提升投射物數量，擊敗敵人會提升至最大值
descriptions.Japanese: 攻撃時、一定の確率で飛び道具数が増えていき、敵を撃破すると最大値に達する
descriptions.Korean: 공격 시 투사체 수가 점차 증가하고, 적 처치 시 최대치까지 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi tấn công có thể tăng dần số lượng Đạn, tấn công kẻ địch sẽ tăng đến mức tối đa
descriptions.Thai: จำนวน​วิถีกระสุน​จะ​ค่อยๆ​ ​เพิ่มขึ้น​เมื่อ​คุณ​โจมตี​ ​และ​จะ​ถึง​จำนวน​สูงสุด​ทันที​หาก​ศัตรู​พ่ายแพ้
descriptions.French: Le nombre de projectiles augmente progressivement à mesure que vous attaquez, et atteint son maximum immédiatement en cas d'élimination d'un ennemi.
descriptions.German: Die Anzahl der Projektile erhöht sich allmählich, während du angreifst, und erreicht sofort das Maximum, wenn ein Gegner besiegt wird.
descriptions.Russian: Количество выстрелов постепенно увеличивается по мере атаки, сразу достигая максимума, если враг повержен.
descriptions.Indonesian: Jumlah proyektil perlahan meningkat saat kamu menyerang dan langsung mencapai jumlah maksimum jika musuh dikalahkan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): O número de projéteis aumenta gradualmente à medida que você ataca, atingindo imediatamente o máximo se um inimigo for derrotado.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): La cantidad de proyectiles aumenta gradualmente mientras atacas y llega a un máximo de inmediato si vences a un enemigo.

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Chokevine Seeds

names.Thai: เมล็ด​เถาวัลย์​พิฆาต

description: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marks</color> are transformed into <color=#49A5FFFF>Chokevine Seeds</color> that reduce their hosts' Poison Resistance and trigger the damage of any <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> on them.

descriptions.English: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marks</color> are transformed into <color=#49A5FFFF>Chokevine Seeds</color> that reduce their hosts' Poison Resistance and trigger the damage of any <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> on them.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>变为<color=#49A5FFFF>「藤蔓之种」</color>：削减毒素抗性，并触发<color=#7CBC45>毒素异常</color>的伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>變為<color=#49A5FFFF>「藤蔓之種」</color>：削減毒素抗性，並觸發<color=#7CBC45>毒素異常</color>的傷害
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>が<color=#49A5FFFF>「蔓の種」</color>に変化する。蔓の種：毒耐性を下げ、<color=#7CBC45>毒異常</color>のダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>「표식」</color>이 <color=#49A5FFFF>「넝쿨의 씨앗」</color>으로 변경된다: 독 저항을 감소시키고 <color=#7CBC45>독 이상</color> 대미지를 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#49A5FFFF>"Đánh Dấu"</color> thay đổi thành <color=#49A5FFFF>"Hạt Giống Dây Leo"</color>: Giảm Kháng Độc Tố và kích hoạt ST của <color=#7CBC45>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color>
descriptions.Thai: <color=#49A5FFFF>​เล็ง​เป้า</color>​ ​จะ​ถูก​เปลี่ยนเป็น​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​เมล็ด​เถาวัลย์​พิฆาต</color>​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​ลด​ความต้านทาน​พิษ​และ​กระตุ้น​ความเสียหาย​ของ​ ​<color=#7CBC45>​อาการ​พิษ</color>​ ​ใดๆ​บน​ตัว​ของ​โฮสต์
descriptions.French: Des <color=#49A5FFFF>marqueurs</color> se transforment en <color=#49A5FFFF>graines de stranguliane</color> qui réduisent la résistance au poison de leurs hôtes et déclenchent les dégâts de toute <color=#7CBC45>altération Poison</color> sur eux.
descriptions.German: <color=#49A5FFFF>Markierungen</color> werden in <color=#49A5FFFF>Würgerankensamen</color> umgewandelt, die die Giftresistenz ihrer Wirte verringern und den Schaden jeder <color=#7CBC45>Giftschwächung</color> auf ihnen auslösen.
descriptions.Russian: <color=#49A5FFFF>Метки</color> на врагах превращаются в <color=#49A5FFFF>семена удушающей лозы</color>, которые снижают их сопротивление яду и активируют <color=#7CBC45>отравляющую хворь</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#49A5FFFF>Tanda</color> diubah menjadi <color=#49A5FFFF>Benih Chokevine</color> yang mengurangi Daya Tahan Racun inangnya dan memicu damage dari <color=#7CBC45>Infeksi Racun</color> mana saja pada mereka.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcações</color> são transformadas em <color=#49A5FFFF>Sementes de Chokevine</color> que reduzem a Resistência a Veneno de seus hospedeiros e desencadeiam o dano de qualquer <color=#7CBC45>Condição Veneno</color> sobre eles.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Las <color=#49A5FFFF>marcas</color> se transforman en <color=#49A5FFFF>semillas de vid asfixiante</color> que reducen la resistencia al veneno del anfitrión y detonan el daño de cualquier <color=#7CBC45>acumulación de veneno</color> que tenga.

name: Huntdown

names.Thai: ไล่​ล่า

description: Deal more damage to enemies with lower health, and have a higher crit chance against enemies whose health have been reduced to a certain percentage.

descriptions.English: Deal more damage to enemies with lower health, and have a higher crit chance against enemies whose health have been reduced to a certain percentage.
descriptions.Chinese: 对生命值越低的敌人，造成的伤害越高；对生命值低于一定幅度的敌人有更高的概率暴击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 對生命值越低的敵人，造成的傷害越高；對生命值低於一定幅度的敵人有更高的概率暴擊
descriptions.Japanese: 敵のHPが低いほどダメージが上がる。敵のHPが一定値を下回ると会心率が上がる
descriptions.Korean: HP가 낮은 적에게 더 많은 대미지를 가한다. HP가 일정 수치보다 낮은 적에게 더 높은 확률로 치명타를 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Kẻ địch có HP càng thấp thì ST gây ra càng cao; kẻ địch có HP thấp hơn một mức nhất định có xác suất bạo kích cao hơn
descriptions.Thai: สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​แก่​ศัตรู​ที่​มีพลัง​ชีวิต​ต่ำ​ ​และ​มีโอกาส​คริ​ติค​อล​ต่อ​ศัตรู​ที่​พลัง​ชีวิต​ลดลง​จนถึง​ระดับ​หนึ่ง​สูง​ขึ้น
descriptions.French: Infligez plus de dégâts aux ennemis dont la santé est inférieure et augmentez vos chances de critique contre les ennemis dont la santé a été réduite à un certain pourcentage.
descriptions.German: Füge Gegnern mit geringerer Gesundheit mehr Schaden zu und erziele eine höhere Krit.-Chance gegen Gegner, deren Gesundheit auf einen bestimmten Prozentsatz reduziert wurde.
descriptions.Russian: Наносит больше урона врагам с небольшим уровнем здоровья и повышает вероятность критического удара по врагам, чей запас здоровья упал до определенной отметки.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menimbulkan lebih banyak damage pada musuh dengan HP lebih rendah, dan mempunyai peluang kritikal lebih tinggi terhadap musuh yang HP-nya telah berkurang hingga persentase tertentu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Causa mais dano a inimigos com menos saúde e tem maior chance de crít. contra inimigos cuja saúde foi reduzida a uma certa porcentagem.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Inflige más daño a los enemigos con menos salud y obtén más probabilidad de golpe crítico contra los enemigos con cierto porcentaje de salud.

name: Adhesive Gunpowder
description: Attacking a non-burning enemy adheres gunpowder to them that reacts with any further Burn status to create a violent explosion.

descriptions.English: Attacking a non-burning enemy adheres gunpowder to them that reacts with any further Burn status to create a violent explosion.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击未附加火焰异常的敌人时，附着一层火药，对附着火药的敌人附加火焰异常时会发生爆炸

names.Thai: กับดัก​บา​ลิส​ต้า

name: Blazing Alacrity

names.Thai: เพลิง​ผลาญ

description: A percentage of your Dexterity is added to your Magic Power, and all Fire Damage has an increased chance to crit.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Dexterity is added to your Magic Power, and all Fire Damage has an increased chance to crit.
descriptions.Chinese: 获得一定比例敏捷的法术强度加成，火焰伤害的暴击率提升
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 獲得一定比例敏捷的法術強度加成，火焰傷害的暴擊率提升
descriptions.Japanese: 素早さに応じて魔法攻撃力を上げ、炎ダメージの会心率を上げる
descriptions.Korean: 일정 비율의 민첩 만큼 마법 강도 보너스를 획득하고, 화염 대미지의 치명타율이 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhận được bonus Cường Độ Phép Thuật với tỷ lệ Nhanh Nhạy nhất định, tăng tỷ lệ Bạo Kích của ST Lửa
descriptions.Thai: สัดส่วน​เปอร์เซ็นต์​ของ​ความคล่อง​ตัว​จะ​เพิ่ม​เป็น​พลัง​เวทมนตร์​ ​และ​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ไฟ​ทั้งหมด​มีโอกาส​คริ​ติค​อล​มากขึ้น
descriptions.French: Un certain pourcentage de votre dextérité est ajouté à votre puissance magique et tous les dégâts de feu ont plus de chances d'infliger des critiques.
descriptions.German: Ein Teil deiner Gewandtheit wird zu deiner Magiekraft hinzugefügt und für jeden Feuerschaden gilt eine erhöhte Chance auf einen kritischen Treffer.
descriptions.Russian: Процент от вашей ловкости прибавляется к силе магии, а весь урон от огня имеет повышенную вероятность стать критическим.
descriptions.Indonesian: Persentase Dexterity ditambahkan ke Kekuatan Sihir, dan semua Damage Api memiliki peluang kritikal yang ditingkatkan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma porcentagem de sua Destreza é adicionada ao seu Poder Mágico, e todo Dano de Fogo tem uma chance maior de crítico.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Un porcentaje de tu destreza se suma a tu poder mágico y el daño ígneo tiene una mayor probabilidad de infligir daño crítico.

name: Adhesive Gunpowder

names.Thai: ดินปืน​ติด​กาว

description: For a time, your normal attacks are steeped in gunpowder, causing multiple explosions upon impacting enemies.

descriptions.English: For a time, your normal attacks are steeped in gunpowder, causing multiple explosions upon impacting enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 一段时间内，普通攻击会使敌人沾染火药持续发生爆炸
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 一段時間內，普通攻擊會使敵人沾染火藥持續發生爆炸
descriptions.Japanese: 一定時間内、通常攻撃は敵に火薬を塗り付けて持続的に爆発を引き起こす
descriptions.Korean: 일정 시간 동안 일반 공격 시 적을 화약으로 물들여 지속적인 폭발을 일으킨다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Trong một khoảng thời gian, tấn công thường sẽ khiến kẻ địch nhiễm phải thuốc nổ và liên tục phát nổ
descriptions.Thai: ชั่วขณะหนึ่ง​ ​การ​โจมตี​ธรรมดา​จะ​อาบ​ด้วย​ดินปืน​ ​ทำให้เกิด​การระเบิด​หลายครั้ง​เมื่อ​กระทบ​กับ​ศัตรู
descriptions.French: Pendant un certain temps, vos attaques normales sont imprégnées de poudre à canon qui provoque plusieurs explosions en touchant les ennemis.
descriptions.German: Für eine gewisse Zeit sind deine normalen Angriffe mit Schwarzpulver verstärkt, wodurch es bei Treffern zu mehreren Explosionen kommt.
descriptions.Russian: Некоторое время вы используете порох при обычных атаках, вызывая тем самым множественные взрывы при ударе по врагу.
descriptions.Indonesian: Untuk beberapa saat, serangan normalmu dilengkapi dengan mesiu, menyebabkan ledakan kecil saat mengenai musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Por um tempo, seus ataques normais são embebidos em pólvora, causando múltiplas explosões ao atingir os inimigos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Durante un tiempo, tus ataques normales están impregnados de pólvora, lo que provoca múltiples explosiones al impactar contra los enemigos.

name: Rain of Arrows: Geddon
description: A volley of fire arrows showers the target area for a short duration.

descriptions.English: A volley of fire arrows showers the target area for a short duration.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域如雨一般持续落下大量火焰箭矢

name: Explosive Arrow
description: Fire an explosive-tipped arrow that detonates on target impact.

descriptions.English: Fire an explosive-tipped arrow that detonates on target impact.
descriptions.Chinese: 射出绑有炸药的箭矢，在命中敌人后爆炸

name: Armored to the Teeth

names.Thai: พลัง​เกราะ

description: A percentage of your Defense is added to Physical Attack.

descriptions.English: A percentage of your Defense is added to Physical Attack.
descriptions.Chinese: 获得一定比例防御值的攻击力
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 獲得一定比例防禦值的攻擊力
descriptions.Japanese: 防御力に応じて攻撃力を上げる
descriptions.Korean: 일정 비율의 방어력 만큼 공격력을 획득한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhận được Lực Công với Phòng Thủ nhất định
descriptions.Thai: สัดส่วน​เปอร์เซ็นต์​ของ​การป้องกัน​จะ​เพิ่ม​เป็นการ​โจมตี​ทางกายภาพ
descriptions.French: Un certain pourcentage de votre défense est ajouté à votre attaque physique.
descriptions.German: Ein Teil deiner Verteidigung wird zu deinem Physischen Angriff hinzugefügt.
descriptions.Russian: Процент от вашего показателя защиты прибавляется к физической атаке.
descriptions.Indonesian: Persentase Pertahanan milikmu ditambahkan ke Serangan Fisik.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma porcentagem de sua Defesa é adicionada ao Ataque Físico.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Un porcentaje de tu defensa se suma a tu ataque físico.

name: Savaging Shot

names.Thai: ธนู​ป่าเถื่อน

description: Deliver a close-range shot that pierces enemies and consumes <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> to deal greatly increased damage for each stack consumed.

descriptions.English: Deliver a close-range shot that pierces enemies and consumes <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> to deal greatly increased damage for each stack consumed.
descriptions.Chinese: 发射一次近战射击，弹丸可以穿透敌人，可消耗<color=#7CBC45>毒素异常</color>，每层消耗都会大幅提升伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 發射一次近戰射擊，彈丸可以穿透敵人，可消耗<color=#7CBC45>毒素異常</color>，每層消耗都會大幅提升傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 近距離射撃し、弾丸は敵を貫通する。<color=#7CBC45>毒異常</color>を一つ消費するごとにダメージが大幅にアップする
descriptions.Korean: 근접 사격을 1회 진행한다. 탄환은 적을 관통할 수 있으며, <color=#7CBC45>독 이상</color>을 소모해 스택마다 대미지가 대폭 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Bắn 1 lần cận chiến, đạn có thể xuyên qua kẻ địch, có thể tiêu hao <color=#7CBC45>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color>, mỗi tầng tiêu hao đều sẽ tăng đáng kể ST
descriptions.Thai: ยิง​ธนู​ระยะใกล้​ที่​เจาะ​ทะลุ​ศัตรู​และ​ใช้<color=#7CBC45>​อาการ​พิษ</color>​ ​เพื่อ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ที่จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​อย่างมาก​ตาม​จำนวน​ชั้น​สะสม
descriptions.French: Vous effectuez un tir à courte portée qui transperce les ennemis et consomme de l’<color=#7CBC45>altération Poison</color> pour infliger des dégâts considérablement accrus pour chaque instance consommée.
descriptions.German: Führe einen Schuss aus nächster Nähe aus, der Gegner durchdringt und <color=#7CBC45>Giftschwächung</color> verbraucht, um für jeden verbrauchten Stapel deutlich erhöhten Schaden zu verursachen.
descriptions.Russian: Совершите выстрел с близкого расстояния, пронзающий врагов и поглощающий <color=#7CBC45>отравляющую хворь</color>. Наносимый урон повышается с каждым поглощенным зарядом.
descriptions.Indonesian: Berikan tembakan jarak dekat yang menembus musuh dan menggunakan <color=#7CBC45>Infeksi Racun</color> untuk memberikan damage yang sangat meningkat untuk setiap tumpukan yang dikonsumsi.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Dá um tiro de curta distância que perfura os inimigos e consome a <color=#7CBC45>Condição Veneno</color> para causar dano muito maior por cada pilha consumida.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Realiza un disparo a corta distancia que atraviesa a los enemigos y consume <color=#7CBC45>alteración de veneno</color> para infligir daño aumentado por cada acumulación consumida.

name: Pyrostigma

names.Thai: ไฟ​โรส​ติก​มา

description: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marks</color> on enemies reduce their Fire Resistance. <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlocked</color> enemies will suffer from explosions when <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> spawn on them.

descriptions.English: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marks</color> on enemies reduce their Fire Resistance. <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlocked</color> enemies will suffer from explosions when <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> spawn on them.
descriptions.Chinese: 强化<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>削减火焰抗性。完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>时发生爆炸并视作<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 強化<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>削減火焰抗性。完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>時發生爆炸並視作<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>を強化して炎耐性を下げる。完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>時は爆発して<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>と見なす
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>"마크"</color>를 강화해 화염 저항을 약화시키고, 완전 <color=#49A5FFFF>"마크"</color> 시 폭발을 일으키고 <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>으로 간주된다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Cường hóa <color=#49A5FFFF>"Đánh Dấu"</color> để giảm Kháng Lửa. <color=#49A5FFFF>"Đánh Dấu"</color> khi hoàn thành sẽ phát nổ và được xem như <color=#49A5FFFF>"Mồi Lửa"</color>
descriptions.Thai: ศัตรู​ที่​ถูก<color=#49A5FFFF>​เล็ง​เป้า</color>​จะ​มี​ความต้านทาน​ไฟ​ลดลง​ ​ศัตรู​ที่​ถูก<color=#49A5FFFF>​ล็อก​ตาย</color>​จะ​โดน​ระเบิด​เมื่อ​ได้รับ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>
descriptions.French: Les <color=#49A5FFFF>Marqueurs</color> sur les ennemis réduisent leur résistance au feu. Les ennemis <color=#49A5FFFF>fixés</color> explosent lorsque des <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> apparaissent sur eux.
descriptions.German: <color=#49A5FFFF>Markierungen</color> auf Gegnern verringern ihre Feuerresistenz. <color=#49A5FFFF>Vollmarkierte</color> Gegner leiden unter Explosionen, wenn bei ihnen <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> entsteht.
descriptions.Russian: <color=#49A5FFFF>Метки</color> на врагах снижают их сопротивление огню. <color=#49A5FFFF>Скованные</color> враги будут страдать от взрывов, когда на них появляются <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#49A5FFFF>Tanda</color> pada musuh mengurangi Daya Tahan Api mereka. Musuh yang terkena <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlock</color> akan menerima damage dari ledakan saat <color=#49A5FFFF>Ember</color> muncul mengenainya.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcas</color> nos inimigos reduzem a Resistência ao Fogo. Inimigos com <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcação Máxima</color> sofrerão com explosões quando <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> surjam neles.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Las <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcas</color> en los enemigos reducen su resistencia al fuego. Los enemigos bajo el efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>Vestigio</color> explotarán cuando se generen <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color> sobre ellos.

name: Rain of Arrows: Ourea
description: A sequence of powerful shots pounds enemies inside the target area and stuns them.

descriptions.English: A sequence of powerful shots pounds enemies inside the target area and stuns them.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域落下多个强力箭矢击晕目标

name: Rain of Arrows: Maahes
description: A volley of arrows shower the target area for a short duration.

descriptions.English: A volley of arrows shower the target area for a short duration.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域如雨一般持续落下大量箭矢

names.Thai: เล็ง​เป้า​เสริม​พลัง

name: Rain of Arrows: Geddon

names.Thai: ฝา​ธนู​:​ ​เก็ด​ดอน

description: A calamitous downpour of flaming arrows ravages the target area with a chance to <color=#49A5FFFF>Mark</color> targets.

descriptions.English: A calamitous downpour of flaming arrows ravages the target area with a chance to <color=#49A5FFFF>Mark</color> targets.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标区域如雨一般持续落下大量火焰箭矢，概率对目标造成<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 目的地區域如雨一般持續落下大量火焰箭矢，概率對目標造成<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 目標エリアに持続的に大量の炎の矢を放つ、確率で目標に<color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>を付与する
descriptions.Korean: 목표 지역에 비 오듯 쏟아지는 화염 화살을 지속 발사하여, 일정 확률로 대상에게 <color=#49A5FFFF>"마크"</color>를 부여한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thả nhiều mũi tên lửa liên tục trút xuống khu vực mục tiêu, có xác suất gây <color=#49A5FFFF>"Đánh Dấu"</color> lên mục tiêu
descriptions.Thai: ระดม​ยิง​ฝูง​ลูกศร​เพลิง​ทำลายล้าง​พื้นที่​เป้าหมาย​ ​โดย​มีโอกาส<color=#49A5FFFF>​เล็ง​เป้า</color>​เป้าหมาย
descriptions.French: Une averse apocalyptique de flèches enflammées ravage la zone et peut <color=#49A5FFFF>marquer</color> les cibles.
descriptions.German: Ein vernichtender Feuerpfeilregen verwüstet das Zielgebiet und hat eine Chance, Ziele zu <color=#49A5FFFF>markieren</color>.
descriptions.Russian: Жуткий ливень из горящих стрел поражает область и может <color=#49A5FFFF>отметить</color> цели.
descriptions.Indonesian: Hujan panah api yang menyerang area target dengan peluang untuk memberi <color=#49A5FFFF>Tanda</color> pada musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Uma chuva calamitosa de flechas flamejantes devasta a área alvo com chance de <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcar</color> os alvos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Una devastadora lluvia de flechas incendiarias arrasa el área objetivo con una probabilidad de infligir <color=#49A5FFFF>Marca</color> a los objetivos.

name: Omnicombustion

names.Thai: ระเบิด​สารพัน

description: Gunpowder explosions and <color=#49A5FFFF>Fire Ailments</color> tick faster. In addition, <color=#49A5FFFF>Fire Ailment</color> damage restores life to you.

descriptions.English: Gunpowder explosions and <color=#49A5FFFF>Fire Ailments</color> tick faster. In addition, <color=#49A5FFFF>Fire Ailment</color> damage restores life to you.
descriptions.Chinese: 降低火药爆炸与<color=#49A5FFFF>火焰异常</color>造成伤害的间隔。<color=#49A5FFFF>火焰异常</color>伤害还会恢复生命
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 降低火藥爆炸與<color=#49A5FFFF>火焰異常</color>造成傷害的間隔。<color=#49A5FFFF>火焰異常</color>傷害還會恢復生命
descriptions.Japanese: 火薬爆発と<color=#49A5FFFF>炎異常</color>のダメージ間隔を減少する。<color=#49A5FFFF>炎異常</color>ダメージを与える時、HPを回復する
descriptions.Korean: 화약 폭발 및 <color=#49A5FFFF>화염 이상</color>이 가하는 대미지 간격이 감소한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>화염 이상</color> 대미지가 HP를 회복시킬 수 있다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Giảm giãn cách giữa Nổ Thuốc Nổ và ST do <color=#49A5FFFF>Ngọn Lửa Bất Thường</color> gây ra. ST <color=#49A5FFFF>Ngọn Lửa Bất Thường</color> sẽ hồi HP
descriptions.Thai: การระเบิด​ของ​ดินปืน​และ​เกิด<color=#49A5FFFF>​อาการ​ติดไฟ</color>​ติ๊ก​เร็ว​ขึ้น​ ​นอกจากนี้​ความเสียหาย​จาก<color=#49A5FFFF>​อาการ​ติดไฟ</color>​จะ​ฟื้น​คืน​ชีวิต​ให้​กับ​คุณ
descriptions.French: Les explosions de poudre à canon et les <color=#49A5FFFF>altérations Feu</color> infligent des dégâts plus souvent. De plus, les dégâts infligés par une <color=#49A5FFFF>altération Feu</color> vous rendent de la vie.
descriptions.German: Schwarzpulver-Explosionen und <color=#49A5FFFF>Feuerschwächung</color> haben kürzere Intervalle. Außerdem wird durch <color=#49A5FFFF>Feuerschwächung</color> bei dir Leben wiederhergestellt.
descriptions.Russian: Пороховые взрывы и <color=#49A5FFFF>сжигающие хвори</color> наносят урон быстрее. Кроме того, урон от <color=#49A5FFFF>сжигающей хвори</color> восстанавливает ваше здоровье.
descriptions.Indonesian: Ledakan mesiu dan <color=#49A5FFFF>Infeksi Api</color> berdetak lebih cepat. Selain itu, damage <color=#49A5FFFF>Infeksi Api</color> memulihkan HP-mu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): As explosões de Pólvora e a <color=#49A5FFFF>Condição Fogo</color> contam com maior velocidade. Além disso, o dano de <color=#49A5FFFF>Condição Fogo</color> restaura vida para você.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Las explosiones de pólvora y las <color=#49A5FFFF>Alteraciones de fuego</color> se activan con más frecuencia. Además, el daño de la <color=#49A5FFFF>Alteración de fuego</color> regenera tu vida.

name: Rain of Arrows: Syl

names.Thai: ฝน​ธนู​:​ ​ซิล

description: Continuously fire volleys of arrows in random directions, dealing damage and <color=#49A5FFFF>Marking</color> enemies. The skill's damage is increased for each stack of <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> on struck enemies.

descriptions.English: Continuously fire volleys of arrows in random directions, dealing damage and <color=#49A5FFFF>Marking</color> enemies. The skill's damage is increased for each stack of <color=#7CBC45>Poison Ailment</color> on struck enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 持续向随机方向发射大量箭矢，造成伤害并施加<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>，每层<color=#7CBC45>毒素异常</color>都会提升伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 持續向隨機方向發射大量箭矢，造成傷害並施加<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>，每層<color=#7CBC45>毒素異常</color>都會提升傷害
descriptions.Japanese: ランダム方向に複数の矢を放ち続け、ダメージを与えて<color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>を付与する。<color=#7CBC45>毒異常</color>があるとダメージが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 지속적으로 랜덤 방향을 향해 대량의 화살을 발사해 대미지를 가하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>「표식」</color>을 부여한다. <color=#7CBC45>독 이상</color> 스택당 대미지가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Bắn liên tục lượng lớn mũi tên theo các hướng ngẫu nhiên, gây ST và kèm thêm <color=#49A5FFFF>"Đánh Dấu"</color>, mỗi tầng <color=#7CBC45>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color> đều sẽ tăng ST
descriptions.Thai: ยิง​ธนู​ออก​ไป​อย่างต่อเนื่อง​แบบ​สุ่ม​ทิศทาง​ ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​และ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​เล็ง​เป้า</color>​ ​ศัตรู​ ​ความเสียหาย​ของ​ทักษะ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ตาม​จำนวน​สะสม​ของ​ ​<color=#7CBC45>​อาการ​พิษ</color>​ ​แต่ละ​ชั้นบน​ตัว​ของ​ศัตรู​ที่​โดน​โจมตี
descriptions.French: Tirez continuellement des volées de flèches dans des directions aléatoires, infligeant des dégâts et <color=#49A5FFFF>marquant</color> les ennemis. Les dégâts de la compétence sont augmentés pour chaque instance d'<color=#7CBC45>altération Poison</color> sur les ennemis touchés.
descriptions.German: Feuere kontinuierlich Pfeilsalven in zufällige Richtungen ab, die Schaden verursachen und Gegner mit <color=#49A5FFFF>Markierungen</color> versehen. Der Schaden der Fertigkeit wird mit jedem Stapel <color=#7CBC45>Giftschwächung</color> auf getroffenen Gegnern erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Непрерывно обрушивайте шквалы из стрел в случайных направлениях, нанося урон и <color=#49A5FFFF>отмечая</color> врагов. Урон от навыка повышается с каждым зарядом <color=#7CBC45>отравляющей хвори</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menembakkan anak panah secara terus menerus ke arah acak, menimbulkan damage dan <color=#49A5FFFF>Menandai</color> musuh. Damage skill meningkat untuk setiap tumpukan <color=#7CBC45>Infeksi Racun</color> pada musuh yang diserang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Dispara de maneira contínua saraivadas de flechas em direções aleatórias, causando dano e <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcação</color> aos inimigos. O dano da habilidade aumenta por cada pilha de <color=#7CBC45>Condição Veneno</color> em inimigos atingidos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Dispara salvas de flechas en direcciones aleatorias para infligir daño y <color=#49A5FFFF>marcar</color> a los enemigos. El daño de la habilidad aumenta por cada acumulación de <color=#7CBC45>alteración de veneno</color> en los enemigos afectados.

names.Thai: กับดัก​บา​ลิส​ต้า

name: Rebuke

names.Thai: ประ​นาม

description: Block all incoming damage and knock back surrounding enemies, dazing them when they collide with objects. The skill is released automatically when <color=#49A5FFFF> Human Bunker </color> is activated.

descriptions.English: Block all incoming damage and knock back surrounding enemies, dazing them when they collide with objects. The skill is released automatically when <color=#49A5FFFF> Human Bunker </color> is activated.
descriptions.Chinese: 格挡伤害并击退周围敌人，造成碰撞时还会晕眩，使用<color=#49A5FFFF> 固定炮台 </color>时自动释放该技能
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 格擋傷害並擊退周圍敵人，造成碰撞時還會暈眩，使用<color=#49A5FFFF> 固定炮臺 </color>時自動釋放該技能
descriptions.Japanese: ダメージをブロックして周りの敵を吹き飛ばし、ぶつかる時敵を気絶させる、<color=#49A5FFFF>固定砲台</color>を使用時に自動的にこのスキルを使う
descriptions.Korean: 대미지를 블록하고 주변 적들을 넉백시킨다. 충돌을 일으킬 때 기절을 부여한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>고정 포탑</color> 사용 시 해당 스킬을 자동 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Cản đòn ST và đẩy lùi kẻ địch xung quanh, khi va chạm sẽ gây choáng, dùng <color=#49A5FFFF>Pháo Đài Cố Định</color> sẽ tự động thi triển kỹ năng này.
descriptions.Thai: สกัดกั้น​ความเสียหาย​ที่​เข้ามา​ทั้งหมด​และ​กระแทก​ศัตรู​รอบตัว​กลับ​ถอยหลัง​ ​ทำให้​พวก​มัน​เหม่อลอย​เมื่อ​ชน​กับ​วัตถุ​ ​ทักษะ​จะ​ปลดปล่อย​โดยอัตโนมัติ​เมื่อ<color=#49A5FFFF>​บัง​เกอร์​มนุษย์</color>​ทำงาน
descriptions.French: Bloque tous les dégâts qui vous sont destinés et repousse les ennemis à proximité. Ceux qui percutent un objet sont hébétés. Ce talent se déclenche automatiquement quand <color=#49A5FFFF>Bunker humain</color> est activé.
descriptions.German: Jeder eingehende Schaden wird geblockt und umstehende Gegner werden zurückgestoßen, wobei sie betäubt werden, wenn sie auf Objekte stoßen. Diese Fertigkeit wird automatisch ausgelöst, wenn <color=#49A5FFFF>Menschlicher Bunker</color> aktiviert ist.
descriptions.Russian: Вы блокируете весь урон и отбрасываете окружающих противников. Если отброшенный противник врежется в объект, то будет оглушен. Навык активируется автоматически при активации <color=#49A5FFFF>«Живого бункера»</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menahan semua damage yang datang dan memukul mundur musuh di sekitar, membuat mereka linglung saat membentur objek. Skill ini dilepaskan otomatis saat <color=#49A5FFFF> Human Bunker </color> diaktifkan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Bloqueia todo dano sofrido e empurra os inimigos ao redor, atordoando-os quando colidirem com objetos. A habilidade é liberada automaticamente quando <color=#49A5FFFF> Bunker Humano </color> está ativado.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Bloqueas todo el daño entrante y haces retroceder a los enemigos circundantes, lo que provoca que se confundan al chocar contra objetos. Esta habilidad se lanza automáticamente cuando se activa <color=#49A5FFFF>Búnker humano</color>.

name: Flammable Flask
description: Toss a flammable concoction that ignites the target area.

descriptions.English: Toss a flammable concoction that ignites the target area.
descriptions.Chinese: 投掷火焰瓶，燃烧目标区域

name: Death from Afar

names.Thai: สังหาร​ทางไกล

description: Damage is increased when no enemies are close.

descriptions.English: Damage is increased when no enemies are close.
descriptions.Chinese: 附近没有敌人时，提升造成的伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 附近沒有敵人時，提升造成的傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 周りに敵がいない時、ダメージが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 근처에 적이 없을 때 주는 대미지가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi xung quanh không có kẻ địch, tăng ST gây ra
descriptions.Thai: เพิ่ม​ความเสียหาย​เมื่อ​ไม่มี​ศัตรู​อยู่​ใกล้
descriptions.French: Vos dégâts augmentent quand aucun ennemi n'est à proximité.
descriptions.German: Wenn sich kein Gegner in deiner Nähe befindet, steigt dein verursachter Schaden.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наносите больше урона, если рядом нет противников.
descriptions.Indonesian: Damage ditingkatkan saat tak ada musuh di sekitar.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): O dano aumenta quando nenhum inimigo está próximo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): El daño aumenta cuando no hay enemigos cerca.

name: Onslaught

names.Thai: ใส่​ไม่​ยั้ง

description: Whenever you crit, you fire additional projectile fragments, and the number of projectiles launched by your next skill attack is increased.

descriptions.English: Whenever you crit, you fire additional projectile fragments, and the number of projectiles launched by your next skill attack is increased.
descriptions.Chinese: 暴击时发射额外碎片攻击，并提升下次技能攻击的投射物数量
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 暴擊時發射額外碎片攻擊，並提升下次技能攻擊的投射物數量
descriptions.Japanese: 会心攻撃時追加で欠片を放ち、次のスキルの飛び道具数を増やす
descriptions.Korean: 치명타 시 추가 조각을 발사해 공격하고, 다음 스킬 공격의 투사체 수량이 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi bạo kích, bắn thêm các mảnh để tấn công và tăng số lượng Đạn cho đòn tấn công kỹ năng tiếp theo
descriptions.Thai: เมื่อใด​ก็ตาม​ที่​คุณ​คริ​ติค​อล​ ​คุณ​จะ​ยิง​เศษ​กระสุนปืน​เพิ่มเติม​ ​และ​จำนวน​กระสุน​ที่​ปล่อย​ออกมา​จาก​การ​โจมตี​ด้วย​ทักษะ​ครั้ง​ต่อไป​ของ​คุณ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น
descriptions.French: Chaque fois que vous effectuez un critique, vous tirez des éclats de projectiles supplémentaires et le nombre de projectiles lancés par votre prochain talent offensif est augmenté.
descriptions.German: Immer wenn du einen kritischen Treffer landest, feuerst du zusätzliche Projektilfragmente ab, und die Anzahl der Projektile, die durch deinen nächsten Fertigkeitsangriff abgefeuert werden, erhöht sich.
descriptions.Russian: Когда вы наносите критический удар, вы выпускаете дополнительные фрагменты снарядов и повышаете число снарядов, выпущенных следующим навыком.
descriptions.Indonesian: Setiap kali kamu melakukan serangan kritikal, kamu menembakkan fragmen proyektil tambahan, serta jumlah proyektil yang ditembakkan oleh serangan skill-mu berikutnya akan bertambah.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Sempre que tiver um acerto crítico, você dispara fragmentos de projéteis adicionais, e o número de projéteis lançados pelo seu próximo ataque de habilidade aumenta.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Cada vez que haces un golpe crítico, disparas fragmentos de proyectiles adicionales, y aumenta la cantidad de proyectiles que lanza tu siguiente ataque de habilidad.

name: Covered Reload

names.Thai: รี​โหลด​ครอบคลุม

description: You regain life and remove <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> from yourself whenever you dodge damage from within the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>.

descriptions.English: You regain life and remove <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> from yourself whenever you dodge damage from within the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 进入<color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>中躲避伤害时获得恢复，并移除自身的<color=#ab87ca>黑暗异常</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 進入<color=#49A5FFFF>「虛空」</color>中躲避傷害時獲得恢復，並移除自身的<color=#ab87ca>黑暗異常</color>
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>に入ってダメージを回避する時に回復し、自身の<color=#ab87ca>闇異常</color>を浄化する
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>「허공」</color>에 진입해 대미지를 회피할 때 HP를 회복하고, 자신의 <color=#ab87ca>암흑 이상</color>을 제거한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi vào <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hư Không]</color> để tránh ST sẽ được hồi phục, và xóa <color=#ab87ca>Hắc Ám Bất Thường</color> của bản thân
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​จะ​ฟื้น​คืน​พลัง​ชีวิต​และ​ลบ<color=#ab87ca>​อาการ​มืด</color>​ออกจาก​ตัว​คุณ​เอง​เมื่อใด​ก็ตาม​ที่​คุณ​หลบ​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ภายใน<color=#49A5FFFF>​ความว่างเปล่า</color>​ได้
descriptions.French: Vous récupérez de la vie et vous retirez une <color=#ab87ca>altération Ténèbres</color> sur vous chaque fois que vous esquivez des dégâts depuis le <color=#49A5FFFF>Néant</color>.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst Leben zurück und entfernst <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelschwächung</color> von dir, wenn du Schaden aus der <color=#49A5FFFF>Leere</color> ausweichst.
descriptions.Russian: Вы восстанавливаете здоровье и снимаете с себя <color=#ab87ca>черную хворь</color>, когда избегаете урона из <color=#49A5FFFF>Пустоты</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu memperoleh HP dan menghapus <color=#ab87ca>Infeksi Kegelapan</color> dari diri setiap kali menghindari damage dari dalam <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você recupera vida e remove a <color=#ab87ca>Condição Escuridão</color> de si mesmo sempre que se esquiva do dano causado pelo <color=#49A5FFFF>Vazio</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Recuperas vida y eliminas la <color=#ab87ca>alteración de oscuridad</color> sobre ti cuando esquivas daño desde dentro del <color=#49A5FFFF>vacío</color>.

name: Predatory Focus

names.Thai: พลังจิต​นัก​ล่า

description: Strength is transformed into Dexterity after the skill is activated. Mana regenerates at a fixed rate.

descriptions.English: Strength is transformed into Dexterity after the skill is activated. Mana regenerates at a fixed rate.
descriptions.Chinese: 开启后将智力转化为敏捷，以固定的速度持续恢复能量值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 開啟後將智力轉化為敏捷，以固定的速度持續恢復能量值
descriptions.Japanese: 使用すると知力を素早さに変え、一定速度で持続的にマナを回復する
descriptions.Korean: 사용 시 지능을 민첩으로 전환하고, 고정된 속도로 마나를 지속 회복한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Sau khi mở sẽ chuyển hóa Trí Lực thành Nhanh Nhạy, dùng tốc độ cố định để hồi phục Năng Lượng liên tục
descriptions.Thai: แปลง​ความแข็ง​แกร่ง​เป็นความ​คล่องตัว​หลังจาก​ใช้​ทักษะ​ ​พลัง​เวท​จะ​ฟื้นฟู​ตาม​อัตรา​คงที่
descriptions.French: Votre force est convertie en dextérité à l'activation de ce talent. Le mana se régénère à une vitesse fixe.
descriptions.German: Nach Aktivierung der Fertigkeit wird Stärke in Gewandtheit umgewandelt. Mana regeneriert sich mit fester Geschwindigkeit.
descriptions.Russian: После активации навыка сила становится ловкостью. Мана восстанавливается с определенной скоростью.
descriptions.Indonesian: Strength diubah menjadi Dexterity setelah skill diaktifkan. Mana pulih pada kecepatan tetap.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): A Força é transformada em Destreza depois que a habilidade é ativada. A mana se regenera a uma taxa fixa.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): La fuerza se transforma en destreza una vez activada la habilidad. El maná se regenera a un ritmo constante.

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Nightpiercer

names.Thai: ไนท์​เพีย​ร์​เซอร์

description: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you fire a tracking, piercing arrow that consumes Deadlock to extend its duration.

descriptions.English: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you fire a tracking, piercing arrow that consumes Deadlock to extend its duration.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，射出一支跟踪穿透箭矢，可以消耗完全标记延长子弹的持续时间
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，射出一支跟蹤穿透箭矢，可以消耗完全標記延長子彈的持續時間
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>闇の力</color>を利用して追尾効果を持つ貫通矢を放ち、完全照準を消費して矢の持続時間を長くすることができる
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>어둠의 힘으로</color> 추적 관통 화살을 발사한다. 완전 마크를 소모해 총알의 지속 시간을 연장시킬 수 있다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Sử dụng Sức Mạnh Hắc Ám</color>, bắn một mũi tên xuyên thấu có thể tiêu hao Đánh Dấu Tất Cả để kéo dài thời gian duy trì của đạn
descriptions.Thai: <color=#ab87ca>​ด้วย​พลัง​แห่ง​กระแสทวน</color>​ ​คุณ​ยิง​ลูกศร​เจาะ​ทะลุ​ติดตาม​ซึ่ง​ใช้​ล็อก​ตาย​เพื่อ​ขยาย​ระยะเวลา
descriptions.French: <color=#ab87ca>Grâce au pouvoir du Contre-courant</color>, vous lancez une flèche perforante à tête chercheuse qui consomme la fixation pour prolonger sa durée.
descriptions.German: <color=#ab87ca>Durch die Kraft des Sogs</color> schießt du einen zielsuchenden, durchdringenden Pfeil ab, der Vollmarkierungen verbraucht, um seine Dauer zu verlängern.
descriptions.Russian: <color=#ab87ca>С помощью силы Тягуна</color> вы выпускаете наводящуюся пронзающую стрелу, которая расходует захват, чтобы продлить свое действие.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#ab87ca>Dengan kekuatan Undertow</color>, kamu menembakkan panah pelacak yang menggunakan Deadlock untuk memperpanjang durasinya.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#ab87ca>Com o poder de Ressaca</color>, você dispara uma flecha rastreadora e perfurante que consome Marcação Máxima para estender sua duração.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Con el poder de la corriente</color>, disparas una flecha punzante y dirigida que consume vestigio para extender su duración.

description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Human Bunker

names.Thai: บัง​เกอร์​มนุษย์

description: Gain bonus attack speed and damage reduction but reduced movement speed.

descriptions.English: Gain bonus attack speed and damage reduction but reduced movement speed.
descriptions.Chinese: 开启后牺牲移动速度，大幅提升攻击速度和防御能力
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 開啟後犧牲移動速度，大幅提升攻擊速度和防禦能力
descriptions.Japanese: 使用すると移動速度が下がり、攻撃速度と防御力は大幅に上がる
descriptions.Korean: 사용 시 이동 속도를 희생하여 공격 속도와 방어 능력을 대폭 증가시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Sau khi mở, hy sinh Tốc độ di chuyển để tăng Tốc độ tấn công và Phòng thủ
descriptions.Thai: รับ​โบนัส​ความเร็ว​การ​โจมตี​และ​การ​ลด​ความเสียหาย​แต่​ลด​ความเร็ว​การ​วิ่ง
descriptions.French: Vous gagnez un bonus de vitesse d'attaque et une réduction de dégâts, mais votre vitesse de déplacement est réduite.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst einen Bonus auf Angriffstempo und Schadensreduktion, doch dein Bewegungstempo sinkt.
descriptions.Russian: Вы атакуете быстрее и получаете меньше урона, но двигаетесь медленнее.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memperoleh bonus kecepatan serangan dan pengurangan damage tapi kecepatan gerak dikurangi.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Ganha bônus de velocidade de ataque e redução de dano, mas reduz a velocidade de movimento.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Obtienes velocidad de ataque y reducción de daño adicional, pero se reduce tu velocidad de movimiento.

name: Enkindle

names.Thai: สั่ง​ระเบิด

description: Unleash a thermal surge that detonates all surrounding <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color>.

descriptions.English: Unleash a thermal surge that detonates all surrounding <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放一阵热浪，并引爆周围的<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 釋放一陣熱浪，並引爆周圍的<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 炎を放ち、周りの<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>を起爆させる
descriptions.Korean: 열파를 내뿜어 주변의 <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>을 폭발시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thi triển 1 làn sóng nhiệt và kích nổ <color=#49A5FFFF>"Ngọn Lửa"</color> xung quanh
descriptions.Thai: ปล่อย​คลื่น​ความร้อน​ที่​ทำให้<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>​รอบๆ​ ​ระเบิด
descriptions.French: Libère une impulsion thermique qui fait exploser toutes les <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> à proximité.
descriptions.German: Du entfesselst eine thermische Welle, die die gesamte <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> in deiner Umgebung explodieren lässt.
descriptions.Russian: Вы выпускаете тепловую волну, которая заставляет все <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color> вокруг взорваться.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melepaskan gelombang termal yang meledakkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Bara</color> di sekitar.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Libera uma onda térmica que detona todas as <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> ao redor.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Liberas una sobrecarga que detona todas las <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color> de los alrededores.

name: Human Bunker
description: Gain bonus attack speed and damage reduction but reduced movement speed.

descriptions.English: Gain bonus attack speed and damage reduction but reduced movement speed.
descriptions.Chinese: 获得攻击速度加成与伤害减免,降低移动速度

name: Scattershot

names.Thai: ศร​กระจาย

description: Shoot an arrow that fragmentates after striking an enemy.

descriptions.English: Shoot an arrow that fragmentates after striking an enemy.
descriptions.Chinese: 射出命中敌人会分裂的箭矢
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 射出命中敵人會分裂的箭矢
descriptions.Japanese: 敵に命中すると分裂する矢を放つ
descriptions.Korean: 적에게 명중 시 분열하는 화살을 발사한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Bắn mũi tên sẽ phân tách ra khi trúng kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: ยิง​ลูกศร​ที่​แตก​กระจาย​หลังจาก​โดน​ศัตรู
descriptions.French: Tire une flèche qui se divise après avoir touché un ennemi.
descriptions.German: Du schießt einen Pfeil ab, der nach dem Kontakt mit dem Gegner zersplittert.
descriptions.Russian: Вы выпускаете стрелу, которая разлетается на осколки при столкновении с врагом.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menembakkan panah yang membelah setelah mengenai musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Atira uma flecha que se fragmenta após atingir um inimigo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Disparas una flecha que se fragmenta después de impactar con el enemigo.

name: Atrophic Barrage

names.Vietnamese: Pháo Kích Năng Lượng Hắc Ám
names.Thai: ระดม​โจมตี

description: Your next several ranged normal attacks <color=#ab87ca>are empowered by the Undertow</color> to deal area damage at the cost of reduced attack speed.

descriptions.English: Your next several ranged normal attacks <color=#ab87ca>are empowered by the Undertow</color> to deal area damage at the cost of reduced attack speed.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>并降低攻击速度，使接下来的数次远程普通攻击造成范围伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>並降低攻擊速度，使接下來的數次遠程普通攻擊造成範圍傷害
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>闇の力</color>を利用し、攻撃速度は下がるが、次の複数回の遠距離通常攻撃は範囲ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>어둠의 힘으로</color> 공격 속도를 감소시키고, 다음 수 차례의 원거리 일반 공격이 광역 대미지를 가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Sử dụng Sức Mạnh Hắc Ám</color> và giảm tốc độ tấn công, để một số đòn tấn công thường tầm xa tiếp theo sẽ gây ST diện rộng
descriptions.Thai: การ​โจมตี​ปกติ​ระยะไกล​หลายครั้ง​ต่อไป​ของ​เจ้า<color=#ab87ca>​จะ​ได้รับ​พลัง​จาก​กระแสทวน</color>​ใน​การ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ใน​พื้นที่​โดย​แลก​กับ​ความเร็ว​การ​โจมตี​ที่​ลดลง
descriptions.French: Vos prochaines attaques normales à distance <color=#ab87ca>sont renforcées par le Contre-courant</color> et infligent des dégâts de zone, mais votre vitesse d'attaque est réduite.
descriptions.German: Deine nächsten paar normalen Fernkampf-Angriffe <color=#ab87ca>werden durch den Sog verstärkt</color> und verursachen Flächenschaden, allerdings auf Kosten eines reduzierten Angriffstempos.
descriptions.Russian: Несколько следующих обычных дальнобойных атак <color=#ab87ca>получают силу Тягуна</color> и наносят урон по области за счет снижения скорости атаки.
descriptions.Indonesian: Rangkaian serangan normalmu berikutnya <color=#ab87ca>diperkuat oleh Undertow</color> untuk menghasilkan damage area, tapi risikonya adalah kecepatan serangannya berkurang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Seus próximos ataques normais de longo alcance <color=#ab87ca>são fortalecidos pela Ressaca</color> para causar dano de área ao custo de uma velocidade de ataque reduzida.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tus próximos ataques normales en rango <color=#ab87ca>están impulsados por la corriente</color> y causan daño adicional en área a cambio de reducir la velocidad de ataque.

name: Scattershot
description: Fire an arrow that splits into damaging fragments upon hitting enemies.

descriptions.English: Fire an arrow that splits into damaging fragments upon hitting enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 射出箭矢，命中敌人后会分裂出碎片

name: Planar Locator

names.Japanese: ディメンションマーカー
names.Thai: ตัว​ระบุ​ตำแหน่ง​ระนาบ

description: Your Mark is enhanced, and you receive the <color=#49A5FFFF>Beacon</color> status upon Deadlocking an enemy, which extends the time you can remain in the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color> upon your next entry. While in the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>, all your attacks instantly Deadlock enemies.

descriptions.English: Your Mark is enhanced, and you receive the <color=#49A5FFFF>Beacon</color> status upon Deadlocking an enemy, which extends the time you can remain in the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color> upon your next entry. While in the <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>, all your attacks instantly Deadlock enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 强化标记，并在完全标记时获得<color=#49A5FFFF>「信标」</color>以延长下次进入<color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>的持续时间。在<color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>中攻击会完全标记敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 強化標記，並在完全標記時獲得<color=#49A5FFFF>「信標」</color>以延長下次進入<color=#49A5FFFF>「虛空」</color>的持續時間。在<color=#49A5FFFF>「虛空」</color>中攻擊會完全標記敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 照準を強化し、完全照準時に<color=#49A5FFFF>「マーカー」</color>を獲得して次回<color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>に入る時間が長くなる。<color=#49A5FFFF>「虚空」</color>で攻撃を行うと敵に完全照準を合わせることができる
descriptions.Korean: 표식을 강화하고, 완전 마크 시 <color=#49A5FFFF>「비콘」</color>을 획득해 다음 <color=#49A5FFFF>「허공」</color> 진입 지속 시간을 연장시킨다. <color=#49A5FFFF>「허공」</color>에서 공격 시 적을 완전 마크한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Cường hóa Đánh Dấu, và khi Đánh Dấu Tất Cả sẽ nhận được <color=#49A5FFFF>[Tín Hiệu]</color> để kéo dài thời gian duy trì khi vào <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hư Không]</color> lần sau. Tấn công trong <color=#49A5FFFF>[Hư Không]</color> sẽ đánh dấu tất cả kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: การเล็ง​เป้า​ของ​คุณ​ได้รับ​การ​เสริม​พลัง​และ​คุณ​ได้รับ​สถานะ<color=#49A5FFFF>​บี​คอน</color>​ ​เมื่อ​ทำการ​ล็อก​ตาย​ศัตรู​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​ขยายเวลา​ที่​คุณ​สามารถ​อยู่ใน<color=#49A5FFFF>​ความว่างเปล่า</color>​ได้​ใน​ครั้ง​ถัดไป​ของ​คุณ​ ​ขณะที่​อยู่ใน<color=#49A5FFFF>​ความว่างเปล่า</color>​ ​การ​โจมตี​ทั้งหมด​ของ​คุณ​จะ​ล็อก​ตาย​ศัตรู​ทันที
descriptions.French: Votre Marqueur est amélioré, et vous recevez le statut <color=#49A5FFFF>Balise</color> lorsque vous fixez un ennemi, ce qui augmente la durée pendant laquelle vous pouvez rester dans le <color=#49A5FFFF>Néant</color> la prochaine fois que vous y entrerez. Tant que vous êtes dans le <color=#49A5FFFF>Néant</color>, toutes vos attaques fixent instantanément les ennemis.
descriptions.German: Deine Markierung wird verbessert und du erhältst den Status <color=#49A5FFFF>Leuchtfeuer</color>, wenn du einen Gegner vollmarkierst. Dadurch verlängerst du die Zeit, die du bei deinem nächsten Eintritt in der <color=#49A5FFFF>Leere</color> bleiben kannst. Während du dich in der <color=#49A5FFFF>Leere</color> befindest, werden durch all deine Angriffe Gegner sofort vollmarkiert.
descriptions.Russian: Ваша метка усиливается, и вы получаете статус <color=#49A5FFFF>«Маяк»</color> при сковывании врага, что увеличивает время пребывания в <color=#49A5FFFF>Пустоте</color> при следующем входе. Пока вы находитесь в <color=#49A5FFFF>Пустоте</color>, все ваши атаки мгновенно сковывают врагов.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mark milikmu ditingkatkan, lalu menerima status <color=#49A5FFFF>Beacon</color> saat melakukan Deadlock pada musuh, yang memperpanjang waktu tinggal dalam <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color> selanjutnya. Saat di dalam <color=#49A5FFFF>Void</color>, semua seranganmu langsung Deadlock musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Sua Marcação é aprimorada e você recebe o status de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sinalizador</color> ao fazer Marcação Máxima em um inimigo, o que aumenta o tempo que você pode permanecer no <color=#49A5FFFF>Vazio</color> na sua próxima entrada. Enquanto estiver no <color=#49A5FFFF>Vazio</color>, todos os seus ataques causam Marcação Máxima instantânea nos inimigos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu marca mejora y recibes la condición de <color=#49A5FFFF>faro</color> al marcar el vestigio en un enemigo, lo que extiende el tiempo que puedes permanecer en el <color=#49A5FFFF>vacío</color> en tu siguiente entrada. Cuando estás en el <color=#49A5FFFF>vacío</color>, todos los ataques marcan el vestigio en tus enemigos al instante.

description: Constructs an arbalest turret to assist you in battle.

descriptions.English: Constructs an arbalest turret to assist you in battle.
descriptions.Chinese: 建造一个弩炮机关协助作战

description: Enemies have a chance to discharge ammo fragments that damage nearby enemies upon death.

descriptions.English: Enemies have a chance to discharge ammo fragments that damage nearby enemies upon death.
descriptions.Chinese: 击败有概率触发小碎片攻击周围敌人

name: Frontload

names.Thai: พุ่งตัว

description: Swiftly advance a distance while temporarily dodging all attacks. Your next attack fires additional projectiles.

descriptions.English: Swiftly advance a distance while temporarily dodging all attacks. Your next attack fires additional projectiles.
descriptions.Chinese: 快速前进一段距离且暂时闪避所有攻击，下一次攻击的投射物数量增加
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 快速前進一段距離且暫時閃避所有攻擊，下一次攻擊的投射物數量增加
descriptions.Japanese: 素早く前進し、暫くの間全ての攻撃を回避し、次の攻撃の飛び道具数が増える
descriptions.Korean: 빠르게 일정 거리 이동한 후, 짧은 시간 모든 공격을 회피한다. 다음 공격 시 투사체 수량이 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhanh chóng tiến về phía trước một đoạn và tạm thời né tránh mọi đòn tấn công, số lượng đạn trong đòn tấn công tiếp theo sẽ tăng lên
descriptions.Thai: เคลื่อนที่​ไป​ข้างหน้า​อย่างว่องไว​พร้อม​หลบ​การ​โจมตี​ทั้งหมด​ชั่วคราว​ ​การ​โจมตี​ครั้ง​ต่อไป​จะ​ยิง​วิถีกระสุน​เพิ่มเติม
descriptions.French: Avancez rapidement sur une certaine distance tout en évitant temporairement toutes les attaques. Votre prochaine attaque tire des projectiles supplémentaires.
descriptions.German: Rücke schnell eine Distanz vor und weiche dabei vorübergehend allen Angriffen aus. Bei deinem nächsten Angriff feuerst du zusätzliche Projektile ab.
descriptions.Russian: Стремительно атакуйте, уклоняясь от всех атак. При последующей атаке выпускайте дополнительные снаряды.
descriptions.Indonesian: Perdekat jarak dengan cepat sambil menghindari semua serangan untuk sementara. Seranganmu yang berikutnya akan menembakkan proyektil tambahan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Avance rapidamente por uma distância enquanto desvia temporariamente de todos os ataques. Seu próximo ataque dispara projéteis adicionais.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Avanza cierta distancia con agilidad y evitando todos los ataques temporalmente. Tu siguiente ataque dispara proyectiles adicionales.

name: Trophy Hunter

names.Thai: นัก​ล่า​รางวัล

description: Gain bonus movement speed and stat upon slaying an enemy.

descriptions.English: Gain bonus movement speed and stat upon slaying an enemy.
descriptions.Chinese: 击杀敌人后获得移动速度和属性加成
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 擊殺敵人後獲得移動速度和屬性加成
descriptions.Japanese: 敵を倒した後、移動速度とステータスが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 적 처치 후 이동 속도와 스탯 보너스를 획득한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Nhận tốc độ di chuyển và buff thuộc tính sau khi tiêu diệt kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: รับ​โบนัส​ความเร็ว​ใน​การ​เคลื่อนที่​และ​สถานะ​เมื่อ​สังหาร​ศัตรู
descriptions.French: Gagnez des bonus de vitesse de déplacement et de stats en éliminant un ennemi.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst einen Bonus auf Bewegungstempo und Attribute, wenn du einen Gegner tötest.
descriptions.Russian: Бонус к скорости движения и показателям после убийства врага.
descriptions.Indonesian: Dapatkan bonus kecepatan gerak dan statistik setelah membunuh musuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Ganhe velocidade de movimento e atributos bônus ao eliminar um inimigo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Obtienes velocidad de movimiento y estadísticas adicionales al vencer a un enemigo.

name: Aimbot

names.Thai: บอ​ต​เล็ง

description: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marked</color> enemies have reduced defense, and <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlocked</color> enemies take amplified damage.

descriptions.English: <color=#49A5FFFF>Marked</color> enemies have reduced defense, and <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlocked</color> enemies take amplified damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 强化<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>的效果降低目标防御，完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「标记」</color>时还会使其受到伤害加深
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 強化<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>的效果降低目標防禦，完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「標記」</color>時還會使其受到傷害加深
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>の効果を強化して目標の防御力を下げ、完全<color=#49A5FFFF>「照準」</color>時はダメージをアップする
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>「표식」</color>의 강화 효과는 목표의 방어력을 감소시키며, 완전한 <color=#49A5FFFF>「표식」</color>이 되면 대미지가 가중된다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Cường hóa hiệu quả của <color=#49A5FFFF>[Đánh Dấu]</color> để giảm phòng thủ của mục tiêu, khi hoàn toàn <color=#49A5FFFF>[Đánh Dấu]</color> mới tăng ST lên mục tiêu
descriptions.Thai: ศัตรู​ที่​ถูก<color=#49A5FFFF>​เล็ง​เป้า</color>​จะ​มีพลัง​ป้องกัน​ลดลง​ ​และ​ศัตรู​ที่​ถูก<color=#49A5FFFF>​ล็อก​ตาย</color>​จะ​ได้รับ​ความเสียหาย​แรง​ขึ้น
descriptions.French: Les ennemis <color=#49A5FFFF>marqués</color> ont une défense réduite et les ennemis <color=#49A5FFFF>fixés</color> subissent des dégâts amplifiés.
descriptions.German: <color=#49A5FFFF>Markierte</color> Gegner haben eine verringerte Verteidigung, und <color=#49A5FFFF>Vollmarkierte</color> Gegner erleiden erhöhten Schaden.
descriptions.Russian: У <color=#49A5FFFF>отмеченных</color> у врагов снижается защита, <color=#49A5FFFF>скованные</color> враги получают дополнительный урон.
descriptions.Indonesian: Musuh yang <color=#49A5FFFF>Ditandai</color> memiliki pertahanan yang dikurangi, dan musuh yang <color=#49A5FFFF>Deadlock</color> menerima damage yang diperkuat.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Inimigos com <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcação</color> têm sua defesa reduzida, e inimigos com <color=#49A5FFFF>Marcação Máxima</color> sofrem dano amplificado.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Se reduce la defensa de los enemigos <color=#49A5FFFF>marcados</color> y los enemigos bajo el efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>Vestigio</color> reciben más daño.

description: Create a <color=#49A5FFFF>Shadowclone</color> that inherits a percentage of your stats to assist you in combat.

descriptions.English: Create a <color=#49A5FFFF>Shadowclone</color> that inherits a percentage of your stats to assist you in combat.
descriptions.Chinese: 制造继承召唤者部分属性的<color=#49A5FFFF>「分身」</color>协助战斗
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 製造繼承召喚者部分屬性的<color=#49A5FFFF>「分身」</color>協助戰鬥
descriptions.Japanese: 召喚者のステータスの一部を引き継ぎ、戦闘に参加してくれる<color=#49A5FFFF>「分身」</color>を作る
descriptions.Korean: 소환사의 일부 속성을 계승한 <color=#49A5FFFF>「분신」</color>을 생성해 전투를 지원한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tạo ra <color=#49A5FFFF>[Bản Sao]</color> kế thừa một phần thuộc tính của người triệu hồi để phối hợp tác chiến
descriptions.Thai: สร้าง<color=#49A5FFFF>​ร่าง​แยก​เงา</color>​ที่​รับ​สืบทอด​ค่า​สถานะ​ของ​คุณ​มา​เปอร์เซ็นต์​หนึ่ง​เพื่อ​ช่วย​คุณ​ใน​การต่อสู้
descriptions.French: Créez un <color=#49A5FFFF>clone d'ombre</color> qui hérite d'un pourcentage de vos stats pour vous aider au combat.
descriptions.German: Erzeuge einen <color=#49A5FFFF>Schattenklon</color>, der einen Prozentsatz deiner Attribute übernimmt, um dich im Kampf zu unterstützen.
descriptions.Russian: Создает <color=#49A5FFFF>клона тени</color> который получает часть ваших показателей, помогая вам в бою.
descriptions.Indonesian: Membuat <color=#49A5FFFF>Shadowclone</color> yang mewarisi sepersentase statusmu untuk membantu di pertempuran.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Cria um <color=#49A5FFFF>Clone de Sombras</color> que herda uma porcentagem das suas estatísticas para ajudá-lo em combate.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Crea un <color=#49A5FFFF>clon de sombras</color> que hereda un porcentaje de tus estadísticas para ayudarte en combate.

name: Immolation Ward

names.Thai: อาคม​มอดไหม้​คุ้มภัย

description: Fortify allies with a fiery aura that continuously scorches enemies around them, and sheathes them with protective flames when they are being attacked.

descriptions.English: Fortify allies with a fiery aura that continuously scorches enemies around them, and sheathes them with protective flames when they are being attacked.
descriptions.Chinese: 为友方施加火焰光环，持续灼烧周围敌人，并在受到攻击时展开护体火焰
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 為友方施加火焰光環，持續灼燒周圍敵人，並在受到攻擊時展開護體火焰
descriptions.Japanese: 味方にフレイムオーラを付与し、周りの敵を燃やし続け、攻撃を受ける時に炎の盾を展開する
descriptions.Korean: 아군에 화염 오라를 부여해 주변의 적을 지속적으로 불태운다. 피격 시 화염 보호막을 전개한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thi triển Hào Quang Lửa cho đồng đội, duy trì lửa xung quanh kẻ địch, đồng thời triển khai ngọn lửa phòng thân khi bị tấn công
descriptions.Thai: เสริม​ความแข็ง​แกร่ง​พันธมิตร​ด้วย​ออ​ร่า​ไฟ​ที่​เผา​ศัตรู​รอบตัว​อย่างต่อเนื่อง​ ​และ​ปกป้อง​พันธมิตร​ด้วย​เพลิง​คุ้มภัย​เมื่อ​ถูก​โจมตี
descriptions.French: Fortifiez vos alliés avec une aura ardente qui brûle en continu les ennemis autour d'eux et les enveloppe de flammes protectrices lorsqu'ils sont attaqués.
descriptions.German: Stärke Verbündete mit einer feurigen Aura, die sie mit schützenden Flammen umhüllt, wenn sie angegriffen werden, und Gegner um sie herum kontinuierlich versengt.
descriptions.Russian: Укрепляет союзников огненной аурой, которая покрывает их защитным пламенем, когда их атакуют, и поджигает врагов вокруг них.
descriptions.Indonesian: Perkuat sekutu dengan aura api yang terus menerus menghanguskan musuh di sekitar mereka, dan menyelimuti mereka dengan api pelindung saat mereka diserang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Fortalece os aliados com uma aura flamejante que queima continuamente os inimigos ao seu redor, envolvendo-os com chamas protetoras quando são atacados.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Fortifica a los aliados con un aura ardiente que quema continuamente a los enemigos que los rodean y los reviste con llamas protectoras cuando están bajo ataque.

name: Avatar of Ursok

names.Thai: อวตาร​ของ​เออร์​ซอก

description: With yourself as a conduit, you summon forth a powerful guardian bear spirit, transforming the effects of certain skills. Locks all mana. All your <color=#49A5FFFF>base stats</color> are greatly increased, furthermore so based on your <color=#49A5FFFF>minion power</color>.

descriptions.English: With yourself as a conduit, you summon forth a powerful guardian bear spirit, transforming the effects of certain skills. Locks all mana. All your <color=#49A5FFFF>base stats</color> are greatly increased, furthermore so based on your <color=#49A5FFFF>minion power</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用全部能量，以自身为媒介召唤强大的熊灵，改变部分技能的效果。大幅提升<color=#49A5FFFF>基础属性</color>，且受<color=#49A5FFFF>召唤物强度</color>影响
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用全部能量，以自身為媒介召喚強大的熊靈，改變部分技能的效果。大幅提升<color=#49A5FFFF>基礎屬性</color>，且受<color=#49A5FFFF>召喚物強度</color>影響
descriptions.Japanese: マナ上限を全て消費し、自身を媒介にして強力な熊霊を召喚し、一部のスキルの効果が変化する。<color=#49A5FFFF>召喚獣の強さ</color>によって、<color=#49A5FFFF>基礎ステータス</color>を大幅に強化する
descriptions.Korean: 모든 마나를 차지해 자신을 매개로 강력한 곰 영혼을 소환하고, 일부 스킬 효과를 변경한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>기본 스탯</color>이 대폭 증가하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>소환수 파워</color>의 영향을 받는다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm dụng toàn bộ năng lượng, lấy bản thân làm Môi Chất để triệu hồi Hùng Linh mạnh mẽ và làm thay đổi hiệu ứng của một số kỹ năng. Tăng mạnh <color=#49A5FFFF>thuộc tính cơ bản</color> và bị <color=#49A5FFFF>cường độ của Vật Triệu Hồi</color> ảnh hưởng
descriptions.Thai: ใช้​ตัวเอง​เป็น​สื่อ​ ​เรียก​วิญญาณ​หมี​อารักขา​ที่​ทรงพลัง​ออกมา​ ​เปลี่ยน​เอฟเฟกต์​บาง​ทักษะ​ ​ล็อค​พลัง​เวท​ทั้งหมด​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​สถานะ​พื้นฐาน</color>​ ​เพิ่มขึ้น​อย่างมาก​ ​และ​ขึ้นอยู่กับ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​พลัง​ของ​ลูกสมุน</color>​ ​ด้วย
descriptions.French: En vous utilisant vous-même comme canalisateur, vous invoquez un puissant esprit d'ours gardien, transformant les effets de certaines compétences. Verrouille tout le mana. Toutes vos <color=#49A5FFFF>stats de base</color> sont considérablement augmentées, encore davantage en fonction de la <color=#49A5FFFF>puissance des serviteurs</color>.
descriptions.German: Mit dir selbst als Vermittler beschwörst du einen mächtigen Wächter-Bärengeist, der die Effekte bestimmter Fertigkeiten transformiert. Sperrt das gesamte Mana. All deine <color=#49A5FFFF>Basisattribute</color> werden stark erhöht, zusätzlich auch basierend auf deiner <color=#49A5FFFF>Lakaien-Kraft</color>.
descriptions.Russian: Выступая в роли проводника, вы призываете дух медведя-хранителя и меняете эффекты некоторых навыков. Блокирует всю ману. Все <color=#49A5FFFF>базовые показатели</color> значительно повышаются в зависимости от <color=#49A5FFFF>силы приспешников</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Dengan dirimu sebagai penghubung, kamu memanggil roh beruang penjaga yang kuat, mengubah efek skill tertentu. Mengunci semua mana. Semua <color=#49A5FFFF>statistik dasar</color> milikmu meningkat pesat, terlebih lagi berdasarkan <color=#49A5FFFF>kekuatan minion</color>-mu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Usando a si próprio como canal, você invoca um poderoso espírito de urso guardião, transformando os efeitos de certas habilidades. Bloqueia todo o mana. Todos os seus <color=#49A5FFFF>atributos básicos</color> são aumentados de forma significativa, com um aumento adicional baseado no seu <color=#49A5FFFF>poder de lacaio</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Contigo mismo como conducto, invoca a un poderoso espíritu de oso guardián para transformar los efectos de ciertas habilidades. Todas tus <color=#49A5FFFF>estadísticas básicas</color> aumentan de forma significativa, y aún más según tu <color=#49A5FFFF>poder de esbirros</color>.

names.Thai: <color=#00e69b>​วิญญาณ​ลูก​หมาป่า​ปีศาจ​พเนจร</color>

name: Possess

names.Thai: สิงสู่

description: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you take over the body of a nearby minion, giving you full control of its actions while continuously accumulating Souls, and ending the effect with a violent soul eruption.

descriptions.English: <color=#ab87ca>By the power of the Undertow</color>, you take over the body of a nearby minion, giving you full control of its actions while continuously accumulating Souls, and ending the effect with a violent soul eruption.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，附身于附近的召唤物中持续恢复「魂魄」，控制其行动并在结束时引发剧烈的灵魂爆炸
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>借助黑暗之力</color>，附身於附近的召喚物中持續恢復「魂魄」，控制其行動並在結束時引發劇烈的靈魂爆炸
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>闇の力</color>を利用して近くの召喚獣に憑依し、持続的に「魂」を獲得する。召喚獣操作終了時に激しい魂の爆発を引き起こす
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>어둠의 힘으로</color> 근처의 소환수에 빙의해 지속적으로 「영혼」을 회복하며 움직임을 제어한다. 종료 시 격렬한 영혼 폭발을 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Sử dụng Sức Mạnh Hắc Ám</color>, nhập thể lên Vật Triệu Hồi gần đó và liên tục khôi phục [Hồn Phách], kiểm soát hành động và kích hoạt Nổ Linh Hồn dữ dội khi kết thúc
descriptions.Thai: คุณ​ควบคุม​ร่าง​ของ​ลูกสมุน​ที่อยู่​ใกล้เคียง<color=#ab87ca>​ด้วย​พลัง​จาก​กระแสทวน</color>​ ​โดย​คุณ​จะ​สามารถ​ควบคุม​การกระทำ​ของ​มัน​ได้​อย่างเต็มที่​ในขณะที่​สะสม​วิญญาณ​อย่างต่อเนื่อง​ ​และ​สิ้นสุด​เอฟเฟกต์​ด้วย​การ​ปะทุ​ของ​วิญญาณ​อย่างรุนแรง
descriptions.French: <color=#ab87ca>Grâce au pouvoir du Contre-courant</color>, vous prenez possession du corps d'un serviteur proche, ce qui vous donne le contrôle total de ses actions tout en cumulant continuellement des âmes. L’effet se termine par une violente éruption d’âmes.
descriptions.German: <color=#ab87ca>Mit der Macht des Sogs</color> übernimmst du den Körper eines Lakaien in der Nähe, wodurch du die volle Kontrolle über seine Handlungen erhältst, während du kontinuierlich Seelen ansammelst und den Effekt mit einer heftigen Seeleneruption beendest.
descriptions.Russian: <color=#ab87ca>С помощью силы Тягуна</color> вы захватываете тело ближайшего приспешника, полностью контролируя его действия и постоянно накапливая души. Действие эффекта завершается мощным извержением душ.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#ab87ca>Dengan kekuatan Undertow</color>, kamu mengambil alih tubuh minion terdekat dan mengendalikannya sambil terus mengumpulkan Jiwa, lalu mengakhiri efek dengan letusan jiwa yang dahsyat.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): <color=#ab87ca>Com o poder da Ressaca</color>, você assume o corpo de um lacaio próximo, dando a você controle completo de suas ações enquanto acumula Almas continuamente. O efeito termina com uma erupção de alma violenta.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Con el poder de la corriente</color>, tomas control del cuerpo de un esbirro cercano, diriges todas sus acciones, y acumulas almas constantemente, hasta que el efecto termina con una violenta explosión de almas.

name: Death Endures

names.Thai: ความตาย​คงอยู่

description: Upon taking lethal damage, you pass into the Void and are restored to life at the expense of losing all Souls.

descriptions.English: Upon taking lethal damage, you pass into the Void and are restored to life at the expense of losing all Souls.
descriptions.Chinese: 受到致命伤害时遁入虚空，同时失去全部「魂魄」以恢复生命值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 受到致命傷害時遁入虛空，同時失去全部「魂魄」以恢復生命值
descriptions.Japanese: 致命ダメージを受ける時に虚空の中に逃げ、「魂」を全て消費してHPを回復する
descriptions.Korean: 치명적인 대미지를 받을 때 허공에 진입하고, 모든 「혼백」을 잃고 HP를 회복한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi phải chịu ST Chí Mang sẽ vào Hư Không, đồng thời mất hết [Linh Hồn] để hồi phục HP
descriptions.Thai: เมื่อ​ได้รับ​ความเสียหาย​ถึงตาย​ ​คุณ​จะ​ผ่าน​เข้าไป​ใน​ความว่างเปล่า​และ​ฟื้น​คืน​พลัง​ชีวิต​โดย​สูญเสีย​วิญญาณ​ทั้งหมด
descriptions.French: Lorsque vous subissez des dégâts mortels, vous passez dans le Néant et revenez à la vie au prix de la perte de toutes vos âmes.
descriptions.German: Wenn du tödlichen Schaden erleidest, gehst du in die Leere und wirst wieder zum Leben erweckt, verlierst dabei aber alle Seelen.
descriptions.Russian: Получив смертельный урон, вы отправляетесь в Пустоту и восстанавливаете здоровье, теряя все души.
descriptions.Indonesian: Saat terkena damage mematikan, kamu memasuki Void dan kembali hidup dengan kehilangan semua Souls.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Ao receber dano letal, você entra no Vazio e é restaurado à vida ao custo da perda de todas as Almas.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Al recibir daño letal, entras al vacío y revives a cambio de perder todas las almas.

name: Overwhelm

names.Thai: ถาโถม

description: When attacking, you deal additional damage to enemies based on your current life percentage. Has a CD when attacking the same enemy. The said CD is halved when Beastmorph Elixir is active.

descriptions.English: When attacking, you deal additional damage to enemies based on your current life percentage. Has a CD when attacking the same enemy. The said CD is halved when Beastmorph Elixir is active.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击时，根据自己当前的生命值对敌人造成额外伤害。对同一个敌人有冷却时间，狂化时减半
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊時，根據自己當前的生命值對敵人造成額外傷害。對同一個敵人有冷卻時間，狂化時減半
descriptions.Japanese: 攻撃時、現在のHPに応じて敵に追加ダメージを与える。同じ敵に追加ダメージを与えると暫くの間この効果を発動できない。狂化時、CDが半分になる
descriptions.Korean: 공격 시 자신의 현재 HP에 따라 적에게 추가 대미지를 가한다. 동일한 적은 쿨타임이 존재하며, 광폭화 시 쿨타임이 50% 감소한다
