descriptions.French: Vous gagnez une résistance élémentaire supplémentaire aux dégâts électriques et de froid. Pour chaque élément, vos dégâts supplémentaires sont augmentés en fonction de votre résistance à cet élément.
descriptions.German: Du erhältst zusätzliche Elektro- und Kälte-Elementarresistenz. Dein zusätzlicher Schaden für jedes Element wird basierend auf deiner Resistenz gegen das entsprechende Element erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы получаете дополнительное сопротивление к молнии и холоду. Чем оно выше, тем больше урон от соответствующей стихии.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu mendapatkan Daya Tahan Elemental tambahan terhadap Syok dan Dingin. Damage ekstramu untuk setiap elemen meningkat berdasarkan daya tahanmu yang sesuai terhadapnya.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você ganha Resistência Elemental adicional à Eletricidade e ao Gelo. Seu dano adicional por cada elemento é aumentado com base na sua resistência ao elemento correspondente.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Ganas resistencia elemental adicional a la electricidad y al frío. El daño adicional que haces con cada elemento aumenta en función de tu resistencia correspondiente.

name: Aeolian Chant

names.Thai: บท​สวด​เอ​โอ​เลียน

description: Call forth spirits of nature to attack nearby enemies, leech their health and mana, and grant <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color> upon returning to you.

descriptions.English: Call forth spirits of nature to attack nearby enemies, leech their health and mana, and grant <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color> upon returning to you.
descriptions.Chinese: 呼唤自然精灵攻击附近的敌人，汲取他们的生命值和能量值，并在返回时提供<color=#49A5FFFF>「过载」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 呼喚自然精靈攻擊附近的敵人，汲取他們的生命值和能量值，並在返回時提供<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 自然の精霊を呼び出して周囲の敵を攻撃させ、敵のHPとマナを吸収し、さらに戻って来る時に<color=#49A5FFFF>「暴走」</color>を獲得する
descriptions.Korean: 자연의 엘프를 소환해 주변의 적을 공격하고 HP 및 마나를 흡수하며, 돌아올 때 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과전류」</color>를 제공한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Gọi Tinh Linh Tự Nhiên tấn công kẻ địch ở gần, hút HP và Pháp Lực và cung cấp <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quá Tải"</color> khi quay lại
descriptions.Thai: เรียก​วิญญาณ​ที่สี่​แห่งธรรม​ชาติ​ออกมา​เพื่อ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ที่อยู่​ใกล้เคียง​ ​ดูด​พลัง​ชีวิต​และ​มา​นา​ของ​พวก​มัน​ ​และ​มอบให้​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​โอเวอร์​โหลด</color>​ ​เมื่อ​กลับมา​หา​คุณ
descriptions.French: Appelle les esprits de la nature pour attaquer les ennemis proches, drainer leur vie et leur mana, et vous conférer <color=#49A5FFFF>Surchargé</color> lorsqu'ils reviennent vers vous.
descriptions.German: Rufe die Geister der Natur herbei, um Gegner in deiner Nähe anzugreifen. Entzieht Gegnern Gesundheit und Mana und kehrt mit einer <color=#49A5FFFF>Überladung</color> zu dir zurück.
descriptions.Russian: Призовите духов природы, которые атакуют ближайших врагов, высасывают их здоровье и ману, а возвращаясь, дают вам <color=#49A5FFFF>перегрузку</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memanggil roh alam untuk menyerang musuh di sekitar dengan mengisap HP dan mana mereka, lalu memberikan <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color> saat kembali kepadamu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Invoca o espírito da natureza para atacar os inimigos próximos, sugando a vida e o mana deles e fornecendo <color=#49A5FFFF>"Sobrecarga"</color> no retorno.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Invoca a los espíritus de la naturaleza para que ataquen a los enemigos cercanos, les roben su salud y maná, y otorguen <color=#49A5FFFF>Sobrecarga</color> al regresar a ti.

name: Fathomless Deep

names.Japanese: エンドレスユニバース
names.Thai: ลึก​สุด​หยั่งถึง

description: The max stacks of <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> you can inflict is increased. Whenever a non-Dark Ailment on an enemy ends, it has a chance to be refreshed as a <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color>.

descriptions.English: The max stacks of <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> you can inflict is increased. Whenever a non-Dark Ailment on an enemy ends, it has a chance to be refreshed as a <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升<color=#ab87ca>黑暗异常</color>的上限，对敌人造成其他的属性异常结束时，有概率转变为<color=#ab87ca>黑暗异常</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 提升<color=#ab87ca>黑暗異常</color>的上限，對敵人造成其他的屬性異常結束時，有概率轉變為<color=#ab87ca>黑暗異常</color>
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>闇異常</color>の上限を上げ、敵に付与するその他の状態異常は効果終了時に一定確率で<color=#ab87ca>闇異常</color>に変化する
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>암흑 이상</color> 최대치가 증가하고, 적에게 가한 다른 속성 이상이 종료될 때 일정 확률로 <color=#ab87ca>암흑 이상</color>으로 변경된다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tăng giới hạn <color=#ab87ca>Hắc Ám Bất Thường</color>, khi gây ra thuộc tính bất thường khác kết thúc sẽ có xác suất chuyển thành <color=#ab87ca>Hắc Ám Bất Thường</color>
descriptions.Thai: ชั้น​ทับ​ซ้อน​สูงสุด​ของ<color=#ab87ca>​อาการ​มืด</color>​ ​ความเสียหาย​ได้มา​ก​ขึ้น​เมื่อใด​ก็ตาม​ที่​สถานะ​ที่​ไม่ใช่​อาการ​มืด​ของ​ศัตรู​สิ้นสุดลง​ ​จะ​มีโอกาส​รี​เฟรช​เป็น​ ​<color=#ab87ca>​อาการ​มืด</color>
descriptions.French: Le nombre d’instances d’<color=#ab87ca>altérations Ténèbres</color> que vous pouvez infliger est augmenté. Quand une altération non-Ténèbres affectant un ennemi prend fin, il y a une chance qu’elle soit renouvelée en tant qu’<color=#ab87ca>altération Ténèbres</color>.
descriptions.German: Die maximale Anzahl Stapel an <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelschwächung</color>, die du zufügen kannst, wird erhöht. Immer wenn eine Nicht-Dunkelschwächung bei einem Gegner endet, besteht die Chance, dass sie als <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelschwächung</color> aktualisiert wird.
descriptions.Russian: Повышается максимальное количество зарядов <color=#ab87ca>черной хвори</color>, которое вы можете наложить. Каждый раз, когда действие хвори, не являющейся черной, заканчивается, есть шанс повторно наложить ее в виде <color=#ab87ca>черной хвори</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Meningkatkan jumlah maksimal tumpukan <color=#ab87ca>Infeksi Kegelapan</color> yang bisa kamu berikan. Setiap kali Infeksi non-Kegelapan pada musuh berakhir, ada peluang untuk disegarkan sebagai <color=#ab87ca>Infeksi Kegelapan</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): O máximo de pilhas de <color=#ab87ca>Condição Escuridão</color> que você pode infligir é aumentado. Sempre que uma Condição que não seja Escuridão em um inimigo termina, ela tem a chance de ser renovada como <color=#ab87ca>Condição Escuridão</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Incrementa la cantidad máxima de <color=#ab87ca>alteraciones de oscuridad</color> acumuladas que puedes infligir. Cuando termina una alteración no oscura en un enemigo, tiene la posibilidad de recargarse como <color=#ab87ca>alteración de oscuridad</color>.

name: Avalanche Ram

names.Thai: พายุ​หิมะ​พุ่งชน

description: Locks a percentage of mana to imbue your shield with the power of frost, inflicting <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> upon enemies that attack you and causing your <color=#49A5FFFF>Shield Bashes</color> to generate <color=#49A5FFFF>Freezing Blasts</color>.

descriptions.English: Locks a percentage of mana to imbue your shield with the power of frost, inflicting <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> upon enemies that attack you and causing your <color=#49A5FFFF>Shield Bashes</color> to generate <color=#49A5FFFF>Freezing Blasts</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用能量上限，向盾牌附着冰霜之力：被攻击时对敌人附着<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷异常</color>，使用<color=#49A5FFFF>盾击</color>时会附带<color=#49A5FFFF>冰霜冲击</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用能量上限，向盾牌附著冰霜之力：被攻擊時對敵人附著<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷異常</color>，使用<color=#49A5FFFF>盾擊</color>時會附帶<color=#49A5FFFF>冰霜衝擊</color>
descriptions.Japanese: マナ上限を消費し、盾に氷の力を与える。攻撃を受ける時に敵に<color=#49A5FFFF>氷異常</color>を付与する。<color=#49A5FFFF>盾撃</color>を使用する時に同時に<color=#49A5FFFF>フリージングブラスト</color>を発動する
descriptions.Korean: 일정 마나를 차지해 방패에 얼음의 힘을 부여한다. 피격 시 적에게 <color=#49A5FFFF>냉기 상태이상</color>을 부여하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>방패 타격</color> 사용 시 <color=#49A5FFFF>얼음 충격</color>을 동반한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm giữ tối đa năng lượng, gắn sức mạnh băng giá vào khiên: gắn <color=#49A5FFFF>Đóng Băng Bất Thường</color> vào kẻ địch khi bị tấn công, khi dùng <color=#49A5FFFF>Đòn Khiên</color> sẽ kèm theo <color=#49A5FFFF>Xung Kích Băng Sương</color>
descriptions.Thai: ล็อก​พลัง​เวท​เปอร์เซ็นต์​หนึ่ง​เพื่อ​ใช้​พลัง​เยือกแข็ง​อาบ​โล่​ ​มอบ<color=#49A5FFFF>​อาการ​หนาว</color>​ใส่​ศัตรู​ที่มา​โจมตี​คุณ​ ​และ​ทำให้<color=#49A5FFFF>​โล่​กระแทก</color>​ของ​คุณ​สร้าง<color=#49A5FFFF>​ระเบิด​พลัง​เยือกแข็ง</color>​ได้
descriptions.French: Verrouille un pourcentage de mana pour imprégner votre bouclier du pouvoir du givre, infligeant l'<color=#49A5FFFF>altération Froid</color> aux ennemis qui vous attaquent et rendant vos <color=#49A5FFFF>Coups de bouclier</color> capables de générer des <color=#49A5FFFF>ondes givrantes</color>.
descriptions.German: Sperrt einen Teil des Manas, um deinem Schild die Macht des Frosts zu verleihen. Verursacht <color=#49A5FFFF>Kälteschwächung</color> bei Gegnern, die dich angreifen, und deine <color=#49A5FFFF>Schildschläge</color> erzeugen <color=#49A5FFFF>Eisige Explosionen</color>.
descriptions.Russian: Блокирует определенную часть очков маны, чтобы наполнить ваш щит силой мороза. Вызывает <color=#49A5FFFF>холодящую хворь</color> у врагов, которые нападают на вас, и позволяет вашим <color=#49A5FFFF>ударам щитом</color> накапливать <color=#49A5FFFF>замораживающие взрывы</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengunci persentase mana untuk mengisi perisaimu dengan kekuatan beku, Memberikan <color=#49A5FFFF>Infeksi Dingin</color> pada musuh yang menyerangmu dan menyebabkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Shield Bash</color> untuk menghasilkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Freezing Blast</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Bloqueia uma porcentagem de mana para imbuir seu escudo com o poder do gelo, causando <color=#49A5FFFF>Condição Gelo</color> nos inimigos que o atacarem e fazendo com que suas <color=#49A5FFFF>Pancadas com Escudo</color> gerem <color=#49A5FFFF>Explosões Congelantes</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Bloquea un porcentaje de maná para infundir tu escudo con el poder del hielo e inflige <color=#49A5FFFF>alteración de frío</color> a los enemigos que te ataquen. También hace que la <color=#49A5FFFF>Embestida de escudos</color> genere <color=#49A5FFFF>estallidos de congelación</color>.

name: Thundersledge

names.Thai: ค้อน​สายฟ้า

description: Throw out hammers of thunder that encircle you and attack enemies. The number of hammers is increased when you have full <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.

descriptions.English: Throw out hammers of thunder that encircle you and attack enemies. The number of hammers is increased when you have full <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 扔出围绕自身的雷电锤攻击敌人，<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>充盈时数量增加
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 扔出圍繞自身的雷電錘攻擊敵人，<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>充盈時數量增加
descriptions.Japanese: 周りに雷の鎚を投げて敵を攻撃する。十分な<color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>を持つ時に雷の鎚の数が倍になる
descriptions.Korean: 자신의 주변에 번개 망치를 던져 적을 공격하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>「결심」</color>이 가득차면 수량이 증가한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Ném Búa Sấm Sét ra xung quanh để tấn công kẻ địch, <color=#49A5FFFF>[Quyết Tâm]</color> dồi dào sẽ được tăng số lượng
descriptions.Thai: ขว้างค้อน​แห่ง​สายฟ้า​ที่​ล้อมรอบ​ตัว​คุณ​และ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ ​จำนวน​ค้อน​เพิ่มขึ้น​เมื่อ​คุณมี​เอฟเฟกต์<color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>​เต็ม
descriptions.French: Lancez une tempête de marteaux et d'éclairs qui vous encerclent et attaquent les ennemis. Le nombre de marteaux augmente lorsque votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color> est remplie.
descriptions.German: Schleudere Donnerhämmer, die dich umkreisen und deine Gegner angreifen. Die Anzahl der Hämmer wird erhöht, wenn du volle <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color> hast.
descriptions.Russian: Вас окружают громовые молоты, атакующие врагов. Количество молотов увеличивается, когда ваша <color=#49A5FFFF>решимость</color> на максимуме.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melempar palu guntur yang mengelilingimu dan menyerang musuh. Jumlah palu bertambah saat sudah memilik <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> penuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Arremessa martelos de trovão que cercam você e atacam os inimigos. O número de martelos aumenta quando sua <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color> estiver completa.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Lanza martillos de truenos que te rodean y atacan a los enemigos. La cantidad de martillos aumenta cuando tienes toda la <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color>.

name: Elemental Equilibrium
description: Attacking enemies afflicted with an elemental ailment has a chance to lower their resistance for that element.

descriptions.English: Attacking enemies afflicted with an elemental ailment has a chance to lower their resistance for that element.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击元素异常状态下的敌人有概率降低目标的元素抗性

name: Excantation: Astral Phenomena

names.Japanese: リバース・アストラルウェザー
names.Thai: คาถา​:​ ​ปรากฏการณ์​ของ​ดาว

description: When active, your elemental damage and skill cost are both increased, and each time your mana regens, it is actually drained instead.

descriptions.English: When active, your elemental damage and skill cost are both increased, and each time your mana regens, it is actually drained instead.
descriptions.Chinese: 开启后提升施放技能的消耗和属性伤害，能量恢复会转变为等额的能量失去
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 開啟後提升施放技能的消耗和屬性傷害，能量恢復會轉變為等額的能量失去
descriptions.Japanese: 発動後、スキル発動時の消費とエレメンタルダメージがアップし、マナ回復効果はマナ減少効果になる
descriptions.Korean: 개방 후 발동 스킬의 소모와 속성 대미지가 증가하고, 마나 회복 후 동일한 수치의 마나를 잃는다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Sau khi bật, sẽ tăng mức tiêu hao và ST Thuộc Tính của kỹ năng thi triển, năng lượng phục hồi sẽ được chuyển thành lượng năng lượng tổn thất tương đương
descriptions.Thai: เมื่อ​ใช้งาน​ ​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​และ​ค่า​ทักษะ​ของ​คุณ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ ​และ​ทุกครั้งที่​ฟื้นฟู​พลัง​เวท​ ​พลัง​เวท​จะ​ถูก​ระบาย​ออก​แทน
descriptions.French: Lorsque ce talent est actif, vos dégâts élémentaires et le coût de vos talents sont tous deux augmentés, et chaque fois que vous regagnez du mana, vous en perdez à la place.
descriptions.German: Wenn dies aktiv ist, werden sowohl der Elementarschaden als auch die Fertigkeitskosten erhöht, und jedes Mal, wenn sich das Mana regeneriert, wird es stattdessen abgezogen.
descriptions.Russian: При активации навыка ваш урон от стихий и стоимость навыков повышаются. А мана в это время утекает, а не восстанавливается.
descriptions.Indonesian: Saat aktif, Damage Elemental dan biaya skill ditingkatkan, setiap kali mana pulih, maka malah akan berkurang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Quando ativo, o Dano Elemental e o custo da habilidade são aumentados e, cada vez que a mana é regenerada, ela é drenada.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Mientras esté activo, tu daño elemental y el costo de tus habilidades aumentan, y cada vez que regeneras tu maná en realidad se drena.

name: Cold Blood

names.Thai: เลือดเย็น

description: Deal more damage to enemies on low life. <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleeding</color> enemies take Cold Damage instead.

descriptions.English: Deal more damage to enemies on low life. <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleeding</color> enemies take Cold Damage instead.
descriptions.Chinese: 对生命值低的敌人造成更多伤害。将<color=#49A5FFFF>「流血」</color>转变为冰属性效果
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 對生命值低的敵人造成更多傷害。將<color=#49A5FFFF>「流血」</color>轉變為冰屬性效果
descriptions.Japanese: HPの低い敵へのダメージが上がる。<color=#49A5FFFF>「出血」</color>を氷属性の効果に変える
descriptions.Korean: 생명력이 낮은 적에게 더 많은 대미지를 준다. <color=#49A5FFFF>"출혈"</color>을 얼음 속성 효과로 전환한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Gây nhiều ST hơn lên kẻ địch có HP thấp. Chuyển <color=#49A5FFFF>"Mất Máu"</color> thành hiệu ứng thuộc tính băng
descriptions.Thai: สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​มากขึ้น​แต่​ศัตรู​ที่​พลัง​ชีวิต​เหลือ​น้อย​ ​ศัตรู​ที่<color=#49A5FFFF>​เลือด​ออก</color>​รับ​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ความ​เย็น​แทนที่
descriptions.French: Vous infligez plus de dégâts aux ennemis qui ont peu de vie. Les ennemis victimes de <color=#49A5FFFF>Saignement</color> subissent des dégâts de froid à la place.
descriptions.German: Du fügst Gegnern mit wenig Leben höheren Schaden zu. Gegner mit <color=#49A5FFFF>Blutung</color> erleiden stattdessen Kälteschaden.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наносите больше урона противникам с малым запасом здоровья. <color=#49A5FFFF>Истекающие кровью</color> противники вместо этого получают урон от холода.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memberikan lebih banyak damage pada musuh dengan HP rendah. Musuh dengan <color=#49A5FFFF>Bleed</color> menerima Damage Dingin.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Cause mais dano aos inimigos com pouca vida. Inimigos sofrendo <color=#49A5FFFF>Sangramento</color> recebem Dano de Gelo em vez disso.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Infliges más daño a los enemigos con poca vida. Los enemigos bajo el efecto de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sangrado</color> reciben daño frío.

name: Survival of the Fittest

names.Thai: การคัดเลือก​โดยธรรมชาติ

description: Your damage is increased against a target for each stack of <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Shock</color>, and<color=#49A5FFFF>Poison</color> Ailment on them.

descriptions.English: Your damage is increased against a target for each stack of <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Shock</color>, and<color=#49A5FFFF>Poison</color> Ailment on them.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标身上每层<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>电击</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>毒素</color>异常都会使伤害提升
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 目標身上每層<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>電擊</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>毒素</color>異常都會使傷害提升
descriptions.Japanese: 目標が<color=#49A5FFFF>氷</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>電撃</color>、<color=#49A5FFFF>毒異常</color>を1つ持つごとに、ダメージが上がる
descriptions.Korean: 목표가 보유한 <color=#49A5FFFF>냉기</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>전기</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>독</color> 이상 스택마다 대미지가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Mỗi tầng <color=#49A5FFFF>Đóng Băng</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Điện Kích</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Độc Tố Bất Thường</color> trên mục tiêu đều sẽ tăng ST
descriptions.Thai: ความเสียหาย​ของ​คุณ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ต่อ​เป้าหมาย​ใน​แต่ละ​ส​แ​ต็​ค​ที่​มี​อาการ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​เย็น</color>​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​ช็อก</color>​ ​และ<color=#49A5FFFF>​พิษ</color>​ต่อ​พวก​มัน
descriptions.French: Les dégâts que vous infligez à une cible sont augmentés pour chaque instance d'altération <color=#49A5FFFF>Froid</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Électrocution</color> et <color=#49A5FFFF>Poison</color> qu'elle subit.
descriptions.German: Dein Schaden gegen ein Ziel wird für jeden Stapel von <color=#49A5FFFF>Kälte-</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Elektro-</color> und <color=#49A5FFFF>Giftschwächung</color> auf dem Ziel erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наносите цели больше урона за каждый действующий на нее заряд <color=#49A5FFFF>холодящей</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>шоковой</color> и <color=#49A5FFFF>отравляющей</color> хвори.
descriptions.Indonesian: Damage-mu meningkat terhadap target untuk setiap tumpukan <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Shock</color>, dan<color=#49A5FFFF>Infeksi</color> Racun pada mereka.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): O dano que você causa ao alvo é aumentado por cada pilha de Condição <color=#49A5FFFF>Gelo</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Eletricidade</color> e <color=#49A5FFFF>Veneno</color> sobre ele.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu daño contra un objetivo aumenta por cada acumulación de Alteración de <color=#49A5FFFF>Frío</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>Eléctrica</color> y <color=#49A5FFFF>Venenosa</color> sobre ellos.

name: Glacial Armor
description: Gain a continuous stacking bonus to stats when not using skills.

descriptions.English: Gain a continuous stacking bonus to stats when not using skills.
descriptions.Chinese: 在不使用技能时，获得不断堆叠的属性加成

name: Elemental Beam

names.Thai: ลำแสง​ธาตุ

description: Magically channel a focused beam of primordial energy that alternates between dealing Fire, Shock, and Cold Damage.

descriptions.English: Magically channel a focused beam of primordial energy that alternates between dealing Fire, Shock, and Cold Damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 用法术持续发射元素激光，交替造成火、雷、冰元素伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 用法術持續發射元素鐳射，交替造成火、雷、冰元素傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 魔法で持続的にエレメントレザーを発射し続け、炎、雷、氷の順番にエレメンタルダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 마법으로 원소 레이저를 지속적으로 발사하여 화염, 번개, 얼음 원소 대미지를 번갈아가며 입힌다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Dùng phép thuật liên tục bắn ra laser nguyên tố, luân phiên gây ST nguyên tố lửa, sấm sét và băng
descriptions.Thai: ใช้​เวทมนตร์​ยิง​ลำแสง​พลังงาน​ดึกดำบรรพ์​ที่​สลับ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ธาตุ​ไฟ​ ​ไฟ​ช็อต​ ​และ​ความ​เย็น
descriptions.French: Lance un sort pour canaliser un rayon concentré d'énergie primordiale qui inflige tour à tour des dégâts de feu, électriques et de froid.
descriptions.German: Du erzeugst auf magische Weise einen konzentrierten Strahl urtümlicher Energie, der abwechselnd Feuer-, Elektro- und Kälteschaden verursacht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы выпускаете луч первобытной энергии, который наносит урон от огня, молнии или холода.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menembakkan laser energi primordial yang berubah bergantian memberikan damage Api, Syok, dan Dingin.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Canaliza magicamente um raio concentrado de energia primordial que alterna entre Dano de Fogo, Eletricidade e Gelo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Canalizas mágicamente un rayo concentrado de energía primordial que inflige daño ígneo, eléctrico y frío de manera alternada.

name: Elemental Overload

names.Thai: ธาตุ​โอเวอร์​โหลด

description: Weapon Attack Power is converted to Magic Power. When using skills, you receive stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color>, that when full, transforms into <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color>, which enhances stats and causes your melee attacks to release elemental blasts. You cannot become <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> again for a short time after the effect expires.

descriptions.English: Weapon Attack Power is converted to Magic Power. When using skills, you receive stacks of <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color>, that when full, transforms into <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color>, which enhances stats and causes your melee attacks to release elemental blasts. You cannot become <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> again for a short time after the effect expires.
descriptions.Chinese: 武器的攻击力转化为法术强度；使用技能时获得<color=#49A5FFFF>「过载」</color>，满层<color=#49A5FFFF>「过载」</color>转化为<color=#49A5FFFF>「超载」</color>，强化自身且近战攻击附带元素爆破，随后短时间内无法<color=#49A5FFFF>「超载」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 武器的攻擊力轉化為法術強度；使用技能時獲得<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>，滿層<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>轉化為<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>，強化自身且近戰攻擊附帶元素爆破，隨後短時間內無法<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 武器の攻撃力は魔法攻撃力に変換する。スキル発動時に<color=#49A5FFFF>「暴走」</color>を獲得し、<color=#49A5FFFF>「暴走」</color>が上限に達すると<color=#49A5FFFF>「超暴走」</color>になり、自身は強化され、近接攻撃は元素爆破を追加する。その後、暫くの間<color=#49A5FFFF>「超暴走」</color>になれない
descriptions.Korean: 무기 공격력이 마법 강도로 전환된다. 스킬 사용 시 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과전류」</color>를 획득하며, 최대 스택의 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과전류」</color>는 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과부하」</color>로 전환되고, 자신을 강화한다. 또한, 근접 공격에 원소 폭파가 부여되며 이후 짧은 시간 내에 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과부하」</color>를 발동할 수 없다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Lực Công của Vũ Khí chuyển hóa thành Cường Độ Phép Thuật; <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quá Tải"</color>, <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quá Tải"</color> đầy tầng chuyển hóa thành <color=#49A5FFFF>"Siêu Tải"</color>, cường hóa bản thân và tấn công cận chiến kèm Nổ Nguyên Tố, sau đó không thể <color=#49A5FFFF>"Siêu Tải"</color> trong thời gian ngắn
descriptions.Thai: พลัง​โจม​ต​ของ​อา​วุ​ธี​จะ​ถูก​แปลง​เป็น​พลัง​เวทมนตร์​ ​เมื่อ​ใช้​ส​กิล​จะ​ได้รับ​จำนวน<color=#49A5FFFF>​โอเวอร์​โหลด</color>​ ​สะสม​ที่​เมื่อ​เต็ม​แล้ว​จะ​เปลี่ยนเป็น<color=#49A5FFFF>​ซู​เปอร์​ชาร์จ</color>​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​ช่วย​เสริม​พลัง​สถานะ​และ​ทำให้​การ​โจมตี​ประชิด​ปล่อย​ระเบิด​ธาตุ​ ​คุณ​จะ​ไม่​สามารถ​กลายเป็น<color=#49A5FFFF>​ซู​เปอร์​ชาร์จ</color>​ ​ได้​อีก​ใน​ช่วงเวลา​สั้นๆ​ ​หลังจากที่​เอฟเฟกต์​หมด​ไป​แล้ว
descriptions.French: La puissance d'attaque de l'arme est convertie en puissance magique. Lorsque vous utilisez des compétences, vous recevez des instances de <color=#49A5FFFF>surchargé</color> qui, une fois pleines, se transforment en <color=#49A5FFFF>survolté</color>, ce qui renforce les stats et permet à vos attaques de mêlée de générer des explosions élémentaires. Vous ne pouvez plus redevenir <color=#49A5FFFF>survolté</color> pendant une courte période après la disparition de l'effet.
descriptions.German: Angriffskraft der Waffen wird in Magiekraft umgewandelt. Beim Einsatz von Fertigkeiten erhältst du Stapel von <color=#49A5FFFF>Überladen</color>, das sich, wenn es voll ist, in <color=#49A5FFFF>Hochaufgeladen</color> verwandelt, was Attribute verbessert und dazu führt, dass deine Nahkampfangriffe Elementarwellen freisetzen. Du kannst für kurze Zeit nicht noch einmal <color=#49A5FFFF>Hochaufgeladen</color> werden, nachdem der Effekt nachgelassen hat.
descriptions.Russian: Сила атаки оружия становится силой магии. При использовании навыков вы получаете заряды <color=#49A5FFFF>перегрузки</color>. Получив <color=#49A5FFFF>суперзаряд</color>, вы улучшаете показатели и наносите стихийные удары в ближнем бою. Вы не сможете повторно получить <color=#49A5FFFF>суперзаряд</color> в течение некоторого времени после прекращения действия эффекта.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kekuatan Serangan Senjata diubah menjadi Kekuatan Sihir. Saat menggunakan skill, kamu menerima tumpukan <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color>, yang bila penuh, berubah menjadi <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color>, yang meningkatkan statistik dan menyebabkan serangan jarak dekatmu melepaskan ledakan elemen. Kamu tidak bisa menjadi <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> lagi untuk waktu yang singkat setelah efeknya hilang.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): O Poder de Ataque da Arma é convertido em Poder Mágico. Ao usar habilidades, você recebe pilhas de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sobrecarregado</color>, que quando cheio, se transforma em <color=#49A5FFFF>Super Carga</color>, o que aprimora seus atributos e faz com que seus ataques corpo a corpo liberem explosões elementais. Você não poderá ativar a <color=#49A5FFFF>Super Carga</color> novamente por um curto período de tempo após o efeito expirar.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): El poder de ataque del arma se convierte en poder mágico. Al usar habilidades, recibes acumulaciones de <color=#49A5FFFF>sobrecargado</color>, que, cuando se llenan, se transforman en <color=#49A5FFFF>supercargado</color>, que mejora las estadísticas y hace que tus ataques cuerpo a cuerpo liberen estallidos elementales. No puedes quedar <color=#49A5FFFF>supercargado</color> de nuevo durante cierto tiempo después de que el efecto desaparezca.

name: Electromorphosis

names.Thai: อิ​เล็ก​โทรม​อ​ร์​โฟ​ซิส

description: Transform into an invulnerable ball of lightning with increased movement speed that electrocutes surrounding enemies.

descriptions.English: Transform into an invulnerable ball of lightning with increased movement speed that electrocutes surrounding enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 化身球形闪电攻击周围敌人，提升移动速度并规避伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 化身球形閃電攻擊周圍敵人，提升移動速度並規避傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 電気玉になって周りの敵を攻撃し、移動速度を上げてダメージを回避する
descriptions.Korean: 구상번개로 변해 주변 적들을 공격하고, 이동 속도와 대미지 회피가 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Hóa thân thành Bóng Sấm Sét tấn công kẻ địch xung quanh, tăng Tốc độ di chuyển và né ST
descriptions.Thai: แปลงร่าง​เป็น​ลูกบอล​สายฟ้า​อมตะ​ที่​เพิ่ม​ความเร็ว​การวิ่ง​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​ช็อต​ไฟฟ้า​ศัตรู​ใกล้เคียง
descriptions.French: Vous vous transformez en une sphère de foudre invulnérable, qui se déplace plus vite et électrocute les ennemis à proximité.
descriptions.German: Du verwandelst dich in eine unverwundbare Blitzkugel mit erhöhtem Bewegungstempo, die umstehende Gegner mit Stromschlägen malträtiert.
descriptions.Russian: Вы превращаетесь в неуязвимую шаровую молнию, двигаетесь быстрее и наносите урон током противникам вокруг.
descriptions.Indonesian: Berubah menjadi bola petir kebal dengan kecepatan gerak ditingkatkan dan menyetrum musuh di sekitar.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você se transforma em uma bola de luz invulnerável com maior velocidade de movimento que eletrocuta os inimigos ao redor.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Te transformas en una bola de rayos invulnerable con mayor velocidad de movimiento que electrocuta a los enemigos circundantes.

name: Coronal Flare

names.Thai: ยักษ์​โล​กันต์

description: Conjure a firestorm that absorbs <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> to gain increased size.

descriptions.English: Conjure a firestorm that absorbs <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> to gain increased size.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放一个火焰风暴，火焰风暴吸收<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>后提升风暴大小
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 釋放一個火焰風暴，火焰風暴吸收<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>後提升風暴大小
descriptions.Japanese: 火炎の嵐を呼び起こす、火炎の嵐は<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>を吸収して拡大する
descriptions.Korean: 화염 폭풍을 1개 발동한다. 화염 폭풍은 <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>을 흡수한 후 더 커진다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Thi triển 1 Bão Lửa, sau khi hấp thụ <color=#49A5FFFF>"Ngọn Lửa"</color> sẽ tăng kích thước của cơn bão
descriptions.Thai: เรียก​พายุ​ไฟ​ที่​ดูดซับ<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>​เพื่อ​เพิ่มขนาด
descriptions.French: Invoque une tempête de feu qui absorbe les <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> pour gagner en taille.
descriptions.German: Du beschwörst einen Feuersturm, der <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> verzehrt, um an Größe zu gewinnen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы призываете огненную бурю, которая поглощает <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color>, чтобы увеличиваться в размерах.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memunculkan badai api yang menyerap <color=#49A5FFFF>Bara</color> untuk memperbesar ukuran.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Conjure uma tempestade de fogo que absorve <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> para aumentar de tamanho.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Invocas una tormenta de fuego que absorbe <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color> para aumentar su tamaño.

name: Ice Boomerang

names.Thai: บูม​เมอ​แรง​น้ำแข็ง

description: Hurl an ice boomerang that attacks enemies twice. Upon reaching the farthest point of its path, the boomerang launches fragments to deal additional damage.

descriptions.English: Hurl an ice boomerang that attacks enemies twice. Upon reaching the farthest point of its path, the boomerang launches fragments to deal additional damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 释放冰晶的回旋镖对敌人进行两次攻击，到达最远距离时还会发射碎片造成额外伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 釋放冰晶的迴旋鏢對敵人進行兩次攻擊，到達最遠距離時還會發射碎片造成額外傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 氷のブーメランで敵を二回攻撃する。一番遠い位置を討伐する時に氷晶の欠片を発射して追加ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 얼음 부메랑을 던져 적을 2회 공격하고, 최대 거리에 도달 시 조각을 발사해 추가 대미지를 준다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Phóng Phi Tiêu của Tinh Thể Băng tấn công kẻ địch 2 lần, khi đến khoảng cách xa nhất sẽ bắn các mảnh gây thêm ST
descriptions.Thai: ขว้าง​บูม​เมอ​แรง​น้ำแข็ง​ที่​โจมตี​ศัตรู​สอง​ครั้ง​ ​เมื่อถึง​จุด​ที่​ไกล​ที่สุด​ของ​เส้นทาง​ ​บูม​เมอ​แรง​จะ​ปล่อย​เศษ​ออกมา​เพื่อ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​เพิ่มเติม
descriptions.French: Lance un boomerang de glace qui attaque deux fois les ennemis. Lorsque le boomerang atteint le point le plus éloigné de sa trajectoire, des fragments se détachent pour infliger des dégâts supplémentaires.
descriptions.German: Du schleuderst einen Eisbumerang, der Gegner zweimal angreift. Wenn der Bumerang den äußersten Punkt seiner Flugbahn erreicht, werden Fragmente freigesetzt, um zusätzlichen Schaden zu verursachen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы метаете ледяной бумеранг, который дважды атакует врагов. Достигнув дальней точки по траектории полета, оружие выпускает осколки, которые наносят дополнительный урон.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melemparkan bumerang es yang menyerang musuh dua kali. Setelah mencapai titik terjauh dari jalurnya, bumerang meluncurkan pecahan untuk memberikan kerusakan tambahan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Arremessa um bumerangue de gelo que ataca os inimigos duas vezes. Ao atingir o ponto mais distante de seu caminho, o bumerangue lança fragmentos que causam dano adicional.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Arrojas un bumerán de hielo que ataca a los enemigos dos veces. Al alcanzar el punto más lejano del recorrido, el bumerán lanza fragmentos que infligen daño adicional.

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Excantation: Iridescence

names.Japanese: リバース・レイディアンス
names.Thai: คาถา​:​ ​ความ​แวววาว

description: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to send out a chain of dark matter shockwaves.

descriptions.English: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to send out a chain of dark matter shockwaves.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，释放一组暗物质冲击波
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，釋放一組暗物質衝擊波
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>リバースマナを消費</color>して、ダークマターによる衝撃波を放つ
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>역으로 마나를 소모해</color> 암흑 물질 충격파를 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Tiêu hao năng lượng theo hướng ngược lại</color>, thi triển một loại sóng xung kích vật chất tối
descriptions.Thai: คุณ<color=#ab87ca>​ใช้​พลัง​เวท​เชิงลบ</color>​ ​เพื่อ​ส่ง​คลื่น​กระแทก​สสาร​มืด​ต่อเนื่อง​ออกมา
descriptions.French: Vous <color=#ab87ca>consommez du mana négatif</color> pour libérer une succession d'ondes de choc de matière noire.
descriptions.German: Du <color=#ab87ca>verbrauchst negatives Mana</color>, um eine Kette von Schockwellen aus dunkler Materie auszusenden.
descriptions.Russian: Вы <color=#ab87ca>расходуете отрицательную ману</color>, чтобы послать цепочку ударных волн из темной материи.
descriptions.Indonesian: Anda <color=#ab87ca>mengonsumsi mana negatif</color> untuk mengirimkan rantai gelombang kejut materi gelap.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você <color=#ab87ca>consome mana negativa</color> para enviar uma cadeia de ondas de choque de matéria escura.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Consumes maná negativo</color> para expulsar una cadena de ondas de materia oscura.

name: The Axel

names.Thai: เอ็ก​เซล

description: Manipulate the smoothness of ice to enhance your dodging capability, and retaliate against foes with icicles on successful dodges.

descriptions.English: Manipulate the smoothness of ice to enhance your dodging capability, and retaliate against foes with icicles on successful dodges.
descriptions.Chinese: 用光滑的冰强化闪避能力，并在闪避时以冰晶回击敌人
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 用光滑的冰強化閃避能力，並在閃避時以冰晶回擊敵人
descriptions.Japanese: 滑らかな氷で回避能力を強化し、回避する時に氷晶で敵を攻撃する
descriptions.Korean: 매끄러운 얼음으로 회피 능력을 강화하고, 회피 시 얼음 수정으로 적에게 반격한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Dùng tảng băng mịn cường hóa năng lực né đòn, khi né đòn dùng Tinh Thể Băng phản đòn kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: ควบคุม​ความลื่น​บน​น้ำแข็ง​เพื่อ​เพิ่ม​การ​หลบหลีก​ ​และ​โต้ตอบ​ศัตรู​ด้วย​แท่ง​น้ำแข็ง​เมื่อ​หลบหลีก​สำเร็จ
descriptions.French: Vous manipulez la glace lisse pour améliorer vos esquives. Après une esquive réussie, vous ripostez en lançant des stalactites.
descriptions.German: Du manipulierst die Glattheit des Eises, um deine Ausweichmöglichkeit zu verbessern, und greifst nach dem Ausweichen Gegner mit Eiszapfen an.
descriptions.Russian: Вы ловко скользите по льду и лучше уклоняетесь от атак, а также отвечаете врагам ударами сосулек при успешном уклонении.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memanipulasi licinnya es untuk meningkatkan kemampuan menghindar, dan membalas musuh dengan untaian es saat berhasil menghindar.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Manipule a suavidade do gelo para aumentar sua capacidade de esquiva e contra-atacar os inimigos com sincelos em esquivas bem-sucedidas.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Manipulas la suavidad del hielo para mejorar tu capacidad de esquivar y contratacas a los enemigos con estalactitas al esquivar con éxito.

name: Arc Blast
description: Electrocharged enemies create an electrical explosion upon death.

descriptions.English: Electrocharged enemies create an electrical explosion upon death.
descriptions.Chinese: 击败带电敌人触发电能爆炸

name: Thunderous Determination

names.Thai: สายฟ้า​ประธาน​พร

description: Each stack of <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> grants you bonus Shock and Cold Damage, more so when your <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> is at full.

descriptions.English: Each stack of <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> grants you bonus Shock and Cold Damage, more so when your <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> is at full.
descriptions.Chinese: 每层<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>能为你提供电击伤害加成与冰冷伤害加成，<color=#49A5FFFF>「决心」</color>充盈时效果增强
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 每層<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>能為你提供電擊傷害加成與冰冷傷害加成，<color=#49A5FFFF>「決心」</color>充盈時效果增強
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>1つにつき電撃ダメージと氷ダメージボーナスを獲得する、十分な<color=#49A5FFFF>「決意」</color>を持っている時、効果はさらに上がる
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>"결심"</color> 스택마다 전기 대미지 보너스와 냉기 대미지 보너스를 제공하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>"결심"</color>이 가득 차면 효과가 강화된다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Mỗi tầng <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quyết Tâm"</color> có thể cung cấp bonus ST Điện Kích và bonus ST Đóng Băng, khi <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quyết Tâm"</color> dồi dào sẽ tăng mạnh hiệu ứng
descriptions.Thai: <color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>​แต่ละครั้ง​ที่​สะสม​จะ​ได้รับ​โบนัส​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ไฟ​ช็อต​และ​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ความเย็น​ ​ซึ่ง​จะ​สูง​ขึ้น​มาก​เมื่อ<color=#49A5FFFF>​แน่วแน่</color>​เต็ม​หลอด
descriptions.French: Chaque instance de <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color> vous rapporte un bonus de dégâts électriques et de froid. Ce bonus est plus élevé si votre <color=#49A5FFFF>Résolution</color> est au maximum.
descriptions.German: Für jeden <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color>-Stapel erhältst du einen Bonus auf Elektro- und Kälteschaden. Dieser Effekt fällt stärker aus, wenn du über volle <color=#49A5FFFF>Entschlossenheit</color> verfügst.
descriptions.Russian: Каждый заряд <color=#49A5FFFF>«Решимости»</color> повышает ваш урон от холода и молнии, особенно если шкала <color=#49A5FFFF>решимости</color> заполнена.
descriptions.Indonesian: Setiap tumpuk <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> memberimu bonus Syok dan Damage Dingin, lebih banyak lagi saat <color=#49A5FFFF>Resolve</color> penuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Cada acúmulo de <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color> concede um bônus de dano de Eletricidade e Gelo, que é aumentado quando sua <color=#49A5FFFF>Determinação</color> está no máximo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Cada acumulación de <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color> te otorga daño eléctrico y daño frío adicional, más aún cuando la <color=#49A5FFFF>Tenacidad</color> está al máximo.

name: Boreal Flicker

names.Thai: ทะลวง​พริบตา

description: Blitz forward and deal up to 6 instances of Cold Damage to enemies.

descriptions.English: Blitz forward and deal up to 6 instances of Cold Damage to enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 突进并对敌人造成最多6次冰冷伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 突進並對敵人造成最多6次冰冷傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 突進して敵に最大6回の氷ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: 돌진하여 적에게 냉기 대미지를 최대 6회 준다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn công và tối đa gây 6 lần ST Đóng Băng lên kẻ địch
descriptions.Thai: พุ่ง​สวน​ไป​ข้างหน้า​และ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ความ​เย็น​ต่อ​ศัตรู​ 6 ​ครั้ง
descriptions.French: Vous foncez vers l'avant et infligez jusqu'à six instances de dégâts de froid aux ennemis.
descriptions.German: Du preschst blitzartig vor und fügst Gegnern bis zu 6-mal Kälteschaden zu.
descriptions.Russian: Вы совершаете рывок вперед и до 6 раз наносите урон от холода противникам.
descriptions.Indonesian: Melesat ke depan dan memberikan sampai dengan 6 kali Damage Dingin pad amusuh.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Realiza uma investida que causa até 6 instâncias de Dano de Gelo aos inimigos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Te desplazas hacia adelante e infliges daño frío hasta 6 veces.

name: Arc Blast

names.Thai: ระเบิด​อาร์ก

description: Attack surrounding targets, dealing Shock Damage thrice.

descriptions.English: Attack surrounding targets, dealing Shock Damage thrice.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击周围目标，造成3次电击伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 攻擊周圍目標，造成3次電擊傷害
descriptions.Japanese: 周りの目標を攻撃し、電撃ダメージを3回与える
descriptions.Korean: 주변 대상을 공격해 전기 대미지를 3회 준다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tấn công mục tiêu xung quanh, gây 3 lần ST Điện Kích
descriptions.Thai: โจมตี​เป้าหมาย​รอบๆ​ ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ไฟ​ช็อต​สาม​เท่า
descriptions.French: Vous attaquez les cibles à proximité en infligeant des dégâts électriques trois fois.
descriptions.German: Du greifst umstehende Gegner an und verursachst dabei 3-mal Elektroschaden.
descriptions.Russian: Вы атакуете цели вокруг, трижды нанося урон от молнии.
descriptions.Indonesian: Menyerang musuh di sekitar, memberikan Damage Syok tiga kali.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Ataca os alvos ao redor, causando Dano de Eletricidade três vezes.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Atacas a los objetivos circundantes, e infliges daño eléctrico tres veces.

name: Corona Discharge

names.Thai: ปลดปล่อย​โค​โร​นา

description: Harness a column of thunder to attack enemies. Instead of causing <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color>, this skill removes all <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color> and <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> effects from you to magnify its power.

descriptions.English: Harness a column of thunder to attack enemies. Instead of causing <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color>, this skill removes all <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color> and <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> effects from you to magnify its power.
descriptions.Chinese: 驱动雷柱攻击敌人，不产生<color=#49A5FFFF>「过载」</color>，反而移除所有<color=#49A5FFFF>「过载」</color>和<color=#49A5FFFF>「超载」</color>并使威力提升
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 驅動雷柱攻擊敵人，不產生<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>，反而移除所有<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>和<color=#49A5FFFF>「超載」</color>並使威力提升
descriptions.Japanese: 太い雷で敵を攻撃するが、<color=#49A5FFFF>「暴走」</color>にはならない。全ての<color=#49A5FFFF>「暴走」</color>と<color=#49A5FFFF>「超暴走」</color>を消費してダメージを上げる
descriptions.Korean: 번개 기둥으로 적을 공격하고, <color=#49A5FFFF>「과전류」</color>를 생성하지 않는다. 모든 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과전류」</color>와 <color=#49A5FFFF>「과부하」</color>를 제거하고 위력을 증가시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Điều khiển Cột Sét tấn công kẻ địch, không tạo ra <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quá Tải"</color>, thay vào đó xóa tất cả <color=#49A5FFFF>"Quá Tải"</color> và <color=#49A5FFFF>"Siêu Tải"</color> và giúp uy lực tăng lên
descriptions.Thai: ควบคุม​เสา​สายฟ้า​เพื่อ​โจมตี​ศัตรู​ ​แทนที่จะ​ทำให้เกิด​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​โอเวอร์​โหลด</color>​ ​ทักษะ​นี้​จะ​ลบ​เอฟเฟกต์​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​โอเวอร์​โหลด</color>​ ​และ​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​ซู​เปอร์​ชาร์จ</color>​ ​ทั้งหมด​เพื่อ​ขยาย​พลัง​ของ​มัน
descriptions.French: Exploitez une colonne de tonnerre pour attaquer les ennemis. Au lieu de provoquer <color=#49A5FFFF>Surcharge</color>, cette compétence vous retire tous vos effets <color=#49A5FFFF>Surchargé</color> et <color=#49A5FFFF>Survolté</color> pour amplifier sa puissance.
descriptions.German: Nutze eine Donnersäule, um Gegner anzugreifen. Anstatt <color=#49A5FFFF>Überladung</color> zu verursachen, entfernt diese Fertigkeit sämtliche <color=#49A5FFFF>Überladen</color>- und <color=#49A5FFFF>Hochaufgeladen</color>-Effekte von dir, um seine Kraft zu verstärken.
descriptions.Russian: Используйте гром, чтобы атаковать врагов. Вместо того, чтобы вызывать <color=#49A5FFFF>перегрузку</color>, этот навык набирает силу, поглощая эффекты <color=#49A5FFFF>перегрузки</color> и <color=#49A5FFFF>суперзаряда</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Manfaatkan kolom guntur untuk menyerang musuh. Bukannya menyebabkan <color=#49A5FFFF>Overload</color>, skill ini menghapus semua efek <color=#49A5FFFF>Overloaded</color> dan <color=#49A5FFFF>Supercharged</color> darimu untuk menggandakan kekuatannya.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Usa uma coluna de trovão para atacar os inimigos. Em vez de causar <color=#49A5FFFF>Sobrecarga</color>, esta habilidade remove todos os efeitos de <color=#49A5FFFF>Sobrecarga</color> e <color=#49A5FFFF>Super Carga</color> de você para ampliar seu poder.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Manipula una columna de trueno para atacar a los enemigos. En lugar de causar una <color=#49A5FFFF>sobrecarga</color>, esta habilidad elimina todos los efectos de <color=#49A5FFFF>sobrecargado</color> y <color=#49A5FFFF>supercargado</color> para que puedas aumentar su poder.

name: Pillar of Flame
description: Convoke a pillar of flame at the target location that inflicts damage over time.

descriptions.English: Convoke a pillar of flame at the target location that inflicts damage over time.
descriptions.Chinese: 在目标位置生成火柱造成持续伤害

name: Crystalline Panoply

names.Thai: เกราะ​ผลึก​คริสตัล

description: Your Defense is increased based on your Cold and Shock Resistance.

descriptions.English: Your Defense is increased based on your Cold and Shock Resistance.
descriptions.Chinese: 冰冷抗性和雷电抗性会提升你的防御值
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 冰冷抗性和雷電抗性會提升你的防禦值
descriptions.Japanese: 氷耐性と雷耐性に応じて防御力を上げる
descriptions.Korean: 얼음 냉기 저항과 번개 저항은 방어력을 증가시킨다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tính kháng băng và tính kháng sấm sét sẽ tăng mức phòng thủ của bạn
descriptions.Thai: พลัง​ป้องกัน​ของ​คุณ​เพิ่มขึ้น​ตาม​ค่า​ต้านทาน​ความ​เย็น​และ​ต้านทาน​ไฟ​ช็อต​ของ​คุณ
descriptions.French: Votre défense augmente en fonction de votre résistance au froid et votre résistance électrique.
descriptions.German: Deine Verteidigung wird basierend auf deiner Kälte- und Elektroresistenz erhöht.
descriptions.Russian: Ваша защита увеличивается в зависимости от вашего сопротивления холоду и электричеству.
descriptions.Indonesian: Pertahananmu meningkat berdasarkan Daya Tahan Dingin Syok milikmu.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Sua Defesa é aumentada com base na sua Resistência a Eletricidade e ao Frio.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu defensa aumenta en función de tu resistencia a la electricidad y al frío.

name: Elemental Power
description: Summon three extraplanar meteoroids to bombard the target area.

descriptions.English: Summon three extraplanar meteoroids to bombard the target area.
descriptions.Chinese: 目标位置落下三枚元素陨石

name: Charged Weapon
description: Accumulate charges each time you attack enemies. Once fully charged, the range of your next melee skill is significantly increased.

descriptions.English: Accumulate charges each time you attack enemies. Once fully charged, the range of your next melee skill is significantly increased.
descriptions.Chinese: 攻击敌人获得充能，当充能满时，下一次近战技能范围提升

name: Infinity Horizon

names.Japanese: インフィニティメディテーション
names.Thai: ขอบฟ้า​ไม่​สิ้นสุด

description: Your Magic Power progressively increases when you consecutively deal different types of elemental damage.

descriptions.English: Your Magic Power progressively increases when you consecutively deal different types of elemental damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 造成不重复的属性伤害时，法术强度会逐步提升
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 造成不重複的屬性傷害時，法術強度會逐步提升
descriptions.Japanese: 異なるエレメンタルダメージを与える時、魔法攻撃力は徐々にアップする
descriptions.Korean: 중복되지 않은 속성 대미지를 가할 때, 마법 강도가 점차 증가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi gây ST Thuộc Tính không lặp lại, Cường Độ Phép Thuật sẽ tăng dần
descriptions.Thai: พลัง​เวทมนตร์​ของ​คุณ​จะ​เพิ่มขึ้น​อย่างต่อเนื่อง​เมื่อ​คุณ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ธาตุ​ประเภท​ต่างๆ​ ​ติดต่อกัน
descriptions.French: Votre puissance magique augmente progressivement lorsque vous infligez consécutivement différents types de dégâts élémentaires.
descriptions.German: Deine Magiekraft erhöht sich progressiv, wenn du nacheinander verschiedene Arten von Elementarschaden verursachst.
descriptions.Russian: Ваша сила магии постепенно повышается, когда вы последовательно наносите различные типы урона от стихий.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kekuatan Sihir terus meningkat saat kamu memberikan jenis Damage Elemental berbeda secara berturut-turut.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Seu Poder Mágico aumenta progressivamente quando você causa consecutivamente diferentes tipos de Dano Elemental.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu poder mágico aumenta progresivamente a medida que infliges distintos tipos de daño elemental de forma consecutiva.

name: Endothermic Rupture

names.Thai: ระเบิด​น้ำแข็ง

description: Your <color=#49A5FFFF>Shock Damage</color> cause icicles to burst forth from victims. In addition, your <color=#49A5FFFF>Bludgeoning</color> attacks deal higher damage against enemies with <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> and cause a large amount of icicles to burst forth from them.

descriptions.English: Your <color=#49A5FFFF>Shock Damage</color> cause icicles to burst forth from victims. In addition, your <color=#49A5FFFF>Bludgeoning</color> attacks deal higher damage against enemies with <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> and cause a large amount of icicles to burst forth from them.
descriptions.Chinese: 造成的<color=#49A5FFFF>电击</color>伤害会激发冰锥碎片。<color=#49A5FFFF>打击</color>伤害对<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷异常</color>的敌人伤害更高，并爆发大量冰锥碎片
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 造成的<color=#49A5FFFF>電擊</color>傷害會激發冰錐碎片。<color=#49A5FFFF>打擊</color>傷害對<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷異常</color>的敵人傷害更高，並爆發大量冰錐碎片
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>電撃</color>ダメージを与える時は氷の矢を召喚。<color=#49A5FFFF>氷異常</color>の敵への<color=#49A5FFFF>打撃</color>ダメージが上がり、さらに多くの氷の矢を召喚する
descriptions.Korean: 가하는 <color=#49A5FFFF>전기</color> 대미지가 얼음 조각을 발동한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>타격</color> 대미지가 <color=#49A5FFFF>냉기 이상</color>의 적에게 가하는 대미지가 증가하고, 대량의 얼음 기둥 조각을 폭발시킨다
descriptions.Vietnamese: ST <color=#49A5FFFF>Điện Kích</color> gây ra sẽ kích hoạt Mảnh Nhũ Băng. ST <color=#49A5FFFF>Đánh</color> gây ST cao hơn cho <color=#49A5FFFF>Đóng Băng Bất Thường</color> và phun trào lượng lớn Mảnh Nhũ Băng
descriptions.Thai: <color=#49A5FFFF>​ความเสียหาย​จาก​แรง​กระแทก</color>​ทำให้เกิด​แท่ง​น้ำแข็ง​พุ่ง​ออกมา​จาก​เหยื่อ​ ​นอกจากนี้​การ​โจมตี​ด้วย<color=#49A5FFFF>​ท่า​ฟาด</color>​ของ​คุณ​จะ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ได้​สูง​กว่า​กับ​ศัตรู​ที่​มี<color=#49A5FFFF>​อาการ​หนาวเย็น</color>​และ​ทำให้​แท่ง​น้ำแข็ง​จำนวนมาก​พุ่ง​ออกมา​จาก​พวก​มัน
descriptions.French: Vos <color=#49A5FFFF>dégâts électriques</color> font jaillir des stalactites de vos victimes. De plus, vous infligez des <color=#49A5FFFF>dégâts contondants</color> plus importants aux ennemis souffrant d'une <color=#49A5FFFF>altération Froid</color> et vos attaques en font jaillir une grande quantité de stalactites.
descriptions.German: Dein <color=#49A5FFFF>Elektroschaden</color> lässt Eiszapfen aus den Opfern herausplatzen. Außerdem fügen deine <color=#49A5FFFF>Hiebschaden</color>-Angriffe Gegnern mit <color=#49A5FFFF>Kälteschwächung</color> höheren Schaden zu und lassen eine große Menge an Eiszapfen aus ihnen herausplatzen.
descriptions.Russian: Когда вы наносите врагам <color=#49A5FFFF>урон молнией</color>, их разрывают сосульки. Кроме того, ваши <color=#49A5FFFF>ударные</color> атаки наносят больше урона врагам, находящимся под воздействием <color=#49A5FFFF>холодящей хвори</color>, а количество сосулек увеличивается.
descriptions.Indonesian: <color=#49A5FFFF>Damage Syok</color> akan menyebabkan untaian es meledak dari target. Selain itu, serangan <color=#49A5FFFF>Memukul</color> akan menghasilkan damage yang lebih tinggi terhadap musuh yang memiliki <color=#49A5FFFF>Infeksi Dingin</color> dan menyebabkan sejumlah besar untaian es meledak dari dalam tubuh mereka.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Seu <color=#49A5FFFF>Dano de Eletricidade</color> faz com que sincelos surjam das vítimas. Além disso, seu ataque <color=#49A5FFFF>Contundente</color> causa um dano maior em inimigos com <color=#49A5FFFF>Condição Gelo</color> e produz uma quantidade ainda maior de sincelos neles.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Tu <color=#49A5FFFF>Daño eléctrico</color> causa que estallen estalactitas de tus víctimas. Además, tus ataques <color=#49A5FFFF>contundentes</color> causan más daño contra enemigos con <color=#49A5FFFF>Alteración de frío</color> y hacen que estallen más estalactitas de ellos.

name: Hyperconductivity

names.Thai: ตัวนำยิ่งยวด

description: Dealing Shock Damage to targets afflicted by <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> results in guaranteed crits.

descriptions.English: Dealing Shock Damage to targets afflicted by <color=#49A5FFFF>Cold Ailment</color> results in guaranteed crits.
descriptions.Chinese: 对<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷异常</color>的目标造成电击伤害时暴击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 對<color=#49A5FFFF>冰冷異常</color>的目標造成電擊傷害時暴擊
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#49A5FFFF>氷異常</color>の目標に電撃ダメージを与える時は必ず会心攻撃になる
descriptions.Korean: <color=#49A5FFFF>냉기 이상</color> 상태인 대상에 전기 대미지를 줄 때 치명타를 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi gây ST Điện Kích lên mục tiêu có <color=#49A5FFFF>Đóng Băng Bất Thường</color> sẽ bạo kích
descriptions.Thai: สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​จาก​ไฟ​ช็อต​ต่อ​เป้าหมาย​ที่​มี<color=#49A5FFFF>​อาการ​หนาว</color>​ ​ซึ่ง​รับประกัน​คริ​ติค​อล
descriptions.French: Infliger des dégâts électriques aux cibles victimes d'une <color=#49A5FFFF>altération Froid</color> garantit un critique.
descriptions.German: Elektroschaden-Angriffe auf Ziele mit <color=#49A5FFFF>Kälteschwächung</color> sind garantierte kritische Treffer.
descriptions.Russian: Если вы наносите урон от молнии целям с <color=#49A5FFFF>холодящей хворью</color>, атака гарантированно становится критической.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memberikan Damage Syok pada target dengan <color=#49A5FFFF>Penyakit Dingin</color> yang menghasilkan kritikal.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Causar Dano de Eletricidade a alvos com a <color=#49A5FFFF>Condição Gelo</color> resulta em críticos garantidos.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Infligir daño eléctrico a los objetivos afectados con <color=#49A5FFFF>alteración de frío</color> garantiza que el daño sea crítico.

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Static Charge
description: Periodically, your attacks create an electrified zone that damages enemies in it.

descriptions.English: Periodically, your attacks create an electrified zone that damages enemies in it.
descriptions.Chinese: 每隔一段时间，下次攻击敌人会触发闪电区域伤害敌人

name: Fulminating Slash
description: Imbue your weapon with the element of thunder and slice through nearby enemies.

descriptions.English: Imbue your weapon with the element of thunder and slice through nearby enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 在武器中注入电击元素攻击周围敌人

name: Honed Traits
description: Improves your character class Traits.

descriptions.English: Improves your character class Traits.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升职业特性

name: Icecleaver
description: Conjures axes of ice around you that attack enemies.

descriptions.English: Conjures axes of ice around you that attack enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 扔出围绕自身的冰霜斧攻击敌人

name: Excantation: Chiron’s Wake

names.Japanese: リバース・コメットフラッシュ
names.Thai: คาถา​:​ ​การตื่น​ของ​ไช​รอน

description: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to pull an extraplanar comet toward the ground, crushing enemies in its path and leaving a scintillating trail that deals continuous damage.

descriptions.English: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to pull an extraplanar comet toward the ground, crushing enemies in its path and leaving a scintillating trail that deals continuous damage.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，吸引一颗异界的彗星高速掠过地面，冲撞沿途的敌人并留下尾迹持续造成伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，吸引一顆異界的彗星高速掠過地面，衝撞沿途的敵人並留下尾跡持續造成傷害
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>リバースマナを消費</color>して異界からコメットを呼び出し、ルート上の敵にぶつかり、軌跡を残して持続ダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>역으로 마나를 소모해</color> 이계의 혜성을 소환해 고속으로 지면을 스쳐 지나가고, 경로상의 적에게 충돌한 후 흔적을 남겨 지속적으로 대미지를 가한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Tiêu hao năng lượng theo hướng ngược lại</color>, thu hút một sao chổi ngoài hành tinh bay trên mặt đất với tốc độ cao, va chạm với kẻ địch trên đường đi và để lại dấu vết tiếp tục gây ST
descriptions.Thai: คุณ<color=#ab87ca>​ใช้​พลัง​เวท​เชิงลบ</color>​ ​เพื่อ​ดึง​ดาวหาง​นอก​ระนาบ​ลงมา​ที่​พื้น​ ​บดขยี้​ศัตรู​ที่​ขวางทาง​และ​ทิ้งร่องรอย​อัน​แวววาว​ที่​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​อย่างต่อเนื่อง
descriptions.French: Vous <color=#ab87ca>consommez du mana négatif</color> pour faire tomber une comète extraplanaire vers le sol, écrasant les ennemis sur son passage et laissant une traînée scintillante qui inflige des dégâts continus.
descriptions.German: Du <color=#ab87ca>verbrauchst negatives Mana</color>, um einen extraplanaren Kometen auf den Boden zu ziehen, der Gegner in seinem Pfad zerschmettert und eine schillernde Spur hinterlässt, die kontinuierlich Schaden verursacht.
descriptions.Russian: Вы <color=#ab87ca>расходуете отрицательную ману</color>, чтобы притянуть к земле комету, сокрушающую врагов на своем пути и оставляющую за собой искрящийся след, который наносит постоянный урон.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu <color=#ab87ca>mengonsumsi mana negatis</color> untuk memanggil komet ke tanah, menghantam musuh yang ada di jalurnya dan meninggalkan jejak kehancuran yang terus memberikan damage.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você <color=#ab87ca>consome mana negativa</color> para puxar um cometa extraplanar em direção ao solo, esmagando os inimigos em seu caminho e deixando um rastro cintilante que causa dano contínuo.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Consumes maná negativo</color> para hacer descender un cometa extraplanario que aplasta a los enemigos en su camino y deja detrás una estela centelleante que inflige daño continuo.

name: Elemental Beam
description: Fire a focused beam of primordial energy that deals elemental damage.

descriptions.English: Fire a focused beam of primordial energy that deals elemental damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 射出一道元素激光，造成元素伤害

name: Lightning Flash
description: Dash forward and deal multiple consecutive electrical slashes to enemies.

descriptions.English: Dash forward and deal multiple consecutive electrical slashes to enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 突进并对敌人造成多段闪电斩击

name: Thunderous Strikes

names.Thai: การ​โจมตี​สายฟ้า​ฟาด

description: Next several normal attacks are empowered to trigger <color=#49A5FFFF>Invoke Thunder</color>.

descriptions.English: Next several normal attacks are empowered to trigger <color=#49A5FFFF>Invoke Thunder</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 使接下来数次普通攻击变为强力攻击，触发<color=#49A5FFFF>「唤雷术」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 使接下來數次普通攻擊變為強力攻擊，觸發<color=#49A5FFFF>「喚雷術」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 暫くの間通常攻撃が強力攻撃に変化し、<color=#49A5FFFF>「雷の召喚」</color>を発動する
descriptions.Korean: 다음 수 차례의 일반 공격이 강력한 공격으로 변경되며, <color=#49A5FFFF>「번개 소환술」</color>을 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Biến một số đòn tấn công thường tiếp theo thành đòn tấn công mạnh mẽ, kích hoạt <color=#49A5FFFF>"Thuật Hoán Lôi"</color>
descriptions.Thai: การ​โจมตี​ปกติ​หลายครั้ง​ถัดไป​จะ​มีพลัง​ที่​ทำให้เกิด​ ​<color=#49A5FFFF>​สายฟ้า​ฟาด</color>
descriptions.French: Les prochaines attaques normales ont le pouvoir de déclencher <color=#49A5FFFF>Fulguration</color>.
descriptions.German: Die nächsten normalen Angriffe erhalten die Macht, <color=#49A5FFFF>Donnerruf</color> auszulösen.
descriptions.Russian: Следующие несколько обычных атак накапливают <color=#49A5FFFF>вызов грома</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Beberapa serangan normal berikutnya diperkuat untuk memicu <color=#49A5FFFF>Invoke Thunder</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Em seguida, vários ataques normais podem desencadear <color=#49A5FFFF>Invocar Trovão</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Los siguientes ataques normales son capaces de <color=#49A5FFFF>invocar al trueno</color>.

names.Thai: <color=#49A5FFFF>​โอเวอร์​โหลด</color>

name: Trinity Traveler

names.Japanese: ネイチャーウォーカー
names.Thai: นักเดินทาง​สาม​สหาย

description: Shock, Poison and Cold Damage is increased, and you have a chance of reducing the remaining CD on skills when dealing the said types of damage.

descriptions.English: Shock, Poison and Cold Damage is increased, and you have a chance of reducing the remaining CD on skills when dealing the said types of damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 提升电击、毒素和冰冷伤害，造成这些伤害时有概率缩短技能的冷却时间
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 提升電擊、毒素和冰冷傷害，造成這些傷害時有概率縮短技能的冷卻時間
descriptions.Japanese: 雷、毒、氷のそれぞれのダメージを上げる。それらのダメージを与える時、一定確率でスキルCDを短縮する
descriptions.Korean: 번개, 독, 냉기 대미지가 증가하고 해당 대미지를 가할 시 일정 확률로 스킬 쿨타임이 감소한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Tăng ST Sét, Độc Tố và Đóng Băng, khi gây ra những ST này có xác suất rút ngắn thời gian hồi chiêu của kỹ năng
descriptions.Thai: ความเสียหาย​จาก​ไฟ​ช็อต​ ​พิษ​ ​และ​ความ​เย็น​เพิ่มขึ้น​ ​และ​มีโอกาส​ที่จะ​ลด​ CD ​ที่​เหลือขอ​ง​ทักษะ​เมื่อ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ประเภท​ดังกล่าว
descriptions.French: Les dégâts de choc, de poison et de froid sont augmentés, et vous avez une chance de réduire le temps de recharge restant sur les compétences lorsque vous infligez ces types de dégâts.
descriptions.German: Schock-, Gift- und Kälteschaden werden erhöht, und es besteht die Chance, dass die verbleibende AZ für Fertigkeiten verringert wird, wenn die genannten Schadenstypen verursacht werden.
descriptions.Russian: Урон от молнии, яда и холода повышается, и у вас появляется шанс сократить время перезарядки навыков при нанесении указанных типов урона.
descriptions.Indonesian: Syok, Racun, dan Damage Dingin ditingkatkan, dan kamu mempunyai peluang untuk mengurangi sisa CD pada skill saat menangani jenis damage tersebut.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Choque, Veneno e Dano de Gelo são aumentados, e você tem a chance de reduzir o CD restante nas habilidades ao lidar com esses tipos de dano.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Aumenta el daño venenoso, eléctrico y frío, y tienes una probabilidad de reducir el TdR restante de las habilidades cuando recibes esos tipos de daño.

name: Lancing Lightning

names.Thai: หอก​สายฟ้า

description: Imbue your weapon with the power of lightning, causing chain lightning to arc from victims of your normal hits. Locks a percentage of mana.

descriptions.English: Imbue your weapon with the power of lightning, causing chain lightning to arc from victims of your normal hits. Locks a percentage of mana.
descriptions.Chinese: 占用能量上限，向武器灌注闪电之力：普通攻击命中敌人时触发闪电链
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 佔用能量上限，向武器灌注閃電之力：普通攻擊命中敵人時觸發閃電鏈
descriptions.Japanese: マナ上限を消費し、武器に雷の力を与える。通常攻撃が敵に命中するとチェーンライトニングを発動する
descriptions.Korean: 일정 마나를 차지해 무기에 번개의 힘을 주입한다. 일반 공격이 적에게 명중하면 번개 사슬이 발동된다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Chiếm giữ tối đa năng lượng, truyền vào vũ khí sức mạnh tia chớp: Tấn công thường trúng kẻ địch sẽ kích hoạt được chuỗi tia chớp
descriptions.Thai: อาบ​พลัง​สายฟ้า​ให้​กับ​อาวุธ​ของ​คุณ​ ​ทำให้เกิด​สายฟ้า​ต่อเนื่อง​จาก​เป้าหมาย​การ​โจมตี​ปกติ​ของ​คุณ​ ​จะ​มี​การ​ล็อก​พลัง​เวท​เปอร์เซ็นต์​หนึ่ง
descriptions.French: Vous imprégnez votre arme du pouvoir de la foudre. Vos attaques normales créent une chaîne d'éclairs qui atteint vos ennemis. Bloque un certain pourcentage de mana.
descriptions.German: Verleihe deiner Waffe die Kraft des Blitzes, wodurch Kettenblitze von den Opfern deiner normalen Treffer ausgehen. Sperrt einen Teil des Manas.
descriptions.Russian: Вы наделяете свое оружие силой молнии, вызывая цепные молнии, исходящие от целей ваших обычных атак. Блокирует часть очков маны.
descriptions.Indonesian: Membenamkan kekuatan petir pada senjata, menyebabkan rangkaian petir membusur dari korban serangan normalmu. Mengunci persentase mana.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Infunde sua arma com o poder do trovão, fazendo com que raios em cadeia saiam das vítimas com os ataques normais. Bloqueia uma porcentagem de mana.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Infundes a tu arma con el poder de los relámpagos, lo que inicia un relámpago en cadena que forma un arco desde las víctimas de tus golpes normales. Bloquea un porcentaje de maná.

name: Glacial Domain
description: Send out a frigid blast that immobilizes nearby enemies.

descriptions.English: Send out a frigid blast that immobilizes nearby enemies.
descriptions.Chinese: 发出一阵冰冷冲击波，使周围单位无法移动

name: Fulgurant Vigor
description: Imbue your weapon with the power of thunder, transforming all your damage into shock damage that trigger chain lightning.

descriptions.English: Imbue your weapon with the power of thunder, transforming all your damage into shock damage that trigger chain lightning.
descriptions.Chinese: 向武器灌注雷霆之力，使伤害全部转化为闪电伤害，并引发连锁闪电

name: Glacial Domain

names.Thai: สนาม​พลัง​เหมันต์

description: Send out a frigid blast that <color=#49A5FFFF>Freezes</color> and immobilizes nearby units. Glacial Domain's effects are automatically triggered by <color=#49A5FFFF>Leaping Strike</color>.

descriptions.English: Send out a frigid blast that <color=#49A5FFFF>Freezes</color> and immobilizes nearby units. Glacial Domain's effects are automatically triggered by <color=#49A5FFFF>Leaping Strike</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 发出一阵冲击波，<color=#49A5FFFF>冻结</color>周围单位使之无法移动。<color=#49A5FFFF>跳跃打击</color>会自动触发冰川领域的效果
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 發出一陣衝擊波，<color=#49A5FFFF>凍結</color>周圍單位使之無法移動。<color=#49A5FFFF>跳躍打擊</color>會自動觸發冰川領域的效果
descriptions.Japanese: 衝撃波を放ち、周りの目標を<color=#49A5FFFF>氷結</color>させ移動できなくさせる。<color=#49A5FFFF>ジャンプストライク</color>は自動的に氷の領域の効果を発動する
descriptions.Korean: 충격파를 시전해 주변 유닛을 <color=#49A5FFFF>빙결</color>해 움직일 수 없도록 한다. <color=#49A5FFFF>점프 타격</color> 시 자동으로 빙하영역 효과를 발동한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Phát ra một sóng xung kích băng, <color=#49A5FFFF>Đóng Băng</color> đơn vị địch xung quanh khiến chúng không thể di chuyển. <color=#49A5FFFF>Đòn Đánh Nhảy Vọt</color> sẽ tự động kích hoạt hiệu ứng của Khu Vực Sông Băng
descriptions.Thai: ส่ง​ระเบิด​ความ​เย็น​ที่<color=#49A5FFFF>​แช่แข็ง</color>​และ​หยุด​การเคลื่อนไหว​ของ​ยู​นิต​ใกล้เคียง​ ​เอฟเฟกต์​ของ​สนาม​พลัง​เหมันต์​จะ​ทำงาน​โดยอัตโนมัติ​เมื่อ​ใช้<color=#49A5FFFF>​โดด​สังหาร</color>
descriptions.French: Vous envoyez une déflagration glaciale qui <color=#49A5FFFF>gèle</color> les ennemis à proximité. Les effets du domaine glacial sont automatiquement déclenchés par la <color=#49A5FFFF>Frappe bondissante</color>.
descriptions.German: Du erzeugst eine eisige Welle, die umstehende Gegner <color=#49A5FFFF>einfriert</color>. Die Effekte von Gletscherfeld werden durch <color=#49A5FFFF>Sprungschlag</color> automatisch ausgelöst.
descriptions.Russian: Вызывает леденящую волну, которая <color=#49A5FFFF>замораживает</color> и обездвиживает ближайших бойцов. Эффекты вечной мерзлоты автоматически активируются <color=#49A5FFFF>ударом в прыжке</color>.
descriptions.Indonesian: Mengeluarkan semburan udara dingin yang <color=#49A5FFFF>Membekukan</color> dan menghentikan musuh di sekitar. Efek Glacial Domain secara otomatis dipicu oleh <color=#49A5FFFF>Leaping Strike</color>.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Libera uma explosão gélida que <color=#49A5FFFF>Congela</color> e imobiliza as unidades próximas. Os efeitos de Domínio Glacial são acionados automaticamente por <color=#49A5FFFF>Ataque de Salto</color>.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Lanzas una onda gélida que <color=#49A5FFFF>congela</color> e inmoviliza a las unidades cercanas. Los efectos de Terreno glaciar se activan automáticamente con el <color=#49A5FFFF>Golpe descendente</color>.

name: Transmute Resistance
description: A percentage of each of your elemental resistances is added to its corresponding elemental damage.

descriptions.English: A percentage of each of your elemental resistances is added to its corresponding elemental damage.
descriptions.Chinese: 将元素抗性转化成对应的元素伤害加成

name: Apophis Impact

names.Thai: อะ​โพ​ฟิส​ถล่ม

description: Magically summon an extraplanar meteor to crash down upon the earth. Consuming surrounding <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> increases the number of meteors.

descriptions.English: Magically summon an extraplanar meteor to crash down upon the earth. Consuming surrounding <color=#49A5FFFF>Embers</color> increases the number of meteors.
descriptions.Chinese: 用法术召唤元素陨石砸向地面，消耗周围的<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>可以提升陨石数量
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 用法術召喚元素隕石砸向地面，消耗周圍的<color=#49A5FFFF>「火苗」</color>可以提升隕石數量
descriptions.Japanese: 元素の隕石を召喚して地面にぶつける。周りの<color=#49A5FFFF>「火の粉」</color>を消費すれば隕石の数を増やせる
descriptions.Korean: 마법으로 원소 운석을 지면에 떨어뜨린다. 주변 <color=#49A5FFFF>"불꽃"</color>을 소모하면 운석 수량이 증가한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: Dùng phép thuật triệu hồi Thiên Thạch Nguyên Tố đập xuống mặt đất, tiêu hao <color=#49A5FFFF>"Mồi Lửa"</color> xung quanh có thể tăng số lượng thiên thạch
descriptions.Thai: ใช้​เวทมนตร์​อัญเชิญ​อุกกาบาต​จาก​นอก​โลก​มาต​กล​งบ​น​โลก​ ​ใช้<color=#49A5FFFF>​เอ็ม​เบอร์</color>​รอบๆ​ ​เพื่อ​เพิ่มจำนวน​อุกกาบาต
descriptions.French: Lance un sort pour invoquer un météore d'outre-espace qui s'écrase sur Terre. Vous consommez les <color=#49A5FFFF>Braises</color> à proximité pour augmenter le nombre de météores.
descriptions.German: Du beschwörst auf magische Weise einen extraplanaren Meteor, der auf die Erde kracht. Durch Aufbrauchen umstehender <color=#49A5FFFF>Glut</color> steigt die Anzahl der Meteore.
descriptions.Russian: Вы обрушиваете космический метеорит на землю. Поглотив <color=#49A5FFFF>угли</color> поблизости, можно увеличить количество метеоритов.
descriptions.Indonesian: Memanggil meteor dari dunia lain untuk menabrak bumi. Menyerap <color=#49A5FFFF>Ember</color> di sekitar untuk meningkatkan jumlah meteor.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Invoca magicamente um meteoro extraplanar que cai sobre a terra. Consumir <color=#49A5FFFF>Brasas</color> ao redor aumenta o número de meteoros.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Invocas mágicamente un meteoro del espacio exterior para que caiga sobre el planeta. Aumentas la cantidad de meteoros al consumir las <color=#49A5FFFF>brasas</color> circundantes.

name: Blink
description: Teleport to the target location and deal Shock Damage around you.

descriptions.English: Teleport to the target location and deal Shock Damage around you.
descriptions.Chinese: 传送到目标位置，并照成电击伤害

name: Excantation: Stellachroma

names.Japanese: リバース・スターカラー
names.Thai: คาถา​:​ ​สเต​ล​ลา​โคร​มา

description: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to perform an attack with the opposite element of the last non-Excantation skill you’ve cast.

descriptions.English: You <color=#ab87ca>consume negative mana</color> to perform an attack with the opposite element of the last non-Excantation skill you’ve cast.
descriptions.Chinese: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，释放与上一个正常技能属性相反的攻击
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: <color=#ab87ca>逆向消耗能量</color>，釋放與上一個正常技能屬性相反的攻擊
descriptions.Japanese: <color=#ab87ca>リバースマナを消費</color>して、前回の通常スキルと真逆のエレメンタルダメージを与える
descriptions.Korean: <color=#ab87ca>역으로 마나를 소모해</color> 이전 정상 스킬 속성과 반대되는 공격을 발동한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#ab87ca>Tiêu hao năng lượng theo hướng ngược lại</color>, thi triển một đòn tấn công có thuộc tính ngược với kỹ năng thông thường trước đó
descriptions.Thai: คุณ<color=#ab87ca>​ใช้​พลัง​เวท​เชิงลบ</color>​ ​เพื่อ​ทำการ​โจมตี​ด้วย​ธาตุ​ตรงข้าม​ของ​ทักษะ​ที่​ไม่ใช่​คาถา​ล่าสุด​ที่​คุณ​ร่าย
descriptions.French: Vous <color=#ab87ca>consommez du mana négatif</color> pour effectuer une attaque avec l'élément opposé au dernier talent non Excantation que vous avez lancé.
descriptions.German: Du <color=#ab87ca>verbrauchst negatives Mana</color>, um einen Angriff mit dem entgegengesetzten Element der zuletzt gewirkten Nicht-Entzauberungsfertigkeit auszuführen.
descriptions.Russian: Вы <color=#ab87ca>расходуете отрицательную ману</color>, чтобы совершить атаку с элементом, противоположным последнему из разыгранных вами навыков, не относящихся к снятию чар.
descriptions.Indonesian: Kamu <color=#ab87ca>mengonsumsi mana negatif</color> untuk melakukan serangan dengan elemen berlawanan dari skill non-Excantation yang kamu lakukan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Você <color=#ab87ca>consome mana negativa</color> para realizar um ataque com o elemento oposto da última habilidade que você lançou que não seja Excantação.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): <color=#ab87ca>Consumes maná negativo</color> para lanzar un ataque con el elemento opuesto de la última habilidad que hayas lanzado que no sea una excantación.

name: Take Root

names.Thai: หยั่งราก

description: When not moving, you gain damage reduction and increased stats in proportion to the time spent in place.

descriptions.English: When not moving, you gain damage reduction and increased stats in proportion to the time spent in place.
descriptions.Chinese: 不移动时，减少受到的伤害并提升属性，持续越久，属性增幅越高
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 不移動時，減少受到的傷害並提升屬性，持續越久，屬性增幅越高
descriptions.Japanese: 止まっていると、被ダメージがダウンし、ステータスが持続的にアップする
descriptions.Korean: 이동하지 않을 때 받는 대미지가 감소하고 스탯이 증가한다. 오래 지속될수록 더 높은 스탯 증폭을 획득한다
descriptions.Vietnamese: Khi không di chuyển, giảm ST phải chịu và tăng thuộc tính, duy trì càng lâu, mức tăng thuộc tính càng cao
descriptions.Thai: เมื่อ​ไม่ได้​เคลื่อนที่​ ​จะ​ได้รับ​การ​ลด​ความเสียหาย​และ​ค่า​สถานะ​ที่​เพิ่มขึ้น​ตาม​สัดส่วน​ของ​เวลา​ที่​ใช้​หยุด​อยู่​ใน​สถานที่​นั้น​.
descriptions.French: Lorsque vous restez immobile, vous gagnez de la réduction de dégâts et une augmentation de stats proportionnellement au temps où vous restez immobile.
descriptions.German: Wenn du dich nicht bewegst, erhältst du eine Schadensreduktion und erhöhte Attribute im Verhältnis zu der an Ort und Stelle verbrachten Zeit.
descriptions.Russian: Когда вы не двигаетесь, вы получаете снижение урона и повышение показателей пропорционально времени, проведенному на одном месте.
descriptions.Indonesian: Saat diam, kamu mendapatkan pengurangan damage dan peningkatan status sesuai dengan lama waktu yang kamu habiskan dalam kondisi diam.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil): Quando não estiver se movendo, você receberá uma redução de dano e um aumento de atributos proporcionais ao tempo passado no mesmo lugar.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America): Cuando estás inmóvil, obtienes reducción de daño y aumentan tus estadísticas en proporción al tiempo que pasas en el lugar.

name: Entropic Flux

names.Japanese: エントロピーストリーム
names.Thai: ฟ​ลัก​ซ์​เอน​โทร​ปิก

description:
Direct an entropic flow to deal damage to enemies, more so when <color=#F4F19AFF>Light Ailment</color> or <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> can be consumed from them.
Attack speed does not affect the skill’s casting speed, but its damage instead.

descriptions.English:
Direct an entropic flow to deal damage to enemies, more so when <color=#F4F19AFF>Light Ailment</color> or <color=#ab87ca>Dark Ailment</color> can be consumed from them.
Attack speed does not affect the skill’s casting speed, but its damage instead.
descriptions.Chinese:
引动一道熵流造成伤害，并消耗敌人的<color=#F4F19AFF>闪光异常</color>和<color=#ab87ca>黑暗异常</color>以造成更高的伤害
攻击速度不会加快施法速度，转而提升伤害
descriptions.Chinese Traditional:
引動一道熵流造成傷害，並消耗敵人的<color=#F4F19AFF>閃光異常</color>和<color=#ab87ca>黑暗異常</color>以造成更高的傷害
攻擊速度不會加快施法速度，轉而提升傷害
descriptions.Japanese:
エントロピーストリームを引き起こしてダメージを与え、敵の<color=#F4F19AFF>光異常</color>と<color=#ab87ca>闇異常</color>を消費してダメージを上げることができる
攻撃速度が上昇する時、発動時間は短縮されないが、代わりにダメージが上昇する
descriptions.Korean:
엔트로피 스트림을 유도하여 대미지를 입히고, 적의 <color=#F4F19AFF>섬광 이상</color>과 <color=#ab87ca>암흑 이상</color>을 소모하여 더 높은 대미지를 입힌다.
공격 속도가 시전 속도를 높이는 것이 아니라 대미지를 증가시킨다.
descriptions.Vietnamese:
Tạo ra một dòng đẳng nhiệt gây sát thương, tiêu hao <color=#F4F19AFF>Tia Chớp Bất Thường</color> và <color=#ab87ca>Hắc Ám Bất Thường</color> của Quân địch để tạo thành sát thương lớn hơn 
Tốc độ tấn công sẽ chỉ làm tăng sát thương mà không làm tăng tốc độ thực hiện phép thuật
descriptions.Thai:
กำหนด​ทิศทาง​กระแส​เอน​โทร​ปิก​เพื่อ​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​ให้​กับ​ศัตรู​ ​และ​มากกว่า​นั้น​เมื่อ​สามารถ​กิน​ ​<color=#F4F19AFF>​อาการ​แสง</color>​ ​หรือ​ ​<color=#ab87ca>​อาการ​มืด</color>​ ​จาก​พวก​มัน​ได้​
​ความเร็ว​ใน​การ​โจมตี​ไม่​ส่งผล​ต่อ​ความเร็ว​ใน​การ​ร่าย​ทักษะ​ ​แต่​จะ​ส่งผล​ต่อ​ความเสียหาย​แทน
descriptions.French:
Dirige un flux entropique pour infliger des dégâts aux ennemis, d'autant plus lorsqu'il est possible de consommer des <color=#F4F19AFF>altérations Lumière</color> ou des <color=#ab87ca>altérations Ténèbres</color> qui les affectent.
La vitesse d'attaque n'affecte pas la vitesse d'incantation du talent, mais elle affecte ses dégâts.
descriptions.German:
Lenke einen entropischen Fluss auf Gegner, um ihnen Schaden zuzufügen. Wenn <color=#F4F19AFF>Lichtschwächung</color> oder <color=#ab87ca>Dunkelschwächung</color> von ihnen verbraucht werden kann, wird der Schaden erhöht.
Das Angriffstempo wirkt sich nicht auf das Zaubertempo der Fertigkeit aus, sondern stattdessen auf ihren Schaden.
descriptions.Russian:
Направьте поток энтропии, чтобы нанести урон врагам, который повышается, если вы можете поглотить их <color=#F4F19AFF>ослепляющую</color> или <color=#ab87ca>черную хворь</color>.
Скорость атаки не влияет на скорость применения навыка, но влияет на его урон.
descriptions.Indonesian:
Mengarahkan aliran entropik untuk menghasilkan damage pada musuh, terlebih lagi jika <color=#F4F19AFF>Infeksi Cahaya</color> atau <color=#ab87ca>Infeksi Kegelapan</color> dapat dikonsumsi dari mereka.
Kecepatan serang tidak memengaruhi kecepatan mengeluarkan skill, melainkan damage yang ditimbulkan.
descriptions.Portuguese (Brazil):
Direciona um fluxo entrópico para causar dano aos inimigos, que pode ser aumentado ainda mais quando for possível consumir <color=#F4F19AFF>Condição Luz</color> ou <color=#ab87ca>Condição Escuridão</color> deles.
A velocidade de ataque não afeta a velocidade de conjuração da habilidade, mas sim o seu dano.
descriptions.Spanish (Latin America):
Diriges un flujo entrópico que causa daño a los enemigos. El daño aumenta si tienen <color=#F4F19AFF>alteración de luz</color> o <color=#ab87ca>alteración de oscuridad</color> para consumir.
La velocidad de ataque no afecta la velocidad con la que se activa la habilidad, pero sí afecta el daño que causa.

names.Thai: <color=#49A5FFFF>​ความเจริญงอกงาม</color>

name: Empyrean Hammer

names.Thai: ค้อน​เอม​พี​เรียน

description: During the skill’s uptime, <color=#49A5FFFF>normal attacks</color> and <color=#49A5FFFF>Shield Bash</color> inflict an additional bash that deals damage and reduces <color=#F4F19AFF>Light</color> Resistance. Using the skill removes other <color=#F4F19AFF>Blessings</color>.

descriptions.English: During the skill’s uptime, <color=#49A5FFFF>normal attacks</color> and <color=#49A5FFFF>Shield Bash</color> inflict an additional bash that deals damage and reduces <color=#F4F19AFF>Light</color> Resistance. Using the skill removes other <color=#F4F19AFF>Blessings</color>.
descriptions.Chinese: 持续时间内，<color=#49A5FFFF>「普通攻击」</color>和<color=#49A5FFFF>「盾击」</color>会产生一次额外的重击，造成伤害并降低<color=#F4F19AFF>闪光</color>抗性，移除其他<color=#F4F19AFF>「祝福」</color>
descriptions.Chinese Traditional: 持續時間內，<color=#49A5FFFF>「普通攻擊」</color>和<color=#49A5FFFF>「盾擊」</color>會產生一次額外的重擊，造成傷害並降低<color=#F4F19AFF>閃光</color>抗性，移除其他<color=#F4F19AFF>「祝福」</color>
descriptions.Japanese: 効果期間中、<color=#49A5FFFF>「通常攻撃」</color>と<color=#49A5FFFF>「盾撃」</color>は追加で重撃になってダメージを与え、さらに<color=#F4F19AFF>光耐性</color>を下げる。他の<color=#F4F19AFF>「祝福」</color>を解除する
descriptions.Korean: 지속 시간 동안 <color=#49A5FFFF>[일반 공격]</color>과 <color=#49A5FFFF>[방패 공격]</color> 시 추가 펀치가 발생하여 대미지를 입히고 <color=#F4F19AFF>빛</color> 저항이 감소되며, 다른 <color=#F4F19AFF>[축복]</color>을 제거한다.
descriptions.Vietnamese: <color=#49A5FFFF>"Tấn công thường"</color> và <color=#49A5FFFF>"Tấn Công Khiên"</color> sẽ tạo thêm một đòn nặng, gây sát thương đồng thời làm giảm Kháng <color=#F4F19AFF>tia chớp</color>, loại bỏ các <color=#F4F19AFF>"Chúc Phúc"</color> khác trong thời gian sử dụng
descriptions.Thai: ใน​ช่วง​ความพร้อม​ของ​ทักษะ<color=#49A5FFFF>​การ​โจมตี​ปกติ</color>​และ<color=#49A5FFFF>​โล่​ทุบตี</color>​จะ​โจมตี​เพิ่มเติม​ซึ่ง​สร้าง​ความเสียหาย​และ​ลด​ความต้านทาน<color=#F4F19AFF>​แสงสว่าง</color>​ลง​ ​การ​ใช้​ทักษะ​จะ​ลบ<color=#F4F19AFF>​พร</color>​อื่นๆ
descriptions.French: Pendant la durée du talent, les <color=#49A5FFFF>attaques normales</color> et le <color=#49A5FFFF>Coup de bouclier</color> donnent un coup supplémentaire qui inflige des dégâts et réduit la résistance à la <color=#F4F19AFF>lumière</color>. Utiliser ce talent retire les autres <color=#F4F19AFF>sacrements</color>.
descriptions.German: Solange die Fertigkeit aktiv ist, verursachen <color=#49A5FFFF>normale Angriffe</color> und <color=#49A5FFFF>Schildschlag</color> einen zusätzlichen Angriff, der Schaden verursacht und die <color=#F4F19AFF>Lichtresistenz</color> des Ziels verringert. Wenn diese Fertigkeit eingesetzt wird, werden alle anderen <color=#F4F19AFF>Segen</color> entfernt.
